paras.en: The outer Solar System is icier still. Far from the warmth of the Sun, the estimated millions of icy objects that make up the Kuiper Belt beyond Neptune are thought to contain absolute scads of the stuff.
paras.zh: 太阳系外层仍然冰冷。远离太阳的温暖，海王星以外的柯伊伯带估计有数百万个冰冷物体，被认为含有绝对大量的这种物质。

paras.en: And now, scientists have found evidence that at least some of that distant water is of a kind singularly unlike the water we have here on Earth.
paras.zh: 现在，科学家们发现的证据表明，至少有一些遥远的水与地球上的水截然不同。

paras.en: In a handful of dust grains that traveled to Earth from the Kuiper Belt, traces remain of long-lost water bearing the signature of primordial chemistry – suggesting that the water reservoir at the edge of the Solar System remained pristine, untouched by the changes unfolding closer to the Sun.
paras.zh: 在从柯伊伯带传播到地球的少量尘埃颗粒中，残留着长期消失的水的痕迹，带有原始化学的特征——这表明太阳系边缘的水库保持着原始状态，没有受到靠近太阳的变化的影响。

paras.en: It is, according to a study led by planetary scientist Lindsay Keller of NASA's Johnson Space Center, "compelling evidence for the presence of a major heavy water reservoir beyond the orbits of the gas giant planets that was largely isolated from inner solar system materials."
paras.zh: 根据美国宇航局约翰逊航天中心的行星科学家林赛·凯勒领导的一项研究，这是“令人信服的证据，证明在气态巨行星的轨道之外存在一个主要的重水库，该水库基本上与太阳系内部的物质隔离。”

paras.en: The Kuiper Belt beyond Neptune's orbit at roughly 30 astronomical units from the Sun – 30 times the Earth-Sun distance – represents a somewhat challenging Solar System frontier.
paras.zh: 海王星轨道之外的柯伊伯带距太阳约 30 个天文单位（地球与太阳距离的 30 倍），代表了太阳系的一个具有挑战性的前沿。

paras.en: Very few human-made craft have ventured into its cold, dark reaches.
paras.zh: 很少有人造飞船冒险进入其寒冷、黑暗的区域。

paras.en: It takes years to get there; landing a probe or collecting samples to send to Earth would be so astronomically difficult and expensive that – so far at least – it's out of the question entirely.
paras.zh: 到达那里需要数年时间；着陆探测器或收集样本发送到地球将是极其困难和昂贵的，至少到目前为止，这是完全不可能的。

paras.en: This is kind of a bummer, because the chunks of ice and rock hanging out in the Kuiper Belt are thought to be among the most unchanged remnants of the early Solar System since it all coalesced out of solar amniotic dust and gas some 4.5 billion years ago.
paras.zh: 这有点令人失望，因为柯伊伯带中悬挂的大块冰和岩石被认为是早期太阳系中最没有变化的遗迹之一，因为它们都是在大约 45 亿年前从太阳羊膜尘埃和气体中凝聚而成的。

paras.en: Luckily for us, though, not everything in the Kuiper Belt stays there.
paras.zh: 不过，对我们来说幸运的是，并不是柯伊伯带中的所有东西都留在那里。

paras.en: We can't see it, but the Solar System is full of cosmic dust. An estimated 5,200 metric tons of the stuff rains down on Earth every year. And some of that dust has traveled a long, long way to get here.
paras.zh: 我们看不到它，但太阳系充满了宇宙尘埃。据估计，每年有 5,200 吨这些物质降落在地球上。有些灰尘是经过很长很长的路才到达这里的。

paras.en: Keller and his colleagues found 12 such grains, each measuring 10 to 30 micrometers across, in materials collected from the stratosphere by high-altitude NASA aircraft.
paras.zh: 凯勒和他的同事在 NASA 飞机从平流层收集的材料中发现了 12 个这样的颗粒，每个颗粒的直径为 10 至 30 微米。

paras.en: Ah, but this raises an interesting and important question: how can you tell that a micron-scale speck of dust scooped from Earth's stratosphere came all the way from beyond Neptune's orbit?
paras.zh: 啊，但这提出了一个有趣而重要的问题：你怎么知道从地球平流层舀出的微米级尘埃是从海王星轨道之外一路而来的？

paras.en: In the Solar System, it's all about travel scars. In interplanetary space, there's no atmospheric protection from the powerful radiation streaming from the Sun – and solar energetic particles don't leave exposed dust unscathed.
paras.zh: 在太阳系中，一切都是关于旅行的伤痕。在行星际空间中，大气层无法抵御来自太阳的强大辐射，而且太阳高能粒子也不会让暴露的尘埃毫发无损。

paras.en: As it passes through a speck of dust, solar energetic particles can knock atoms slightly askew in their crystal lattice structures, leaving a telltale trail in their wake – a bit like a charged particle leaving a trail in vapor in a cloud chamber, although the mechanisms are different.
paras.zh: 当穿过一粒尘埃时，太阳高能粒子可以使原子的晶格结构稍微倾斜，在其尾迹中留下明显的痕迹——有点像带电粒子在云室中的蒸汽中留下痕迹，尽管机制不同。

paras.en: The more such trails a mineral has accumulated, the more time it has spent drifting in interplanetary space. And it's pretty reliable. Dust orbiting the Sun experiences something called the Poynting-Robertson effect – a very slight drag exerted by sunlight, causing the grains to gradually lose energy and spiral inward towards the Sun.
paras.zh: 矿物积累的此类痕迹越多，它在行星际空间中漂流的时间就越长。而且它非常可靠。绕太阳运行的尘埃会经历一种叫做坡印廷-罗伯逊效应的现象——阳光施加的一种非常轻微的阻力，导致颗粒逐渐失去能量并向内螺旋向太阳。

paras.en: So scientists can count the radiation tracks and work out whether a grain has spent enough time in space to have traveled from the distant reaches of the Solar System.
paras.zh: 因此，科学家可以计算辐射轨迹，并计算出颗粒是否在太空中度过了足够的时间，从而从遥远的太阳系传播出去。

paras.en: The grains identified by Keller and his team had track densities around 100 times greater than expected for dust from the asteroid belt or Jupiter-family comets – consistent with an origin from much farther away, as far as the Kuiper Belt.
paras.zh: 凯勒和他的团队发现的颗粒轨迹密度比小行星带或木星家族彗星尘埃的预期密度高出约 100 倍，这与更远的柯伊伯带的起源一致。

paras.en: The mineral composition of the grains offers another clue – and, as the researchers found, holds the secret of the ancient water they encountered.
paras.zh: 谷物的矿物成分提供了另一条线索，正如研究人员发现的那样，它掌握着他们所遇到的古代水的秘密。

paras.en: The grains were extraordinarily rich in carbon, containing around four times as much as certain carbonaceous meteorites – another indication that they formed under different conditions, far from the Sun.
paras.zh: 这些颗粒的碳含量异常丰富，其含量约为某些碳质陨石的四倍——这又表明它们是在远离太阳的不同条件下形成的。

paras.en: But there was something else in the grains that yielded a particularly tantalizing clue about their history – clay.
paras.zh: 但谷物中还有另一种东西，可以提供有关其历史的特别诱人的线索——粘土。

paras.en: Many of the grains contained clays such as saponite and serpentine, as well as other hydrated minerals that form when water reacts chemically with other minerals, altering their composition.
paras.zh: 许多颗粒含有皂石和蛇纹石等粘土，以及水与其他矿物质发生化学反应改变其成分时形成的其他水合矿物质。

paras.en: This means that, at some point in the distant past, liquid water must have existed inside the parent bodies from which the dust grains originated.
paras.zh: 这意味着，在遥远的过去的某个时刻，液态水一定存在于尘埃颗粒起源的母体内。

paras.en: Although the Kuiper Belt is frozen today, radioactive decay or heat generated by collisions could once have warmed the interiors of some of its icy objects enough to melt water, allowing it to react with the surrounding rock.
paras.zh: 尽管柯伊伯带今天已经结冰，但放射性衰变或碰撞产生的热量曾经可能使一些冰冷物体的内部变暖，足以融化水，使其与周围的岩石发生反应。

paras.en: That water is long gone, but the minerals in the 12 grains retained some of the oxygen that was once part of its molecules. And that's where things got very not-from-around-here.
paras.zh: 水早已消失，但 12 粒颗粒中的矿物质保留了一些曾经是其分子一部分的氧。这就是事情变得非常不来自这里的地方。

paras.en: Oxygen comes in several varieties, called isotopes, which differ in the number of neutrons in their atomic nuclei. The most common by far is oxygen-16, with eight protons and eight neutrons. But there are also two heavier, naturally occurring stable isotopes: oxygen-17, with eight protons and nine neutrons, and oxygen-18, with eight protons and ten neutrons.
paras.zh: 氧有多种类型，称为同位素，其原子核中的中子数量不同。迄今为止最常见的是氧16，有八个质子和八个中子。但还有两种较重的、天然存在的稳定同位素：氧 17，有 8 个质子和 9 个中子，氧 18，有 8 个质子和 10 个中子。

paras.en: The relative proportions of these isotopes can vary depending on where and how a material formed, leaving a sort of chemical fingerprint of its history.
paras.zh: 这些同位素的相对比例可能会根据材料形成的地点和方式而变化，从而留下其历史的化学指纹。

paras.en: When Keller and his colleagues measured the oxygen isotopes in the dust grains, they found an unusual enrichment in the heavier varieties.
paras.zh: 当凯勒和他的同事测量尘埃颗粒中的氧同位素时，他们发现较重的品种异常富集。

paras.en: By reconstructing the chemical reactions that formed the hydrated minerals, the researchers were able to estimate the isotopic composition of the water responsible.
paras.zh: 通过重建形成水合矿物质的化学反应，研究人员能够估计出水的同位素组成。

paras.en: They found that the minerals inherited the heavier oxygen isotopes from water that must have been unusually rich in them – preserving the signature of an ancient reservoir that existed in the outer Solar System billions of years ago.
paras.zh: 他们发现，这些矿物质从水中继承了较重的氧同位素，而水中的氧同位素含量一定异常丰富，从而保留了数十亿年前存在于太阳系外层的古老水库的特征。

paras.en: The isotopic signature was distinctly different from that of water inferred from carbonaceous meteorites, which formed in other regions of the early Solar System.
paras.zh: 该同位素特征与从早期太阳系其他区域形成的碳质陨石推断出的水的同位素特征明显不同。

paras.en: This suggests that the water in the distant Kuiper Belt belonged to a separate reservoir that had remained largely isolated from the mixing and chemical changes taking place closer to the Sun.
paras.zh: 这表明遥远的柯伊伯带中的水属于一个单独的水库，该水库在很大程度上与太阳附近发生的混合和化学变化隔离。

paras.en: And the researchers have an idea about what might have kept it that way: the giant planets.
paras.zh: 研究人员对可能使其保持这种状态的原因有了一个想法：巨行星。

paras.en: You're nodding to yourself now, thinking, yep, that sounds like Jupiter. But this time, it is Saturn acting as the goalkeeper, keeping the outer Solar System's primordial water from crossing into the inner Solar System.
paras.zh: You're nodding to yourself now, thinking, yep, that sounds like Jupiter.但这一次，土星充当了守门员的角色，阻止了外太阳系的原始水进入内太阳系。

paras.en: Models of the early Solar System suggest that Saturn could have created a pressure bump in the disk of gas and dust surrounding the young Sun, slowing or even stopping material from drifting inward.
paras.zh: 早期太阳系的模型表明，土星可能在年轻太阳周围的气体和尘埃盘中产生了压力凸起，减缓甚至阻止了物质向内漂移。

paras.en: Together with the ice giants, Saturn may therefore have helped preserve a reservoir of water with an isotopic signature distinct from the material circulating closer to the Sun.
paras.zh: 因此，土星可能与冰巨星一起帮助保存了一个水库，其同位素特征不同于靠近太阳的循环物质。

paras.en: Scientists have long suspected that such a reservoir of heavy-oxygen-rich water existed in the early Solar System, but evidence of it has been remarkably difficult to find.
paras.zh: 科学家们长期以来一直怀疑早期太阳系中存在这样一个富含重氧的水库，但要找到它的证据却非常困难。

paras.en: Most of the meteorites available for study come from regions where extensive mixing and chemical alteration have obscured the original isotopic signatures.
paras.zh: 大多数可供研究的陨石来自广泛的混合和化学变化掩盖了原始同位素特征的地区。

paras.en: But this evidence may have been drifting right under our noses this entire time.
paras.zh: 但这些证据可能一直就在我们眼皮子底下漂流。

paras.en: Twelve grains may not sound like a lot… until you consider how far they must have traveled, and how they were collected. In a 2022 paper, Keller and coauthor George Flynn of the State University of New York estimated that as much as a quarter of the interplanetary dust entering the inner Solar System may have traveled from the Kuiper Belt.
paras.zh: 十二粒谷物听起来可能不是很多……直到您考虑它们必须走了多远以及它们是如何收集的。在 2022 年的一篇论文中，凯勒和纽约州立大学的合著者乔治·弗林估计，进入内太阳系的行星际尘埃中有多达四分之一可能是从柯伊伯带传播的。

paras.en: Somewhere in the constant rain of cosmic dust that falls to Earth may lie countless other fragments of the Solar System's earliest history, scarred from the journey and carrying secrets that have survived billions of years to end up in your roof gutter.
paras.zh: 在不断落在地球上的宇宙尘埃雨中的某个地方，可能存在着太阳系最早历史的无数其他碎片，它们在旅途中伤痕累累，并承载着数十亿年来幸存下来的秘密，最终落入你的屋顶排水沟中。

paras.en: The research has been published in Science Advances.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学进展》上。

articles.title: The mystery of how hair knows where to grow may finally be solved

paras.en: The mystery of how hair knows where to grow may finally be solved
paras.zh: 头发如何知道在哪里生长的谜团可能最终被解开

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered that the intricate patterns of hair follicles on mammals may arise from a remarkably simple process involving cells following chemical signals. The findings challenge a long-standing theory and reveal how nature can create complex biological patterns without a detailed blueprint.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，哺乳动物毛囊的复杂模式可能源于一个非常简单的过程，涉及细胞遵循化学信号。这些发现挑战了长期存在的理论，并揭示了大自然如何在没有详细蓝图的情况下创造出复杂的生物模式。

paras.en: Long before a mammal is born, its skin begins establishing the precise locations where hair will eventually grow. These developing hair follicles form intricate geometric arrangements that differ from species to species. But what determines where each follicle appears, and how does the body create such orderly patterns?
paras.zh: 早在哺乳动物出生之前，它的皮肤就开始确定毛发最终生长的精确位置。这些发育中的毛囊形成复杂的几何排列，且因物种而异。但是是什么决定了每个卵泡出现的位置，以及身体如何创造出如此有序的模式呢？

paras.en: Researchers at the University of Geneva (UNIGE) have identified a surprisingly simple process that may help explain this biological mystery. By studying how cells move in response to chemical signals, the team developed a model that successfully recreates the formation of hair follicle patterns in two mammalian species. Their findings, published in PNAS, suggest that elaborate biological structures can emerge naturally from basic interactions between neighboring cells.
paras.zh: 日内瓦大学 (UNIGE) 的研究人员发现了一个令人惊讶的简单过程，可能有助于解释这一生物学之谜。通过研究细胞如何响应化学信号而移动，该团队开发了一种模型，成功地重现了两种哺乳动物毛囊模式的形成。他们发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上的研究结果表明，精细的生物结构可以从相邻细胞之间的基本相互作用中自然产生。

paras.en: The discovery could help explain a much broader phenomenon in nature. Hair, feathers, and most types of scales begin as small structures called placodes that appear during embryonic development. Scientists have spent decades investigating how these early structures establish the distinctive arrangements seen across different animal species.
paras.zh: 这一发现可能有助于解释自然界中更广泛的现象。头发、羽毛和大多数类型的鳞片最初都是在胚胎发育过程中出现的称为基板的小结构。科学家们花了几十年的时间研究这些早期结构如何建立不同动物物种的独特排列。

paras.en: Challenging a Long-Standing Theory of Hair Growth
paras.zh: 挑战长期存在的头发生长理论

paras.en: For laboratory mice (Mus musculus), the leading explanation has traditionally been the expansion-induction model. This theory proposes that when a new placode appears, it releases a chemical that prevents additional placodes from developing too close to it.
paras.zh: 对于实验室小鼠（Mus musculus），传统上主要的解释是扩张诱导模型。该理论提出，当新的基板出现时，它会释放一种化学物质，防止其他基板发育得离它太近。

paras.en: As the embryo's skin grows and stretches, some areas move far enough away from existing placodes to escape the chemical's influence. New placodes can then develop in those spaces, gradually creating a more complete pattern across the skin.
paras.zh: 随着胚胎皮肤的生长和伸展，一些区域会远离现有的基板，以逃避化学物质的影响。然后，新的基板可以在这些空间中发育，逐渐在皮肤上形成更完整的图案。

paras.en: Although this explanation has gained widespread acceptance, scientists have not experimentally established that it can account for the diversity of follicle patterns found across species.
paras.zh: 尽管这种解释已获得广泛接受，但科学家尚未通过实验证明它可以解释跨物种毛囊模式的多样性。

paras.en: A Simpler Mechanism for Hair Follicle Formation
paras.zh: 更简单的毛囊形成机制

paras.en: To investigate another possibility, researchers led by Athanasia Tzika, Senior Lecturer, and Michel Milinkovitch, Professor, both in the Department of Genetics and Evolution at UNIGE's Faculty of Science, focused on a process called chemotaxis.
paras.zh: 为了研究另一种可能性，由 UNIGE 理学院遗传与进化系高级讲师 Athanasia Tzika 和教授 Michel Milinkovitch 领导的研究人员重点研究了一种称为趋化性的过程。

paras.en: Chemotaxis occurs when cells move in response to differences in chemical concentrations. The same basic process helps guide white blood cells toward areas of inflammation, allowing the immune system to respond where it is needed.
paras.zh: 当细胞响应化学浓度的差异而移动时，就会发生趋化性。相同的基本过程有助于引导白细胞流向炎症区域，从而使免疫系统能够在需要的地方做出反应。

paras.en: The researchers created a mathematical model that tracks how mobile cells in the dermis interact with an attracting chemical signal released by the epidermis, the skin's outer layer. They then simulated the growth of embryonic skin to see whether these interactions could produce the gradual appearance of placodes.
paras.zh: 研究人员创建了一个数学模型，用于追踪真皮中的移动细胞如何与表皮（皮肤的外层）释放的吸引化学信号相互作用。然后，他们模拟了胚胎皮肤的生长，看看这些相互作用是否会导致基板逐渐出现。

paras.en: Remarkably, the model recreated the developmental patterns observed in laboratory mice, including the same sequence of follicle formation that scientists had previously explained using the expansion-induction theory. This suggests that a complex system of instructions may not be necessary to determine where follicles develop.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，该模型重现了在实验室小鼠中观察到的发育模式，包括科学家之前使用扩张诱导理论解释的相同的卵泡形成顺序。这表明可能不需要复杂的指令系统来确定卵泡的发育位置。

paras.en: "Our findings show that the observed patterns do not require a complex system telling each placode where to form," explain Muhamet Ibrahimi and Ebrahim Jahanbakhsh, researchers in the Department of Genetics and Evolution. "Instead, placodes emerge spontaneously from local interactions between cells and chemical signals."
paras.zh: “我们的研究结果表明，观察到的模式不需要一个复杂的系统来告诉每个基板在哪里形成，”遗传与进化系的研究人员穆罕默德·易卜拉希米和易卜拉欣·贾汉巴赫什解释道。 “相反，基板是通过细胞和化学信号之间的局部相互作用自发出现的。”

paras.en: One Simple Process Creates Different Hair Patterns
paras.zh: 一个简单的过程创造出不同的头发图案

paras.en: The team next investigated whether the same mechanism could explain follicle arrangements in another mammal with a very different coat structure.
paras.zh: 研究小组接下来研究了相同的机制是否可以解释另一种皮毛结构截然不同的哺乳动物的毛囊排列。

paras.en: They selected the spiny mouse (Acomys dimidiatus), a rodent whose hair follicles develop in an unusually regular pattern with a strong directional alignment. This distinctive organization cannot be explained by the traditional expansion-induction model.
paras.zh: 他们选择了刺鼠（Acomys dimidiatus），这是一种啮齿动物，其毛囊以异常规则的方式发育，具有很强的方向性。这种独特的组织无法用传统的扩张-归纳模型来解释。

paras.en: Using experimental information gathered from three-dimensional images of developing embryonic skin, the researchers adapted their simulations to reflect the spiny mouse's particular biochemical characteristics and the way its skin grows.
paras.zh: 利用从发育中的胚胎皮肤的三维图像收集的实验信息，研究人员调整了他们的模拟，以反映多刺小鼠的特定生化特征及其皮肤的生长方式。

paras.en: The results showed that the same underlying process of cells responding to chemical signals could also reproduce the spiny mouse's highly organized follicle pattern. The differences between the two species could be explained by variations in their cellular interactions, chemical properties, and skin growth rather than entirely different mechanisms.
paras.zh: 结果表明，细胞响应化学信号的相同基本过程也可以重现多刺小鼠高度组织化的毛囊模式。这两个物种之间的差异可以通过它们的细胞相互作用、化学性质和皮肤生长的差异来解释，而不是完全不同的机制。

paras.en: These findings suggest that the remarkable variety of structures found throughout the animal kingdom may arise from a shared set of relatively simple biological rules. By adjusting how cells interact and respond to their surroundings, nature can generate dramatically different patterns without requiring a separate developmental blueprint for every species.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，在整个动物界中发现的各种显着的结构可能源于一组共享的相对简单的生物学规则。通过调整细胞如何相互作用以及对周围环境的反应，大自然可以产生截然不同的模式，而不需要为每个物种提供单独的发育蓝图。

paras.en: "Our work suggests that simple cellular interactions can generate the remarkable diversity of tissue architectures observed throughout evolution," concludes Athanasia Tzika. "The differences observed between species therefore result from the same self-organization process, but with variations in the interactions between cells and chemical signals."
paras.zh: “我们的工作表明，简单的细胞相互作用可以产生在整个进化过程中观察到的组织结构的显着多样性，”Athanasia Tzika 总结道。 “因此，物种之间观察到的差异是由相同的自组织过程造成的，但细胞和化学信号之间的相互作用存在差异。”

paras.zh: 材料由日内瓦大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.zh: - 穆罕默德·易卜拉希米、易卜拉欣·贾汉巴赫什、阿塔纳西娅·C·齐卡、米歇尔·C·米林科维奇。趋化自组织捕捉了哺乳动物毛囊图案的动态。美国国家科学院院刊，2026 年； 123 (27) DOI: 10.1073/pnas.2530407123

articles.title: Obesity linked to up to 27% lower risk of death in dementia

paras.en: Obesity linked to up to 27% lower risk of death in dementia
paras.zh: 肥胖可使痴呆症死亡风险降低 27%

paras.en: - Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health
paras.zh: - 哥伦比亚大学梅尔曼公共卫生学院

paras.en: - A surprising study of more than 4,500 older adults found that people who were overweight or obese when diagnosed with dementia had a 16% to 27% lower risk of death than those at a normal weight. Researchers suspect that extra energy and muscle reserves may help patients survive the disease's toll on the body, although the reason for the survival advantage remains unclear.
paras.zh: - 一项对 4,500 多名老年人进行的令人惊讶的研究发现，被诊断患有痴呆症时超重或肥胖的人的死亡风险比正常体重的人低 16% 至 27%。研究人员怀疑，额外的能量和肌肉储备可能有助于患者在疾病对身体造成的损害中生存下来，尽管生存优势的原因尚不清楚。

paras.en: A surprising new study has found that people who are overweight or obese when diagnosed with dementia tend to live longer than those who have a normal body weight. The findings challenge expectations about the relationship between weight and health, suggesting that carrying extra weight may be associated with an unexpected survival advantage after dementia develops.
paras.zh: 一项令人惊讶的新研究发现，在被诊断患有痴呆症时超重或肥胖的人往往比体重正常的人寿命更长。该研究结果对体重与健康之间关系的一般看法提出了质疑，表明在患上失智症后，超重可能与意想不到的生存优势相关。

paras.en: Researchers from Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health and NYU School of Global Public Health found that body weight at the time of diagnosis may provide important clues about how long someone with dementia is likely to live. Their findings, published in the Journal of Alzheimer's Disease, also highlight the importance of proper nutrition for people living with the condition.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚大学梅尔曼公共卫生学院和纽约大学全球公共卫生学院的研究人员发现，诊断时的体重可能为痴呆症患者的寿命提供重要线索。他们的研究结果发表在《阿尔茨海默病杂志》上，也强调了适当营养对患有这种疾病的人的重要性。

paras.en: The results are particularly intriguing because obesity is well established as a risk factor for several serious health problems, including heart disease and diabetes. Being overweight or obese during middle age is also associated with a greater likelihood of developing dementia later in life. However, previous research has suggested that the relationship may reverse once dementia has developed, with higher body weight linked to better survival.
paras.zh: 研究结果特别令人感兴趣，因为肥胖已被确定为导致心脏病和糖尿病等多种严重健康问题的危险因素。中年时期超重或肥胖也与晚年患痴呆症的可能性更大有关。然而，之前的研究表明，一旦患上痴呆症，这种关系可能会逆转，体重越高，生存率越高。

paras.en: "Because this finding is somewhat counterintuitive, an important question is whether it could simply be an artifact of bias. Our analyses suggest that the major sources of bias we examined do not explain the survival advantage associated with higher weight," said corresponding author Yuan Zhang, PhD, assistant professor of Sociomedical Sciences at Columbia Mailman and in the Butler Columbia Aging Center.
paras.zh: “因为这一发现有些违反直觉，所以一个重要的问题是它是否可能只是偏见的产物。我们的分析表明，我们检查的主要偏见来源并不能解释与较高体重相关的生存优势，”通讯作者、哥伦比亚邮曼大学和巴特勒哥伦比亚老龄化中心的社会医学科学助理教授张远博士说。

paras.en: Obesity Linked to Up to 27% Lower Risk of Death
paras.zh: 肥胖可使死亡风险降低 27%

paras.en: The researchers found substantial differences in survival based on body weight at the time of dementia diagnosis. Compared with individuals in the normal weight range, those who were overweight or obese had a significantly lower risk of death, even after the researchers accounted for smoking, existing medical conditions, and demographic characteristics.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，根据痴呆症诊断时的体重，生存率存在显着差异。与正常体重范围内的个体相比，即使研究人员考虑了吸烟、现有医疗状况和人口特征，超重或肥胖者的死亡风险也显着降低。

paras.en: People classified as overweight (body mass index of 25 to 29.9) had a 16 percent lower risk of death. Those with class 1 obesity (BMI of 30 to 34.9) had an even larger reduction of 27 percent, while individuals with class 2 and 3 obesity (BMI equal to or greater than 35) had a 22 percent lower risk.
paras.zh: 超重人群（体重指数为 25 至 29.9）的死亡风险降低 16%。 1 级肥胖者（BMI 为 30 至 34.9）的风险降低幅度更大，达 27%，而 2 级和 3 级肥胖者（BMI 等于或大于 35）的风险降低了 22%。

paras.en: Despite these striking differences, the researchers caution that the findings should not be interpreted as a recommendation for people with dementia to gain weight.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些显着差异，研究人员警告说，这些发现不应被解释为痴呆症患者增加体重的建议。

paras.en: "This doesn't mean that patients with dementia should attempt to become overweight or obese, as our study was not designed to test that question. But our findings do suggest that weight status may serve as a useful prognostic signal for survival at the time of dementia diagnosis. They also support the notion that nutrition is a key factor in the health and survival of people with dementia," said Virginia Chang, associate professor of Social and Behavioral Sciences at NYU School of Global Public Health and the study's first author.
paras.zh: “这并不意味着痴呆症患者应该尝试变得超重或肥胖，因为我们的研究并不是为了测试这个问题。但我们的研究结果确实表明，在痴呆症诊断时，体重状况可能作为生存的有用预后信号。他们还支持这样的观点，即营养是痴呆症患者健康和生存的关键因素，”纽约大学全球公共卫生学院社会和行为科学副教授、该研究的第一作者 Virginia Chang 说。

paras.en: Tracking Weight and Dementia Over 24 Years
paras.zh: 24 年来追踪体重和痴呆症

paras.en: To investigate the connection, Zhang, Chang, and their colleagues examined information from the Health and Retirement Study, a nationally representative research project that follows Americans ages 51 and older.
paras.zh: 为了调查其中的联系，Zhang、Chang 和他们的同事检查了健康与退休研究中的信息，这是一个针对 51 岁及以上美国人的全国代表性研究项目。

paras.en: The team analyzed records collected between 1998 and 2022, focusing on 4,523 participants who did not have dementia when they entered the study but subsequently developed the condition.
paras.zh: 该团队分析了 1998 年至 2022 年间收集的记录，重点关注了 4,523 名参与者，他们在进入研究时并未患有痴呆症，但随后出现了这种情况。

paras.en: Because the data covered such a long period, the researchers could examine how participants' weight changed in the years leading up to their diagnosis. They could also determine their weight when dementia was identified and track their survival afterward.
paras.zh: 由于数据涵盖的时间很长，研究人员可以检查参与者在诊断前几年的体重变化。他们还可以在发现痴呆症时确定自己的体重，并在之后追踪他们的生存情况。

paras.en: This extended timeline was especially important because scientists have questioned whether the apparent benefit of higher body weight is genuine or simply reflects misleading patterns in the data. One possibility is that having additional fat or muscle gives patients resources that help them withstand the physical effects of dementia. Another is that the association arises from factors that earlier studies did not adequately consider.
paras.zh: 这一延长的时间表尤其重要，因为科学家们质疑体重增加的明显好处是否真实，或者只是反映了数据中的误导性模式。一种可能性是，拥有额外的脂肪或肌肉可以为患者提供资源，帮助他们抵御痴呆症的身体影响。另一个原因是这种关联是由早期研究没有充分考虑的因素引起的。

paras.en: Could Weight Loss Explain the Dementia Paradox?
paras.zh: 减肥可以解释痴呆症悖论吗？

paras.en: One major concern involves weight loss that occurs before dementia becomes clinically apparent.
paras.zh: 一个主要问题是在痴呆症临床表现明显之前发生的体重减轻。

paras.en: Earlier research by Zhang and Chang found that people can begin losing weight as much as 10 years before a dementia diagnosis, with the decline becoming more pronounced as the disease approaches.
paras.zh: 张和张的早期研究发现，人们在诊断出痴呆症前 10 年就可以开始减肥，并且随着疾病的临近，体重下降变得更加明显。

paras.en: This creates a potential problem for studies that measure weight only at the time dementia is diagnosed. Some individuals classified as having a normal weight may previously have been heavier and lost weight because of the developing disease. If those individuals are already experiencing more advanced illness, they may face a greater risk of death, making higher body weight appear beneficial by comparison.
paras.zh: 这给仅在诊断出痴呆症时测量体重的研究带来了潜在的问题。一些被归类为体重正常的个体之前可能因患病而体重增加或减轻。如果这些人已经患有更严重的疾病，他们可能面临更大的死亡风险，相比之下，增加体重似乎是有益的。

paras.en: The researchers also considered other possible distortions. Restricting an analysis to people who develop dementia can create misleading relationships between obesity and mortality, even when the underlying connection is more complicated.
paras.zh: 研究人员还考虑了其​​他可能的扭曲。将分析仅限于患有痴呆症的人可能会在肥胖和死亡率之间产生误导性的关系，即使潜在的联系更为复杂。

paras.en: Another concern is known as "survivor" bias. Since people with obesity face an increased risk of dying from certain illnesses before reaching the age when dementia typically develops, those who survive long enough to receive a dementia diagnosis may represent an unusually healthy group.
paras.zh: 另一个问题被称为“幸存者”偏见。由于肥胖症患者在达到痴呆症通常发病年龄之前死于某些疾病的风险会增加，因此那些存活时间足够长以接受痴呆症诊断的人可能代表了一个异常健康的群体。

paras.en: To determine whether these factors explained the findings, the team performed additional analyses designed to evaluate several potential sources of bias. The results indicated that the biases they examined were unlikely to be major drivers of the observed connection between higher weight and lower mortality.
paras.zh: 为了确定这些因素是否解释了研究结果，研究小组进行了额外的分析，旨在评估几种潜在的偏差来源。结果表明，他们检查的偏差不太可能是观察到的较高体重和较低死亡率之间联系的主要驱动因素。

paras.en: Why Extra Weight Might Help People With Dementia
paras.zh: 为什么额外的体重可能有助于痴呆症患者

paras.en: Although the precise explanation remains unknown, the researchers identified several biological reasons why additional body weight could be advantageous for someone already living with dementia.
paras.zh: 尽管确切的解释尚不清楚，但研究人员确定了几个生物学原因，解释了为什么额外的体重可能对已经患有痴呆症的人有利。

paras.en: One possibility involves the body's energy reserves. People with more stored fat or greater muscle mass may be better equipped to withstand periods of poor nutrition and the physical deterioration that can accompany the disease.
paras.zh: 一种可能性涉及身体的能量储备。储存脂肪较多或肌肉量较大的人可能更有能力承受营养不良和疾病带来的身体恶化。

paras.en: Dementia can interfere with eating in several ways. Changes in brain function may reduce appetite or motivation to eat, while some patients experience increased energy needs or gradually lose the ability to feed themselves. Over time, these problems can contribute to significant weight loss, muscle wasting, and declining health.
paras.zh: 痴呆症会通过多种方式干扰饮食。大脑功能的变化可能会降低食欲或进食动力，而一些患者会经历能量需求增加或逐渐丧失进食的能力。随着时间的推移，这些问题会导致体重显着减轻、肌肉萎缩和健康状况恶化。

paras.en: "Nutrition can be a big problem for people with dementia," said Chang. "They may experience wasting and an inability to eat, which can be due to changes in the brain's central drive, leading to loss of appetite and initiative, increased energy expenditure, and difficulties feeding themselves."
paras.zh: “对于痴呆症患者来说，营养可能是一个大问题，”张说。 “他们可能会出现消瘦和无法进食的情况，这可能是由于大脑中枢驱动力的变化导致的，导致食欲和主动性丧失，能量消耗增加以及进食困难。”

paras.en: Having additional energy stores or muscle tissue could potentially help patients cope with these challenges, although the study did not establish that these factors directly explain the survival differences.
paras.zh: 拥有额外的能量储存或肌肉组织可能有助于患者应对这些挑战，尽管该研究并未确定这些因素可以直接解释生存差异。

paras.en: The researchers emphasize that important questions remain unanswered. Even after examining multiple potential biases and identifying plausible biological explanations, they cannot say for certain why overweight and obese participants experienced lower mortality.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，重要的问题仍未得到解答。即使在检查了多种潜在偏差并确定了合理的生物学解释之后，他们也无法确定为什么超重和肥胖的参与者死亡率较低。

paras.en: Nevertheless, Zhang and Chang believe that weight at the time of a dementia diagnosis could provide valuable information about a patient's likely survival. The results also reinforce the importance of recognizing and addressing nutritional problems in people with dementia.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，张和张相信，痴呆症诊断时的体重可以提供有关患者可能生存的宝贵信息。研究结果还强调了认识和解决痴呆症患者营养问题的重要性。

paras.en: Additional study authors include Eleanor Hayes-Larson of the University of Southern California and Hui Zheng of the University of Toronto.
paras.zh: 其他研究作者包括南加州大学的埃莉诺·海耶斯-拉尔森和多伦多大学的郑慧。

paras.en: The research received funding from the National Institutes of Health (grant numbers R00AG070274, R00AG075317).
paras.zh: 该研究获得了美国国立卫生研究院的资助（资助号 R00AG070274、R00AG075317）。

articles.title: Energy drinks linked to 11 times more reports of cardiac arrest

paras.en: Energy drinks linked to 11 times more reports of cardiac arrest
paras.zh: 能量饮料导致心脏骤停的报告增加 11 倍

paras.en: - A new study found that energy drinks and stimulant supplements were linked to disproportionately frequent reports of serious heart problems, including 11 times more reports of cardiac arrest and 4.5 times more reports of heart attacks. Young adults accounted for nearly half of the cardiovascular reports involving these products, raising concerns about their potential risks despite the study being unable to prove causation.
paras.zh: - 一项新的研究发现，能量饮料和兴奋剂补充剂与严重心脏病的报告增加有关，其中心脏骤停的报告增加 11 倍，心脏病发作的报告增加 4.5 倍。涉及这些产品的心血管报告中近一半是年轻人，尽管研究无法证明因果关系，但仍引起人们对其潜在风险的担忧。

paras.en: Energy drinks and stimulant supplements are raising new concerns about heart health after researchers discovered a striking pattern in reports of serious cardiovascular emergencies. Products containing caffeine and other stimulants appeared far more frequently in reports of cardiac arrest, heart attacks, and other heart problems than products without these ingredients.
paras.zh: 研究人员在严重心血管紧急情况的报告中发现了一个惊人的模式后，能量饮料和兴奋剂补充剂引发了人们对心脏健康的新担忧。含有咖啡因和其他兴奋剂的产品在心脏骤停、心脏病发作和其他心脏问题的报告中出现的频率比不含这些成分的产品要高得多。

paras.en: The findings were particularly concerning among younger adults. People ages 18 to 34 accounted for a substantial share of the reported heart problems involving caffeinated products, according to independent, preliminary research presented at the American Heart Association's Scientific Sessions 2026.
paras.zh: 研究结果在年轻人中尤其令人担忧。根据美国心脏协会 2026 年科学会议上发表的独立初步研究，在报告的涉及含咖啡因产品的心脏问题中，18 至 34 岁的人占很大一部分。

paras.en: Researchers emphasized that the findings do not establish that energy drinks or stimulant supplements caused these medical emergencies. However, the unusually high frequency of certain cardiovascular events in FDA safety reports suggests that these widely available products deserve closer examination.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，研究结果并不能证明能量饮料或兴奋剂补充剂导致了这些医疗紧急情况。然而，FDA 安全报告中某些心血管事件的发生频率异常高，表明这些广泛使用的产品值得更仔细的检查。

paras.en: Growing Concerns About Energy Drinks and Heart Health
paras.zh: 人们越来越关注能量饮料和心脏健康

paras.en: The energy drink industry has expanded rapidly, with sales more than doubling over the past decade and exceeding $20 billion in 2024. Despite their popularity, scientists still have limited information about the cardiovascular effects of energy drinks and supplements containing stimulants.
paras.zh: 能量饮料行业发展迅速，过去十年销售额增长了一倍多，到 2024 年将超过 200 亿美元。尽管能量饮料和含有兴奋剂的补充剂很受欢迎，但科学家们对心血管影响的信息仍然有限。

paras.en: Existing evidence suggests that consuming large amounts of caffeine can harm the cardiovascular system. Medical professionals have also documented cases of arrhythmias (irregular heart rhythms) and sudden cardiac death following the consumption of these products. Some of these incidents involved young adults who had no previously identified risk factors for heart disease.
paras.zh: 现有证据表明，摄入大量咖啡因会损害心血管系统。医疗专业人士还记录了食用这些产品后出现心律失常（心律不齐）和心源性猝死的病例。其中一些事件涉及以前没有发现心脏病危险因素的年轻人。

paras.en: A 2026 American Heart Association Scientific Statement on caffeine and cardiovascular disease indicates that most adults can generally consume up to 400 mg of caffeine daily without significant safety concerns (the equivalent of up to 5, 8-ounce cups of regular black caffeinated coffee).
paras.zh: 2026 年美国心脏协会关于咖啡因和心血管疾病的科学声明表明，大多数成年人通常每天可以摄入最多 400 毫克咖啡因，而不会出现重大安全问题（相当于最多 5 杯 8 盎司的普通黑咖啡因咖啡）。

paras.en: However, caffeine concentrations can differ dramatically between products. Certain energy drinks provide up to three times as much caffeine per fluid ounce as brewed coffee, while some pre-workout supplements contain more than 12 times the concentration found in coffee.
paras.zh: 然而，不同产品的咖啡因浓度可能存在巨大差异。某些能量饮料每盎司提供的咖啡因含量是冲泡咖啡的三倍，而一些锻炼前补充剂的咖啡因含量是咖啡的 12 倍以上。

paras.en: Another concern involves how these products are regulated. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) classifies energy drinks and stimulant supplements as foods or dietary supplements rather than medications. As a result, they are not subject to the same safety testing requirements that medications must meet before entering the market.
paras.zh: 另一个问题涉及如何监管这些产品。美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 将能量饮料和兴奋剂补充剂归类为食品或膳食补充剂，而不是药物。因此，它们不需要遵守药物在进入市场之前必须满足的相同安全测试要求。

paras.en: "These products are marketed as everyday pick-me-ups and sold next to soda and bottled water, so most people assume they carry no real risk," said study author Sai Samayamanthula, a fourth-year medical student at the University of Virginia School of Medicine in Charlottesville, Virginia. "For many healthy people, if these products are consumed occasionally, the risk is probably small. However, individuals who consume energy drinks or other stimulant-containing supplements regularly can quickly exceed the recommended daily limit for caffeine, so it's important for people to know that there may be a risk of cardiovascular harm with these products."
paras.zh: 研究作者、弗吉尼亚州夏洛茨维尔弗吉尼亚大学医学院四年级医学生赛·萨玛雅曼图拉 (Sai Samayamanthula) 表示：“这些产品被作为日常提神剂进行销售，与苏打水和瓶装水一起出售，因此大多数人认为它们没有真正的风险。” “对于许多健康人​​来说，如果偶尔食用这些产品，风险可能很小。然而，经常食用能量饮料或其他含有兴奋剂的补充剂的人很快就会超过推荐的咖啡因每日限量，因此人们必须知道这些产品可能存在心血管损害的风险。”

paras.en: FDA Reports Reveal Striking Differences in Cardiac Events
paras.zh: FDA 报告揭示了心脏事件的显着差异

paras.en: To investigate possible cardiovascular safety concerns, researchers examined a federal database containing reports of suspected adverse reactions to foods and dietary supplements. They compared products containing caffeine and other stimulants with products that did not contain these ingredients.
paras.zh: 为了调查可能的心血管安全问题，研究人员检查了一个联邦数据库，其中包含疑似食品和膳食补充剂不良反应的报告。他们将含有咖啡因和其他兴奋剂的产品与不含这些成分的产品进行了比较。

paras.en: The comparison group included commonly consumed products such as soft drinks, smoothies, vitamins, protein bars, and meal replacement shakes. Researchers examined reports involving people ages 13 and older submitted between 2017 and 2025.
paras.zh: 对照组包括常用的消费产品，如软饮料、冰沙、维生素、蛋白棒和代餐奶昔。研究人员审查了 2017 年至 2025 年间提交的涉及 13 岁及以上人群的报告。

paras.en: Several differences stood out in the analysis:
paras.zh: 分析中存在一些差异：

paras.en: - Cardiac arrest: Reports involving caffeine and stimulant products were approximately 11 times more likely to mention cardiac arrest than reports involving products without these ingredients.
paras.zh: - 心脏骤停：涉及咖啡因和兴奋剂产品的报告提及心脏骤停的可能性比涉及不含这些成分的产品的报告高出大约 11 倍。

paras.en: - Heart attacks: Heart attacks appeared about 4.5 times more frequently in reports associated with energy drinks and stimulant supplements.
paras.zh: - 心脏病发作：在与能量饮料和兴奋剂补充剂相关的报告中，心脏病发作的频率大约高出 4.5 倍。

paras.en: - Abnormal heart rhythms: Reports involving stimulant products were roughly four times more likely to include ventricular arrhythmias (abnormal rhythm in the heart's lower pumping chambers) or heart palpitations.
paras.zh: - 心律异常：涉及兴奋剂产品的报告中，出现室性心律失常（心脏下部泵室节律异常）或心悸的可能性大约是其四倍。

paras.en: - Other cardiovascular symptoms: The researchers also identified higher reporting frequencies for rapid heart rate (nearly 3 times more often), chest pain (2.71 times more often) and fainting (about 2 times more often).
paras.zh: - 其他心血管症状：研究人员还发现心率过快（频率增加近 3 倍）、胸痛（频率增加 2.71 倍）和昏厥（频率增加约 2 倍）的报告频率较高。

paras.en: - Young adults: Approximately 45% of cardiovascular event reports involving caffeine and stimulant products concerned adults between ages 18 and 34.
paras.zh: - 年轻人：大约 45% 涉及咖啡因和兴奋剂产品的心血管事件报告涉及 18 岁至 34 岁的成年人。

paras.en: - Men and women: Comparable patterns appeared in reports submitted for both sexes.
paras.zh: - 男性和女性：为两性提交的报告中出现了类似的模式。

paras.en: These differences describe how frequently certain medical problems appeared within the FDA reports. They do not mean that people consuming energy drinks face an 11 times greater actual risk of cardiac arrest or a 4.5 times greater risk of having a heart attack.
paras.zh: 这些差异描述了 FDA 报告中某些医疗问题出现的频率。这并不意味着饮用能量饮料的人面临的心脏骤停的实际风险高出 11 倍，或者心脏病发作的风险高出 4.5 倍。

paras.en: "Our findings support the case for more systematic safety monitoring of caffeine- and stimulant-containing products. In addition, healthcare professionals should remember to ask their younger patients who have palpitations, chest pain, or fainting spells if they recently or regularly consume these products," Samayamanthula said.
paras.zh: “我们的研究结果支持对含有咖啡因和兴奋剂的产品进行更系统的安全监测。此外，医疗保健专业人员应该记得询问有心悸、胸痛或昏厥症状的年轻患者最近或经常食用这些产品，”Samayamanthula 说。

paras.en: Why Young Adults May Be Particularly Vulnerable
paras.zh: 为什么年轻人可能特别脆弱

paras.en: One of the most notable findings was the large proportion of cardiovascular reports involving younger adults. Researchers have not yet determined why the connection between stimulant products and reported heart problems appeared so frequently in this age group.
paras.zh: 最值得注意的发现之一是大部分心血管报告涉及年轻人。研究人员尚未确定为什么兴奋剂产品与报告的心脏问题之间的联系在这个年龄段如此频繁地出现。

paras.en: Several explanations are possible. Younger consumers may use energy drinks and stimulant supplements more often, increasing the likelihood that these products appear in reports of medical emergencies.
paras.zh: 有几种可能的解释。年轻消费者可能更频繁地使用能量饮料和兴奋剂补充剂，从而增加了这些产品出现在医疗紧急情况报告中的可能性。

paras.en: How the products are consumed could also influence the pattern. Potential contributing factors include the circumstances surrounding their use (for example, consuming them before intense exercise or mixing them with alcohol or drugs). Some individuals may also have previously undiagnosed heart conditions that could make them more susceptible to cardiovascular complications.
paras.zh: 产品的消费方式也会影响模式。潜在的影响因素包括其使用环境（例如，在剧烈运动前食用或与酒精或药物混合）。有些人可能还患有以前未诊断的心脏病，这可能使他们更容易出现心血管并发症。

paras.en: These possibilities remain uncertain, and additional research will be needed to determine which factors, if any, help explain the unusually high reporting frequency among younger adults.
paras.zh: 这些可能性仍然不确定，需要进行更多研究来确定哪些因素（如果有的话）有助于解释年轻人中异常高的报告频率。

paras.en: Do Energy Drinks Actually Cause Heart Attacks?
paras.zh: 能量饮料真的会导致心脏病吗？

paras.en: Although the results raise important questions about products containing concentrated caffeine and other stimulants, experts caution against interpreting the findings as proof of a direct cause.
paras.zh: 尽管研究结果对含有浓缩咖啡因和其他兴奋剂的产品提出了重要问题，但专家警告不要将研究结果解释为直接原因的证据。

paras.en: "This study raises concerns that products with very high amounts of caffeine may be harmful to the cardiovascular system," said Gregory M. Marcus, M.D., M.A.S., FAHA, chair of the 2026 American Heart Association scientific statement on caffeine and cardiovascular disease. "Although there are biological reasons why that connection could be possible, the study does not prove that caffeine products cause these events, because other factors may have influenced the results found in this analysis. More research is needed to understand whether these stimulant products are truly responsible for the reported heart-related events."
paras.zh: “这项研究引起了人们的担忧，即咖啡因含量极高的产品可能对心血管系统有害，”2026 年美国心脏协会咖啡因与心血管疾病科学声明主席 Gregory M. Marcus（医学博士、硕士、FAHA）说。 “尽管存在可能存在这种联系的生物学原因，但该研究并没有证明咖啡因产品会导致这些事件，因为其他因素可能影响了本次分析中发现的结果。需要更多的研究来了解这些兴奋剂产品是否真正导致了所报告的心脏相关事件。”

paras.en: Marcus did not participate in the research. He is a professor of medicine at the University of California, San Francisco School of Medicine and serves as associate chief of the Cardiology for Research program at the University of California, San Francisco Health.
paras.zh: 马库斯没有参与这项研究。他是加州大学旧金山分校医学院的医学教授，并担任加州大学旧金山分校健康中心心脏病学研究项目的副主任。

paras.en: Because the analysis relied on reports submitted voluntarily to the FDA, it cannot establish whether the products themselves were responsible for the cardiovascular events. Other health conditions, behaviors, or circumstances may have played a role.
paras.zh: 由于该分析依赖于自愿向 FDA 提交的报告，因此无法确定产品本身是否与心血管事件有关。其他健康状况、行为或环境可能也发挥了作用。

paras.en: How Researchers Analyzed the FDA Safety Reports
paras.zh: 研究人员如何分析 FDA 安全报告

paras.en: The research team reviewed 28,345 reports of possible adverse events submitted to an FDA safety database from 2017 through 2025.
paras.zh: 研究小组审查了 2017 年至 2025 年提交给 FDA 安全数据库的 28,345 份可能不良事件的报告。

paras.en: Of these, 854 reports involved energy drinks or dietary supplements containing caffeine or other stimulants. The remaining 27,491 reports concerned products without caffeine or stimulant ingredients and served as the comparison group.
paras.zh: 其中，854 份报告涉及含有咖啡因或其他兴奋剂的能量饮料或膳食补充剂。其余27,491份报告涉及不含咖啡因或兴奋剂成分的产品，并作为对照组。

paras.en: Researchers classified products according to the ingredients they contained. The stimulant category included caffeine, methylxanthines (theobromine, guarana, yerba mate, green tea/coffee extracts) and sympathomimetics (synephrine, yohimbine, ephedra, DMAA, higenamine).
paras.zh: 研究人员根据产品所含成分对产品进行分类。兴奋剂类别包括咖啡因、甲基黄嘌呤（可可碱、瓜拉那、巴拉圭茶、绿茶/咖啡提取物）和拟交感神经药（辛弗林、育亨宾、麻黄、DMAA、去甲乌药碱）。

paras.en: Rather than evaluating individual brands, the researchers grouped products by their ingredients. Consequently, the findings apply to broad categories of caffeinated and stimulant products and do not identify any particular brand as more dangerous than another.
paras.zh: 研究人员没有评估单个品牌，而是根据产品成分对产品进行分组。因此，研究结果适用于广泛类别的含咖啡因和兴奋剂产品，并且没有发现任何特定品牌比其他品牌更危险。

paras.en: The researchers also highlighted important limitations in the available data. Reports were voluntarily submitted by members of the public, consumers, healthcare professionals, and manufacturers, meaning that the database does not provide a complete record of everyone who experienced a possible adverse reaction.
paras.zh: 研究人员还强调了现有数据的重要局限性。报告是由公众、消费者、医疗保健专业人员和制造商自愿提交的，这意味着该数据库并不能提供每个可能经历不良反应的人的完整记录。

paras.en: Just as importantly, the researchers could not determine how many people consumed these products without developing cardiovascular problems. They also could not establish how many people experienced heart problems but never submitted a report.
paras.zh: 同样重要的是，研究人员无法确定有多少人食用这些产品后不会出现心血管问题。他们也无法确定有多少人经历过心脏病但从未提交报告。

paras.en: Without those figures, the analysis cannot calculate the actual likelihood of a heart attack, cardiac arrest, or another cardiovascular event among consumers of energy drinks and stimulant supplements.
paras.zh: 如果没有这些数据，分析就无法计算能量饮料和兴奋剂补充剂消费者发生心脏病、心脏骤停或其他心血管事件的实际可能性。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the findings reveal a potentially important safety signal. Researchers say more systematic monitoring and further studies are needed to determine whether these products contribute directly to serious heart problems, particularly among younger adults who frequently consume them.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究结果揭示了一个潜在的重要安全信号。研究人员表示，需要进行更系统的监测和进一步的研究，以确定这些产品是否直接导致严重的心脏问题，特别是对于经常食用这些产品的年轻人。

paras.en: Materials provided by American Heart Association. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由美国心脏协会提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: 'There's tremendous demand': Rocket Lab raises price of Neutron launch from $55 million to $70 million
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: The coming launch bottleneck has ramped up demand for a rocket that has yet to leave the ground.
paras.zh: 即将到来的发射瓶颈增加了对尚未离开地面的火箭的需求。

paras.en: Rocket Lab announced on Monday (Nov. 9) that it recently raised the price of a Neutron launch from $55 million to $70 million — an increase of more than 25%, for a ride on a rocket that's set to debut in 2027.
paras.zh: Rocket Lab 周一（11 月 9 日）宣布，最近将中子发射的价格从 5500 万美元提高到 7000 万美元，涨幅超过 25%，火箭将于 2027 年首次亮相。

paras.en: "Launch is extremely constrained, and that is exactly the situation we predicted," Rocket Lab founder and CEO Peter Beck said on Monday during the company's third-quarter earnings call. "We saw a pent-up launch market on the horizon, and rather than provide early discounted launches, we set out to deliver a rocket into an environment with extreme demand at full price or higher."
paras.zh: Rocket Lab 创始人兼首席执行官 Peter Beck 周一在公司第三季度财报电话会议上表示：“发射受到极大限制，这正是我们所预测的情况。” “我们看到了一个被压抑的发射市场即将出现，我们不是提供早期的折扣发射，而是着手以全价或更高价格将火箭运送到需求极端的环境中。”

paras.en: Rocket Lab is best known for Electron, a workhorse small-satellite launcher that debuted in 2017 and now has 90 orbital missions under its belt. The 59-foot-tall (18 meters) expendable rocket and can haul 660 pounds (300 kilograms) to low Earth orbit (LEO).
paras.zh: Rocket Lab 最出名的是 Electron，这是一款主力小型卫星发射器，于 2017 年首次亮相，目前已完成 90 次轨道任务。这枚高 59 英尺（18 米）的消耗性火箭可将 660 磅（300 公斤）的重物运送到近地轨道 (LEO)。

paras.en: Neutron is the company's entry into the medium-lift market. It features a reusable first stage, stands 141 feet (43 m) tall and can carry 14.3 tons (13 metric tons) of payload to LEO.
paras.zh: Neutron 是该公司进入中升力市场的切入点。它具有可重复使用的第一级，高 141 英尺（43 m），可向近地轨道运载 14.3 吨（13 公吨）的有效载荷。

paras.en: Rocket Lab announced Neutron back in 2021 and first targeted a 2024 debut for the vehicle. But various problems have cropped up over the years, pushing things back. Last month, for example, Rocket Lab announced that it was delaying the first Neutron flight from late 2026 into 2027 due to a manufacturing issue (which it says is now under control).
paras.zh: Rocket Lab 早在 2021 年就宣布推出 Neutron，并最初计划在 2024 年首次亮相。但这些年来出现了各种问题，使事情倒退。例如，上个月，火箭实验室宣布，由于制造问题（据称目前已得到控制），将首次 Neutron 飞行从 2026 年底推迟到 2027 年。

paras.en: Such setbacks have not dampened demand for Neutron's services, however. During Monday's call, Beck revealed that Rocket Lab booked eight Neutron launches during the third quarter of 2026, which ran from July 1 through Sept. 30.
paras.zh: 然而，此类挫折并没有抑制对 Neutron 服务的需求。在周一的电话会议上，贝克透露，火箭实验室预定了 2026 年第三季度（从 7 月 1 日到 9 月 30 日）的 8 次 Neutron 发射。

paras.en: The contracts for those eight flights are worth "a total of roughly 515 million, including multiple missions on a new escalated base price of $70 million," Beck said. Neutron's first 16 launches are now sold out, he added, and bookings from here on will be for flights in the 2030s.
paras.zh: 贝克说，这八次航班的合同价值“总计约 5.15 亿美元，其中包括多次飞行任务，新的基本价格为 7000 万美元”。他补充说，Neutron 的前 16 次发射现已售罄，从这里开始的预订将针对 2030 年代的航班。

paras.en: "The demand is a function of both a tightening global launch supply and our customers' confidence that Rocket Lab is the right partner to break the world's launch bottleneck," Beck said.
paras.zh: 贝克说：“这一需求既是全球发射供应紧张的结果，也是我们客户对火箭实验室是打破世界发射瓶颈的正确合作伙伴的信心的结果。”

paras.en: That bottleneck is coming in 2028 or so, when SpaceX plans to retire its Falcon 9 rocket. For some perspective, and comparison with Neutron: SpaceX currently charges $74 million for each Falcon 9 launch. The rocket has a reusable first stage and can carry about 25 tons (22.7 metric tons) to LEO.
paras.zh: 这个瓶颈将在 2028 年左右出现，届时 SpaceX 计划退役其猎鹰 9 号火箭。从某些角度来看，并与 Neutron 进行比较：SpaceX 目前每次 Falcon 9 发射的费用为 7400 万美元。该火箭具有可重复使用的第一级，可携带约 25 吨（22.7 公吨）的物体前往近地轨道。

paras.en: The medium lifter has been the world's most prolific rocket for the past few years. In 2025, for example, it flew 165 times — roughly the same number of orbital missions as all other launchers in the world combined. And all 165 of those flights were successful.
paras.zh: 在过去的几年里，中型运载火箭一直是世界上最多产的火箭。例如，到 2025 年，它飞行了 165 次——与世界上所有其他发射器的轨道任务次数大致相同。这 165 次飞行全部成功。

paras.en: But SpaceX is phasing out the Falcon 9 — and its heavy-lift cousin, the Falcon Heavy — nonetheless, shifting all launch work over to its fully reusable Starship megarocket, which can haul more than 100 tons to LEO.
paras.zh: 但 SpaceX 正在逐步淘汰 Falcon 9 及其重型猎鹰重型火箭，将所有发射工作转移到其完全可重复使用的 Starship 巨型火箭上，该火箭可以将超过 100 吨的货物运送到近地轨道。

paras.en: There's a real worry among folks in the space community that this massive payload capacity won't be available to them for a while. SpaceX has made it pretty clear that early Starship operations will be geared toward internal priorities — specifically, the buildout of SpaceX's Starlink V3 broadband network and its Starmind AI data-center constellation.
paras.zh: 太空界的人们真正担心的是，他们暂时无法使用如此巨大的有效载荷能力。 SpaceX 已经明确表示，早期的 Starship 运营将面向内部优先事项，特别是 SpaceX 的 Starlink V3 宽带网络及其 Starmind AI 数据中心星座的建设。

paras.en: These will be very big jobs, even for the most powerful rocket ever built. For example, the Starlink V3 megaconstellation will consist of about 100,000 satellites, according to SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk. Starship can carry about 60 of these spacecraft to LEO per launch, so just building out the constellation will require about 1,700 liftoffs.
paras.zh: 即使对于有史以来最强大的火箭来说，这些工作也将是非常艰巨的。例如，SpaceX 创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 表示，Starlink V3 巨型星座将由约 10 万颗卫星组成。星舰每次发射可携带约 60 艘此类航天器前往近地轨道，因此仅建造该星座就需要约 1,700 次升空。

paras.en: The numbers for Starmind will be even more mind-boggling, for SpaceX wants that constellation to eventually harbor a million satellites.
paras.zh: Starmind 的数字将更加令人难以置信，因为 SpaceX 希望该星座最终拥有 100 万颗卫星。

paras.en: The coming launch bottleneck should increase demand for Electron as well as Neutron, Beck said during Monday's call. After all, many small-satellite operators have launched with SpaceX over the years, booking spots on Falcon 9 "rideshare" flights. And those opportunities are now drying up.
paras.zh: 贝克在周一的电话会议上表示，即将到来的发射瓶颈应该会增加对 Electron 和 Neutron 的需求。毕竟，多年来，许多小型卫星运营商都与 SpaceX 合作发射，预订了猎鹰 9 号“拼车”航班的座位。而这些机会现在正在枯竭。

paras.en: "The next logical alternative is of course an Electron, so we see tremendous traction there," Beck said.
paras.zh: “下一个合乎逻辑的选择当然是 Electron，所以我们看到了那里巨大的吸引力，”贝克说。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: Did comets bring building blocks of life to Earth? Scientists aren't so sure anymore
articles.author: Keith Cooper

paras.en: The origin of life on Earth remains a mystery. New research shows that comets almost certainly did not bring the chemical building blocks of life to our planet.
paras.zh: 地球上生命的起源仍然是个谜。新的研究表明，几乎可以肯定彗星没有给我们的星球带来生命的化学组成部分。

paras.en: Life as we know it is based around carbon chemistry, also known as organic chemistry. Complex organic molecules are the fundamental building blocks of biochemical compounds such as nucleobases, amino acids, sugars and so on that act as the machinery for biochemistry on Earth.
paras.zh: 我们所知道的生命是基于碳化学，也称为有机化学。复杂的有机分子是核碱基、氨基酸、糖等生化化合物的基本组成部分，它们是地球上生物化学的机制。

paras.en: Two big questions are where did this complex chemistry originate? Did these complex organic molecules form on Earth, or were they delivered here from space?
paras.zh: 两个大问题是这种复杂的化学反应从何而来？这些复杂的有机分子是在地球上形成的，还是从太空传送到这里的？

paras.en: New research led by planetary scientist Richard Anslow of the Institute for Astronomy at the University of Cambridge has now seemingly ruled out comets as the origin of complex organic molecules on Earth.
paras.zh: 剑桥大学天文学研究所的行星科学家理查德·安斯洛领导的新研究现在似乎排除了彗星是地球上复杂有机分子的起源。

paras.en: "Historically, scientists thought that comets were important for the origin of life on Earth, because they carried carbon and nitrogen-bearing molecules, so these giant space snowballs were almost like a 'get-out-of-jail-free card' that brought all the molecules a planet would need to seed life," said Anslow in a statement.
paras.zh: 安斯洛在一份声明中说：“从历史上看，科学家们认为彗星对于地球生命的起源很重要，因为它们携带着碳和氮分子，因此这些巨大的太空雪球几乎就像一张‘免狱卡’，带来了行星孕育生命所需的所有分子。”

paras.en: Stripping the romance from the Earth's turbulent past
paras.zh: 从地球动荡的过去中剥离浪漫

paras.en: Comet impacts on Earth were much more frequent in the first half-billion years of the solar system’s existence, when there were still lots of debris leftover from the formation of the planets.
paras.zh: 在太阳系存在的前五亿年里，彗星对地球的撞击要频繁得多，当时仍然有大量行星形成过程中留下的碎片。

paras.en: For over a century comet impacts had been considered a prime suspect in the search for what brought the building blocks of life to Earth. However, while comets bringing the building blocks of life to Earth is "kind of a romantic idea," according to Anslow, the University of Cambridge researcher added that the team's results suggest that is highly unlikely.
paras.zh: 一个多世纪以来，彗星撞击一直被认为是寻找生命构成要素来到地球的主要嫌疑人。然而，根据安斯洛的说法，虽然彗星将生命的组成部分带到地球是“一种浪漫的想法”，但剑桥大学的研究人员补充说，该团队的研究结果表明这种可能性极小。

paras.en: Anslow and colleagues arrived at this conclusion based upon computer modeling by using the very latest simulations depicting the origin and evolution of comets and their orbits, their interactions with Earth's atmosphere as they enter it, and of the hypervelocity comet impacts themselves.
paras.zh: 安斯洛和同事基于计算机建模得出了这一结论，他们使用最新的模拟来描述彗星及其轨道的起源和演化、它们进入地球大气层时与地球大气层的相互作用，以及超高速彗星自身的撞击。

paras.en: In particular, they used the fate of hydrogen cyanide as a proxy for what happens to complex organic molecules in comet impacts. Hydrogen cyanide is frequently found in comets and was even detected in the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS.
paras.zh: 特别是，他们用氰化氢的命运作为复杂有机分子在彗星撞击中发生的情况的代理。氰化氢经常在彗星中发现，甚至在星际彗星 3I/ATLAS 中也被检测到。

paras.en: The problem is that comets are generally moving at too great a velocity. For organic molecules to survive impact, the impact velocity would have to be below 33,500 miles per hour (15 kilometers per second).
paras.zh: 问题是彗星通常以太大的速度移动。为了使有机分子能够在撞击中幸存下来，撞击速度必须低于每小时 33,500 英里（每秒 15 公里）。

paras.en: Anslow and his colleagues found that, in general, comets travel too fast and enter Earth’s atmosphere at too sharp an angle for complex organic molecules to survive. Instead, they are mostly vaporized on impact. Even on the rare occasions that the complex organic molecules survived, they were usually not in great enough abundance to provide any meaningful prebiotic chemistry.
paras.zh: 安斯洛和他的同事发现，一般来说，彗星运行速度太快，并且以太尖锐的角度进入地球大气层，复杂的有机分子无法生存。相反，它们大部分在撞击时蒸发。即使在极少数情况下，复杂的有机分子幸存下来，它们的丰度通常不足以提供任何有意义的生命前化学。

paras.en: "It would really have to be a one-in-a-million occurrence, because not only would you need an impact at just the right speed and just the right angle, you would also need everything to happen after that point, in terms of the concentration and the speed at which the chemical origins of life got going," said Anslow. "We can’t rule out for certain that it happened that way, but it seems to be a really rare occurrence – at best, a one-off fluke."
paras.zh: 安斯洛说：“这确实必须是百万分之一的发生，因为你不仅需要以正确的速度和正确的角度进行撞击，还需要在那之后发生一切，就生命化学起源发生的浓度和速度而言。” “我们不能肯定地排除这种情况发生的可能性，但这似乎是一种非常罕见的情况——充其量只是一次性的侥幸。”

paras.en: It is not yet known if the origin of life on Earth was a fluke, or whether life is plentiful in the universe, so a fluke occurrence could still have been a trigger for life on our planet.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚地球上生命的起源是否是侥幸，或者宇宙中是否存在丰富的生命，因此侥幸的发生仍然可能是我们星球上生命的触发因素。

paras.en: However, researchers are coming around to alternatives, either that all the pre-biotic chemistry that resulted in life took place on Earth without requiring material from space, or asteroids instead brought those important molecules to Earth.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人员正在寻找替代方案，要么所有产生生命的前生物化学反应都发生在地球上，不需要来自太空的物质，要么小行星将这些重要的分子带到了地球。

paras.en: Scientists have found asteroids to be rich in those molecules – for example, the sample of material brought back by the OSIRIS-REx mission from the near-Earth asteroid Bennu contained all the building blocks of RNA.
paras.zh: 科学家们发现小行星富含这些分子——例如，OSIRIS-REx 任务从小行星 Bennu 带回的物质样本就包含了 RNA 的所有组成部分。

paras.en: However, other planets could have plausibly benefitted from comet impacts. The simulations showed that complex organic molecules in comets would stand a slightly better chance of surviving impacts on Mars, because of the Red Planet’s thinner atmosphere and lower gravity.
paras.zh: 然而，其他行星也可能从彗星撞击中受益。模拟结果表明，由于火星大气层较薄且重力较低，彗星中的复杂有机分子在撞击火星时幸存下来的机会稍大一些。

paras.en: "This is not to say it definitely happened on Mars, of course, but it suggests it would be unlikely if it happened on Earth and didn’t happen on Mars," said Anslow. "Or the other, perhaps more likely, alternative is that it didn’t happen on either planet."
paras.zh: 安斯洛说：“当然，这并不是说它肯定发生在火星上，但它表明如果它发生在地球上并且没有发生在火星上，它就不太可能发生。” “或者另一种可能性更大的选择是，这件事在任何一个星球上都没有发生。”

paras.en: More intriguing are the possibilities on exoplanets, specifically the peas-in-a-pod multi-planet systems around red dwarf stars such as TRAPPIST-1, where all the planets are bunched up close.
paras.zh: 更有趣的是系外行星上的可能性，特别是红矮星周围的豌豆荚多行星系统，例如 TRAPPIST-1，其中所有行星都紧密地聚集在一起。

paras.en: In 2023 Anslow wrote a research paper describing how comets could gravitationally bounce from one planet to the next, losing velocity in the process so that when they crash into one of the planets, they impact is not so severe and complex organic molecules might have a chance to survive.
paras.zh: 2023 年，安斯洛写了一篇研究论文，描述了彗星如何通过引力从一颗行星弹回另一颗行星，并在此过程中失去速度，这样当它们撞击其中一颗行星时，它们的撞击就不会那么严重，复杂的有机分子可能有机会生存。

paras.en: The team's research was published on 28 October in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究成果于 10 月 28 日发表在《科学报告》上。

paras.en: Keith Cooper is a freelance science journalist and editor in the United Kingdom, and has a degree in physics and astrophysics from the University of Manchester. He's the author of "The Contact Paradox: Challenging Our Assumptions in the Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence" (Bloomsbury Sigma, 2020) and has written articles on astronomy, space, physics and astrobiology for a multitude of magazines and websites.
paras.zh: 基思·库珀 (Keith Cooper) 是英国自由科学记者和编辑，拥有曼彻斯特大学物理学和天体物理学学位。他是《接触悖论：在寻找外星智慧生命中挑战我们的假设》（Bloomsbury Sigma，2020 年）一书的作者，并为众多杂志和网站撰写了有关天文学、太空、物理学和天体生物学的文章。

articles.title: Andy Weir's 'Exoplanet' just landed on Audible, but what actually makes an exoplanet habitable?
articles.author: Alix Freckelton

paras.en: Imagine you’ve crash-landed on an alien planet. Your ship is destroyed, your oxygen supply is dangerously low, and the landscape around you is completely unknown. Where would you begin looking for clues to your survival? Surprisingly, the best place to start could be the star overhead.
paras.zh: 想象一下你迫降在一个外星球上。你的船被毁了，你的氧气供应严重不足，你周围的景观完全未知。你会从哪里开始寻找生存的线索？令人惊讶的是，最好的起点可能是头顶上的星星。

paras.en: This is the predicament that three crew members of the Wild Blue Yonder face in Audible’s new sci-fi thriller, "Exoplanet." This sci-fi thriller is written by acclaimed comic writer Benjamin Percy, executive produced by Andy Weir (Project Hail Mary, The Martian), and features an all-star voice cast including Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose, and John Leguizamo.
paras.zh: 这就是 Audible 的新科幻惊悚片《系外行星》中“野蓝那边”的三名船员所面临的困境。这部科幻惊悚片由著名漫画作家本杰明·珀西撰写，由安迪·威尔（《万福玛丽计划》、《火星救援》）担任监制，并拥有包括安东尼·麦凯、阿丽亚娜·德博斯和约翰·雷吉扎莫在内的全明星配音阵容。

paras.en: Stranded on an unfamiliar planet, they encounter volcanic wastelands, unknown skies, and environments that seem to defy reason. But behind the extraordinary events of this audio drama is a very real scientific question: what makes a planet habitable?
paras.zh: 他们被困在一个陌生的星球上，遇到了火山荒原、未知的天空和似乎违背理性的环境。但这部音频剧的非凡事件背后隐藏着一个非常现实的科学问题：是什么让行星适合居住？

paras.en: In “Exoplanet”, the crew view skies that are not only unfamiliar but also seemingly different from one another. One character sees a sun as so dim that he can look directly at it, while another suffers under a blazing heat, surrounded by stretches of sun-scorched red rock.
paras.zh: 在《系外行星》中，船员们看到的天空不仅陌生，而且看起来彼此不同。一个角色看到的太阳是如此暗淡，以至于他可以直视它，而另一个角色则在炎热的天气下受苦，周围是大片被阳光烤焦的红色岩石。

paras.en: For astronomers, the light emitted by a star is one of the most crucial tools for understanding planets orbiting it.
paras.zh: 对于天文学家来说，恒星发出的光是了解绕其运行的行星最重要的工具之一。

paras.en: Using a technique called spectroscopy, astronomers split starlight into its constituent wavelengths, producing a spectrum much like a rainbow. By studying this spectrum, they can investigate the temperature, composition, and other physical properties of the star.
paras.zh: 天文学家使用光谱学技术将星光分解为其组成波长，产生类似于彩虹的光谱。通过研究这个光谱，他们可以研究恒星的温度、成分和其他物理特性。

paras.en: However, stellar temperature is only part of the picture. The amount of energy a planet receives depends on both the luminosity of the star and its orbital distance.
paras.zh: 然而，恒星温度只是图片的一部分。行星接收的能量取决于恒星的光度及其轨道距离。

paras.en: Astronomers use these measurements to determine whether a world lies in the habitable zone of a star, where temperatures could allow liquid water to exist on the surface given a suitable atmosphere.
paras.zh: 天文学家利用这些测量结果来确定一个世界是否位于恒星的宜居带，在适当的大气条件下，该区域的温度可能允许液态水存在于表面。

paras.en: A planet orbiting a cool red dwarf would need to be much closer to its star than Earth is to the Sun to be in this habitable zone. Unfortunately, being in this zone is no guarantee of a planetary paradise.
paras.zh: 一颗围绕冷红矮星运行的行星与恒星的距离需要比地球与太阳的距离要近得多，才能进入这个宜居带。不幸的是，处于这个区域并不能保证成为地球天堂。

paras.en: A planet that sits comfortably in the habitable zone is ultimately still at the mercy of its star. Stars emit more than just the light we see. Ultraviolet radiation and X-rays can interact with planetary atmospheres, altering chemistry and even contributing to the loss of the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 一颗舒适地位于宜居带的行星最终仍受其恒星的支配。恒星发出的不仅仅是我们看到的光。紫外线辐射和 X 射线可以与行星大气层相互作用，改变化学性质，甚至导致大气层的损失。

paras.en: Violent stellar flares can produce bursts of high-energy radiation. A planet could offer a wonderfully balmy temperature, only to be bombarded with radiation from the host star.
paras.zh: 剧烈的恒星耀斑会产生高能辐射爆发。一颗行星可以提供极其宜人的温度，但却会受到来自主恒星的辐射的轰击。

paras.en: The age of a star matters too. Young stars tend to be more active, with radiation that could erode a planet’s atmosphere over time. Meanwhile, as stars age and evolve, their changing luminosities can drastically alter the conditions a planet experiences.
paras.zh: 明星的年龄也很重要。年轻的恒星往往更加活跃，随着时间的推移，其辐射可能会侵蚀行星的大气层。与此同时，随着恒星的老化和演化，它们不断变化的光度会极大地改变行星所经历的条件。

paras.en: For the stranded crew in “Exoplanet”, understanding the star overhead may therefore be as important as knowing the landscape beneath their feet.
paras.zh: 因此，对于《系外行星》中被困的船员来说，了解头顶上的恒星可能与了解他们脚下的景观一样重要。

paras.en: Even if a planet has survived all the complications we’ve just thrown at it, there’s still a rather important question: could we actually breathe the air?
paras.zh: 即使一颗行星经受住了我们刚刚给它带来的所有复杂问题，仍然存在一个相当重要的问题：我们真的可以呼吸空气吗？

paras.en: In "Exoplanet", one crew member discovers that the planet’s atmosphere contains enough oxygen for him to breathe without his spacesuit. On Earth, oxygen makes up around 21% of our atmosphere. However, finding a similar percentage on another planet wouldn’t automatically mean the air is safe to breathe.
paras.zh: 在《系外行星》中，一名船员发现行星的大气层中含有足够的氧气，让他无需穿着宇航服即可呼吸。在地球上，氧气约占大气层的 21%。然而，在另一个星球上发现类似的百分比并不意味着空气可以安全呼吸。

paras.en: Atmospheric pressure matters just as much. At high altitudes on Earth, the oxygen percentage remains the same, but the lower pressure means less oxygen is available to our lungs.
paras.zh: 大气压同样重要。在地球的高海拔地区，氧气百分比保持不变，但较低的压力意味着我们肺部可获得的氧气较少。

paras.en: Oxygen isn’t the only concern, either. The fictional planet’s volcanic landscape releases gases such as sulfur dioxide and hydrogen sulfide, both of which are hazardous at high concentrations. Even an oxygen-rich atmosphere could still be lethal.
paras.zh: 氧气也不是唯一的问题。这颗虚构星球的火山景观释放出二氧化硫和硫化氢等气体，这两种气体在高浓度下都是危险的。即使富含氧气的大气仍然可能致命。

paras.en: But what if you don't just need to know if a planet is habitable? What if you need to know if something already lives there?
paras.zh: 但如果您不仅仅需要知道一颗行星是否适合居住怎么办？如果您需要知道那里是否已经存在某些东西该怎么办？

paras.en: Before the Wild Blue Yonder arrived at the planet, probes detected dimethyl sulfide, a molecule we associate with biological activity on Earth. This is a beautifully timely detail, as this very molecule has been at the heart of a scientific debate about one of the most intriguing exoplanets discovered so far.
paras.zh: 在野蓝那边到达地球之前，探测器检测到了二甲硫醚，我们将这种分子与地球上的生物活动联系在一起。这是一个非常及时的细节，因为这种分子一直是关于迄今为止发现的最有趣的系外行星之一的科学辩论的核心。

paras.en: Astronomers have investigated possible signs of dimethyl sulfide in the atmosphere of K2-18 b, an exoplanet orbiting a red dwarf. However, both the detection itself and the biological interpretation remain heavily disputed.
paras.zh: 天文学家研究了围绕红矮星运行的系外行星 K2-18 b 大气中可能存在二甲硫醚的迹象。然而，检测本身和生物学解释仍然存在很大争议。

paras.en: The challenge is that detecting a single molecule isn’t definitive evidence of life. Its presence can be influenced by factors other than biology, like atmospheric chemistry and stellar radiation.
paras.zh: 挑战在于检测单个分子并不能确定生命存在的证据。它的存在可能受到生物学以外的因素的影响，例如大气化学和恒星辐射。

paras.en: Understanding whether such a molecule could actually indicate life means studying not just the planet’s atmosphere, but also the radiation it receives from its star.
paras.zh: 了解这样的分子是否真的可以表明生命意味着不仅要研究行星的大气层，还要研究它从恒星接收到的辐射。

paras.en: Astronomers have discovered thousands of exoplanets. Understanding whether any could support life is, however, an extraordinary challenge.
paras.zh: 天文学家已经发现了数千颗系外行星。然而，了解是否有任何物质可以支持生命是一项非凡的挑战。

paras.en: The distance between the planet and the star might give us a good clue, but its atmosphere, geology, and stellar environment are all interconnected in determining whether life could survive. For the unfortunate crew of the Wild Blue Yonder, those distinctions could mean the difference between survival and utter disaster.
paras.zh: 行星和恒星之间的距离可能会给我们提供一个很好的线索，但它的大气层、地质和恒星环境在决定生命是否能够生存时都是相互关联的。对于“野蓝那边”号上不幸的船员来说，这些区别可能意味着生存与彻底灾难之间的区别。

paras.en: We might one day identify a planet with Earth-like temperatures, liquid water, and abundant oxygen. But even then, there’s still a huge gap dividing a potentially habitable planet from one where we could safely remove our helmets.
paras.zh: 有一天，我们可能会发现一颗拥有与地球相似的温度、液态水和丰富氧气的行星。但即便如此，潜在宜居行星与我们可以安全摘下头盔的行星之间仍然存在巨大差距。

paras.en: "Exoplanet" is available now exclusively from Audible. It is free for members of its subscription tiers or available to purchase separately.
paras.zh: 《Exoplanet》现已由 Audible 独家发售。它对其订阅级别的会员免费，也可以单独购买。

paras.en: One crew. One planet. Three timelines. No one survives alone. A sci-fi thriller executive produced by Andy Weir (#1 bestselling author of Project Hail Mary, The Martian), with an all-star cast led by Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose and John Leguizamo.
paras.zh: 一名船员。一颗行星。三个时间线。没有人能够独自生存。这部科幻惊悚片由安迪·威尔（《万福玛丽计划》、《火星救援》畅销书作者）监制，演员阵容由安东尼·麦基、阿丽亚娜·德博斯和约翰·雷吉扎莫领衔。

paras.en: Exoplanet is free for Audible members, but also available for purchase separately.
paras.zh: Exoplanet 对 Audible 会员免费，但也可以单独购买。

paras.en: Alix is an astrophysicist at the University of Birmingham specialising in the characterisation of stars and exoplanets. She is passionate about science communication, and how astrophysics is portrayed in movies, TV, and pop culture at large.
paras.zh: 阿利克斯是伯明翰大学的天体物理学家，专门研究恒星和系外行星的特征。她热衷于科学传播，以及如何在电影、电视和流行文化中描绘天体物理学。
