articles.title: Former ESPN star Sean Salisbury says political arguments wore out fans who just wanted sports

paras.en: Sean Salisbury thinks ESPN lost sight of the person coming home after a long day at work who just wanted to watch some sports. That viewer wanted highlights and a few laughs. Instead, Salisbury said, too much of the programming became another argument about politics.
paras.zh: 肖恩·索尔兹伯里 (Sean Salisbury) 认为 ESPN 忽视了那些在工作一整天后回家只想看一些体育比赛的人。那位观众想要亮点和一些笑声。相反，索尔兹伯里说，太多的节目变成了关于政治的另一个争论。

paras.en: "If I want that, I'll get it on a different channel," he told OutKick.
paras.zh: “如果我想要的话，我会在不同的频道上播放，”他告诉 OutKick。

paras.en: I spoke with the former NFL quarterback and ESPN analyst in October about the network where we both worked. Salisbury spent 12 years there, leaving in 2008. I arrived in 2012 and stayed until 2021.
paras.zh: 10 月份，我与这位前 NFL 四分卫和 ESPN 分析师谈论了我们共同工作的电视台。索尔兹伯里在那里度过了 12 年，于 2008 年离开。我于 2012 年抵达，一直待到 2021 年。

paras.en: To me, ESPN was at its best in the early 2000s. Salisbury was part of that, along with the people who made you want to watch a studio show even when you already knew what happened in the games.
paras.zh: 对我来说，ESPN 在 2000 年代初处于鼎盛时期。索尔兹伯里就是其中的一部分，还有那些让你想观看演播室表演的人，即使你已经知道比赛中发生了什么。

paras.en: "It was sports first with entertainment personalities," Salisbury said.
paras.zh: “这首先是娱乐界人士的体育运动，”索尔兹伯里说。

paras.en: He remembered watching the same edition of SportsCenter several times because he enjoyed the people delivering the highlights.
paras.zh: 他记得看过同一期《体育中心》好几次，因为他喜欢人们提供的精彩片段。

paras.en: Salisbury says ESPN got caught up chasing reactions
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里称 ESPN 陷入了追逐反应的境地

paras.en: Salisbury's father was a blue-collar worker, and that shaped how he thought about the people watching him on television. Someone who had spent all day working construction probably wanted to sit down and enjoy a game or some highlights.
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里的父亲是一名蓝领工人，这塑造了他对电视上观看他的人们的看法。花了一整天时间从事建筑工作的人可能想坐下来享受一场游戏或一些精彩片段。

paras.en: Salisbury believes ESPN made that harder by letting political and social arguments take up too much of its programming.
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里认为，ESPN 让政治和社会争论占据了其节目的过多部分，从而让事情变得更加困难。

paras.en: "We really weren't concerned with what the color of the skin of the quarterback was because we were just talking football," he said of his years at the network.
paras.zh: “我们真的并不关心四分卫的肤色，因为我们只是在谈论足球，”他谈到自己在电视台的岁月时说道。

paras.en: He also blamed the pressure to generate a reaction on social media. In his view, talking about the sports news increasingly gave way to trying to become the sports news, with arguments designed to get people sharing clips.
paras.zh: 他还指责社交媒体上产生反应的压力。在他看来，谈论体育新闻越来越多地让位于试图成为体育新闻，其争论旨在让人们分享视频片段。

paras.en: I think that's a big part of it. Once getting a reaction becomes the goal, there's always a reason to make the next argument more outlandish and controversial. Eventually, the viewer who wanted to hear about his team has to sit through a debate about something an analyst said on another show.
paras.zh: 我认为这是其中很大一部分。一旦获得反应成为目标，总有理由让下一个论点变得更加古怪和有争议。最终，想要了解他的团队的观众必须坐下来就分析师在另一档节目中所说的话进行辩论。

paras.en: Salisbury acknowledged that politics and sports overlap, and he said those subjects deserve coverage when they're relevant. His complaint was about how much of the programming those discussions consumed.
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里承认政治和体育有重叠，他说这些主题相关时值得报道。他抱怨的是这些讨论消耗了多少编程时间。

paras.en: "That should be the outlier, not the every single day grind," he said.
paras.zh: “这应该是异常值，而不是每天的苦差事，”他说。

paras.en: Our conversation started with the argument over Emmanuel Acho's comments about NFL Live. In July, Acho credited Ryan Clark with building the show into a "juggernaut." He acknowledged that Clark hadn't created it, but dismissed its earlier audience by claiming "nobody was watching NFL Live then."
paras.zh: 我们的谈话始于 Emmanuel Acho 对 NFL Live 评论的争论。 7 月，阿乔称赞瑞安·克拉克 (Ryan Clark) 将这部剧打造成“主宰者”。他承认克拉克没有创造它，但驳回了它的早期观众，声称“当时没有人在观看 NFL 直播”。

paras.en: As I pointed out on social media, that's false. NFL Live averaged around 650,000 daily viewers in 2011 and 2012, before Clark was even hired by ESPN. The version featuring Clark never averaged an audience that size.
paras.zh: 正如我在社交媒体上指出的那样，这是错误的。在克拉克被 ESPN 聘用之前，2011 年和 2012 年 NFL Live 的平均每日观众人数约为 65 万。克拉克主演的版本从未有过如此规模的平均观众人数。

paras.en: Salisbury and former host Trey Wingo both weighed in on social media, as well. Wingo wrote, "'Let your apology be as loud as your disrespect.' I think somebody said that once."
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里和前主持人特雷·温戈也在社交媒体上发表了看法。温戈写道：“‘让你的道歉和你的不尊重一样响亮。’”我想有人曾经说过这样的话。”

paras.en: Salisbury posted, "Should one of us tell him" and tagged NFL Live alums Wingo, Mark Schlereth, Mike Golic, Merril Hoge, and Mark Malone.
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里发布了一条“我们应该有人告诉他吗”的帖子，并标记了 NFL Live 校友 Wingo、Mark Schlereth、Mike Golic、Merril Hoge 和 Mark Malone。

paras.en: "Acho was about two decades late to the party on that one, so no shock there," he told me.
paras.zh: “阿乔在那次聚会上迟到了大约二十年，所以这并不令人震惊，”他告诉我。

paras.en: He compared overlooking the original group to talking about Led Zeppelin without Jimmy Page. Other people could come along and do good work, but that didn't erase what the earlier crew had built.
paras.zh: 他将俯瞰原来的乐队比作在没有吉米·佩奇的情况下谈论齐柏林飞艇。其他人可以加入并做好工作，但这并没有抹去早期团队所建造的东西。

paras.en: And Salisbury's memories of that period went well beyond wanting credit for NFL Live. He talked about learning from broadcasters whose personalities made the shows worth watching, particularly Dan Patrick, Chris Berman and Mike Tirico.
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里对那段时期的记忆远远超出了《NFL Live》的功劳。他谈到向那些个性使节目值得观看的广播公司学习，特别是丹·帕特里克、克里斯·伯曼和迈克·蒂里科。

paras.en: That's the ESPN he wants people to be able to turn on again.
paras.zh: 他希望人们能够再次观看 ESPN。

paras.en: I watched the way people talked about ESPN change
paras.zh: 我看到人们谈论 ESPN 的方式发生了变化

paras.en: When I got hired at ESPN in 2012, the reaction from my family was pretty much what you'd expect: "You got a job at ESPN? That's incredible!"
paras.zh: 2012 年，当我受聘于 ESPN 时，家人的反应与你所预料的差不多：“你在 ESPN 找到了工作？这太不可思议了！”

paras.en: By the time I left in 2021, some of those same people had a very different reaction to hearing where I worked. "You work at ESPN? Oh."
paras.zh: 到 2021 年我离开时，其中一些人对我工作的地方产生了截然不同的反应。 “你在 ESPN 工作？哦。”

paras.en: I told Salisbury that I don't miss working at ESPN. But I do miss producing live radio.
paras.zh: 我告诉索尔兹伯里，我并不怀念在 ESPN 的工作。但我确实怀念制作现场广播。

paras.en: I'd spend all week preparing a four-hour Saturday show, then news would break while we were on the air and we'd have to adjust. I loved that part of the job. There were a lot of moving pieces, and getting it right gave me an adrenaline rush.
paras.zh: 我会花整个星期准备一个四小时的周六节目，然后当我们播出时就会有新闻发生，我们就必须做出调整。我喜欢这部分工作。有很多令人感动的部分，正确地完成它让我肾上腺素激增。

paras.en: Salisbury knew exactly what I meant. For him, live television was about as close as broadcasting could get to the feeling of playing quarterback in the NFL.
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里完全明白我的意思。对他来说，电视直播是最接近在 NFL 打四分卫的感觉。

paras.en: He recalled sitting beside Tirico on Monday Night Countdown when a camera went down just before the show started. Salisbury was sweating over how they were going to handle it. Tirico made it look routine.
paras.zh: 他回忆起周一晚倒计时坐在蒂里科旁边的情景，当时摄像机在演出开始前突然停机了。索尔兹伯里正在为如何处理这件事而苦恼。 Tirico 让它看起来很平常。

paras.en: "Nobody at home would have ever known," Salisbury said.
paras.zh: “家里没人会知道，”索尔兹伯里说。

paras.en: He also repeatedly credited the producers and other employees behind the scenes who made those shows work. His years at ESPN gave him close friends and taught him how to do the broadcasting work he still does.
paras.zh: 他还多次赞扬制片人和其他幕后员工，是他们让这些节目得以成功。在 ESPN 的岁月让他结识了亲密的朋友，并教会了他如何从事他现在仍在从事的广播工作。

paras.en: "Those 12 years changed my life," he said.
paras.zh: “这12年改变了我的生活，”他说。

paras.en: Salisbury still sees programming at ESPN that delivers what he's talking about. He singled out College GameDay, calling it "the best studio show on the planet."
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里仍然认为 ESPN 的节目能够传达他所说的内容。他特别提到了大学比赛日，称其为“地球上最好的工作室表演”。

paras.en: Salisbury wants ESPN's analysts saying what they actually believe.
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里希望 ESPN 的分析师说出他们真正相信的内容。

paras.en: "I think sometimes we all get caught up in it, saying stuff to appease somebody else as opposed to what you actually believe, and I'm just not willing to do that," Salisbury said. "I think it loses credibility."
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里说：“我认为有时我们都会陷入其中，说一些话来安抚别人，而不是你真正相信的事情，而我只是不愿意这样做。” “我认为它失去了可信度。”

paras.en: The ESPN Salisbury and I remember gave viewers a reason to keep watching after the highlights were over. He thinks the network still has the people to do that, provided it remembers why those viewers turned on a sports channel in the first place.
paras.zh: ESPN 索尔兹伯里和我记得在精彩片段结束后给观众一个继续观看的理由。他认为该网络仍然有人这样做，只要它记得那些观众最初打开体育频道的原因。

paras.en: "Hopefully we can get back to where we're actually talking sports more than we're talking about why somebody should have voted for somebody else," he said.
paras.zh: “希望我们能回到我们真正谈论体育的地方，而不是谈论为什么某人应该投票给别人，”他说。

articles.title: Millions join Spain’s first general strike in 14 years in protest at housing costs
articles.author: Ashifa Kassam in Madrid and Stephen Burgen in Barcelona

paras.en: Millions of people across Spain have joined the country’s first general strike in 14 years, setting up picket lines to protest against soaring housing prices before an election in which the far right could be catapulted into power.
paras.zh: 西班牙各地数百万人参加了该国 14 年来的首次大罢工，在极右翼可能上台的选举前设置纠察线，抗议房价飙升。

paras.en: At the centre of Wednesday’s nationwide 24-hour stoppage, singularly called for by tenants’ associations and later backed by workers’ unions, is a pushback against Spain’s deepening housing crisis.
paras.zh: 周三全国范围内的 24 小时停工行动由租户协会特别呼吁，后来得到了工会的支持，其核心是对西班牙日益严重的住房危机的抵制。

paras.en: Sandra Mora, of the Madrid Tenants’ Union, told the broadcaster RNE: “It’s extremely important to remind people that we, the workers – who are also renters or who also pay mortgages – are the ones with the power to halt production and bring the economy to a standstill.”
paras.zh: 马德里租户联盟的桑德拉·莫拉 (Sandra Mora) 告诉 RNE 广播公司：“提醒人们，我们工人——他们也是租房者或支付抵押贷款——是有权力停止生产并使经济陷入停滞的人，这一点非常重要。”

paras.en: While workers’ unions reported high participation in the strike across several sectors, including 90% in the automotive and port sectors and 82% in waste collection, they said participation was uneven across the country. The strongest support was reported in coastal regions, such as Catalonia and Andalucía, where the soaring cost of housing has been particularly acute.
paras.zh: 尽管工会报告称，多个行业的罢工参与率很高，其中汽车和港口行业的罢工率为 90%，垃圾收集行业的罢工率为 82%，但他们表示，全国各地的罢工参与率并不均衡。据报道，加泰罗尼亚和安达卢西亚等沿海地区的支持最为强烈，这些地区的住房成本飙升尤为严重。

paras.en: The Confederation of Tenants’ Association described the strike as a success, saying in a statement that by midday about 4 million people had taken part.
paras.zh: 租户协会联合会称这次罢工是成功的，并在一份声明中表示，截至中午已有约 400 万人参加。

paras.en: Many schools and universities were reportedly closed or working at minimal capacity. In Madrid, the labour action added to a continuing teachers’ strike that began nearly a month ago to demand better working conditions.
paras.zh: 据报道，许多学校和大学已关闭或以最低限度的能力开学。在马德里，劳工行动加剧了近一个月前开始的持续教师罢工，要求改善工作条件。

paras.en: In Barcelona, workers set up roadblocks – some with burning tyres – as public transport came to a near-standstill. Pickets were in place soon after the strike began at midnight, blocking off entry to factories, markets and transport hubs. Key roads into Barcelona, including the AP-7 motorway, were blocked off in both directions.
paras.zh: 在巴塞罗那，当公共交通几近瘫痪时，工人们设置了路障——其中一些还用燃烧的轮胎设置。午夜罢工开始后不久，纠察队就到位，封锁了工厂、市场和交通枢纽的入口。进入巴塞罗那的主要道路，包括 AP-7 高速公路，双向都被封锁。

paras.en: In Madrid, scuffles broke out between pickets and police near the country’s main wholesale market, while thousands of demonstrators poured into the city’s main boulevard, halting traffic temporarily. Government officials said more than 50 people had been arrested over minor incidents across the country.
paras.zh: 在马德里，该国主要批发市场附近的纠察队和警察之间爆发了混战，数千名示威者涌入该市的主要大道，导致交通暂时中断。政府官员表示，全国已有 50 多人因轻微事件被捕。

paras.en: Bad weather loomed over plans for afternoon marches after Spain’s state meteorological agency issued 14 alerts for two storms that were expected to bring strong winds, heavy rain and rough seas.
paras.zh: 西班牙国家气象局针对两场风暴发布了 14 次警报，预计将带来强风、暴雨和汹涌的海面，恶劣天气给下午的游行计划带来了阴影。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people still came together in more than 90 marches, pouring into plazas in Barcelona, Madrid and other cities. The marches in Cádiz, Seville, Córdoba and Huelva had to be cancelled amid forecasts of winds gusting up to 75mph (120km/h).
paras.zh: 仍有数万人聚集在一起，进行了90多次游行，涌入巴塞罗那、马德里和其他城市的广场。由于预报阵风高达 75 英里/小时（120 公里/小时），加的斯、塞维利亚、科尔多瓦和韦尔瓦的游行不得不取消。

paras.en: The long-simmering frustration at soaring housing prices across Spain burst into public view in September after the eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal from the home in which she had lived for more than seven decades.
paras.zh: 9月份，87岁的马里卡门·阿巴斯卡尔(Marcarmen Abascal)被驱逐出她居住了七十多年的家后，西班牙各地房价飙升引发的长期压抑的沮丧情绪突然进入公众视野。

paras.en: As protests and encampments sprang up across Spain, it cast a spotlight on a market where properties have been increasingly used as tourist lets, speculative assets and short-term rentals, sending rents rising by 80% within a decade while the cost of homes climbed by 63%.
paras.zh: 随着西班牙各地抗议活动和营地的兴起，房地产市场越来越多地被用作旅游出租、投机资产和短期租赁，导致租金在十年内上涨了 80%，而房屋成本上涨了 63%。

paras.en: Before Wednesday’s strike, the tenants’ union of Granada sought to highlight this link, descending on the city’s most touristy areas to vandalise about 300 lockboxes belonging to short-term rentals. “No to capitalists, no to rent-seekers, no to their accomplices,” the organisation wrote on social media, as they posted pictures of lockboxes that had been rendered unusable.
paras.zh: 在周三的罢工之前，格拉纳达的租户联盟试图突袭该市最受游客欢迎的地区，破坏了大约 300 个属于短期出租的锁箱，以突显这种联系。 “对资本家说不，对寻租者说不，对他们的同谋说不，”该组织在社交媒体上写道，同时发布了无法使用的密码箱的照片。

paras.en: Housing campaigners and unions have called on the government to do more to intervene in the market, with tenants’ unions demanding measures such as a crackdown on housing speculation, the elimination of tourist lets and strengthened protections for renters.
paras.zh: 住房活动人士和工会呼吁政府采取更多措施干预市场，租户工会要求采取措施，例如打击住房投机、消除游客出租以及加强对租户的保护等。

paras.en: While nominal wages for many across Spain had risen in recent years, Unai Sordo, the head of Spain’s biggest labour union, the Workers’ Commissions, said no amount of collective bargaining would be enough to address housing costs that had climbed by as much as 12% annually. “There is one issue that is fracturing the country, and that is the difficulty many people face in accessing housing,” he told the broadcaster Cadena Ser.
paras.zh: 尽管近年来西班牙许多人的名义工资有所上涨，但西班牙最大工会工人委员会主席乌奈·索尔多表示，再多的集体谈判也不足以解决每年上涨12%的住房成本问题。 “有一个问题正在使这个国家分裂，那就是许多人在获得住房方面面临困难，”他告诉广播公司 Cadena Ser。

paras.en: Spain is holding a general election on 29 November. The snap vote was called by the Socialist prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, after rightwing parties torpedoed emergency legislation aimed at tackling the housing crisis.
paras.zh: 西班牙将于11月29日举行大选。在右翼政党破坏了旨在解决住房危机的紧急立法后，社会党总理佩德罗·桑切斯宣布提前投票。

paras.en: Polls suggest the most likely outcome will be a rightwing coalition between the People’s party and the far-right, anti-immigration Vox party.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，最有可能的结果是人民党和极右翼反移民 Vox 党组成右翼联盟。

paras.en: While Sánchez has sought to focus the campaign on social issues, the discussion has shifted to questions over infrastructure after at least 69 people were killed in Spain’s second deadly high-speed rail disaster this year.
paras.zh: 虽然桑切斯试图将竞选重点放在社会问题上，但在西班牙今年第二次致命的高铁灾难中至少有 69 人死亡后，讨论转向了基础设施问题。

paras.en: This week Sánchez seized on the strike, whose official slogan is “Salaries. Housing. Prices”, as a way to recast the spotlight, posting a video in which he lauded developments such as the eight-hour work day and national health insurance and credited them to the labour movement and the right to strike. “It wasn’t easy, but they changed Spain,” Sánchez said.
paras.zh: 本周，桑切斯抓住了官方口号为“工资、住房、价格”的罢工，作为重新聚焦聚光灯的一种方式，他发布了一段视频，在视频中赞扬了八小时工作制和国民健康保险等发展，并将其归功于劳工运动和罢工权。 “这并不容易，但他们改变了西班牙，”桑切斯说。

paras.en: His position sharply contrasted with the discourse of parties on the right who, in the lead-up to the strike, dismissed it as an effort by unions to help Sánchez remain in office.
paras.zh: 他的立场与右翼政党的言论形成鲜明对比，右翼政党在罢工前将罢工视为工会帮助桑切斯继续执政的努力。

paras.en: This week the rightwing leader of the Madrid region, Isabel Díaz Ayuso, accused striking workers of “holding citizens hostage”. Ayuso, who this year faced questions over her administration’s decision to allegedly spend €6.3m (£5.4m) of public funds on a residential penthouse to use as a temporary office, added: “Everything is chaotic, everything is gridlocked.”
paras.zh: 本周，马德里地区右翼领导人伊莎贝尔·迪亚斯·阿尤索指责罢工工人“将公民扣为人质”。阿尤索今年因政府决定花费 630 万欧元（540 万英镑）公共资金购买一套住宅顶层公寓作为临时办公室而受到质疑，她补充道：“一切都很混乱，一切都陷入僵局。”

paras.en: While she acknowledged union activity was a constitutional right, she also took aim at what she described as the “mafia of union representatives” and said she had vented her frustrations to the leader of the People’s party, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, who polls suggest will be the next prime minister. “I’ll confess something,” she told Spanish television. “I spoke to Feijóo and I told him: ‘Promise me this garbage will end.’”
paras.zh: 虽然她承认工会活动是一项宪法权利，但她也将矛头指向了她所称的“工会代表黑手党”，并表示她已向人民党领袖阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费霍（Alberto Núñez Feijóo）发泄了不满，民调显示他将成为下一任总理。 “我会承认一些事情，”她告诉西班牙电视台。 “我和费乔谈过，我告诉他：‘答应我，这种垃圾将会结束。’”

articles.title: ‘The world we know is over’ without urgent climate action, leaders tell Cop31
articles.author: Oliver Milman, Fiona Harvey and Graham Readfearn in Antalya, and Ajit Niranjan

paras.en: Failure to provide an overwhelming response to the climate crisis means “the world we know is over”, the president of the embattled Marshall Islands has warned, as dozens of leaders gathered in Turkey for the Cop31 climate summit.
paras.zh: 陷入困境的马绍尔群岛总统警告说，未能对气候危机做出压倒性的应对措施意味着“我们所知道的世界已经结束”，数十位领导人齐聚土耳其参加第三十一届缔约方会议气候峰会。

paras.en: Hilda Heine, one of a handful of Pacific Island leaders to make an impassioned speech at Cop31 on Wednesday, told other heads of state that overshooting the 1.5C Paris temperature target would mean waves eating away their shores and floods that destroy towns, schools and hospitals.
paras.zh: 希尔达·海涅 (Hilda Heine) 是周三在第 31 届缔约方大会上发表热情洋溢演讲的少数太平洋岛国领导人之一，她对其他国家元首表示，超过巴黎 1.5 摄氏度的气温目标将意味着海浪侵蚀其海岸，洪水将摧毁城镇、学校和医院。

paras.en: She described seeing bright, lush coral beneath the water of her home island in July that had been bleached white just months later.
paras.zh: 她描述说，七月份她在家乡岛屿的水下看到了明亮、茂盛的珊瑚，而几个月后，珊瑚就被漂白了。

paras.en: “It’s time to wake up,” said Heine. “Our response to the threat of overshoot must be overwhelming, or the world we know is over.”
paras.zh: “该起床了。”海涅说道。 “我们对超调威胁的反应必须是压倒性的，否则我们所知道的世界就结束了。”

paras.en: Mia Mottley, the prime minister of Barbados, also called out governments who had “not tried hard enough” to curb emissions since the Paris agreement.
paras.zh: 巴巴多斯总理米娅·莫特利也呼吁各国政府自《巴黎协定》签署以来在遏制排放方面“不够努力”。

paras.en: “The UN tells us that, even if every pledge is delivered, we are heading for 2.6 degrees,” she said. “On current policies, 2.8 degrees is where we will end up.
paras.zh: “联合国告诉我们，即使每一项承诺都兑现，我们的气温也将达到 2.6 度，”她说。 “根据目前的政策，2.8 度是我们最终的目标。

paras.en: “Let me be plain: overshoot is not a new target. It is a debt, a debt of heat, borrowed against our children’s future. And it must be repaid.”
paras.zh: “让我直白地说：超额完成并不是一个新目标。它是一笔债务，一笔热债，是为了我们孩子的未来而借来的。而且必须偿还。”

paras.en: The opening of the summit of international leaders, on day three of Cop31, saw impassioned speeches interspersed with vigorous displays of Turkish music and dancing.
paras.zh: 第三十一届缔约方大会第三天的国际领导人峰会开幕式上，热情洋溢的演讲中穿插着充满活力的土耳其音乐和舞蹈表演。

paras.en: António Guterres, the UN secretary general, blamed a deceitful fossil fuel industry and countries that “keep expanding fossil fuel production while claiming to be committed to 1.5C”. His speech – a salvo aimed at boosting the talks – was one of the last Guterres, a vocal climate advocate, will deliver as secretary general before he stands down next month.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯指责具有欺骗性的化石燃料行业和“一边声称致力于1.5摄氏度一边不断扩大化石燃料生产”的国家。古特雷斯是一位直言不讳的气候倡导者，他的讲话是旨在推动谈判的一次齐射，是下个月卸任前作为秘书长将发表的最后一次讲话之一。

paras.en: “We need an extraordinary acceleration,” Guterres said. “Our planet is heating up. The clock is winding down. It’s make or bake time.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯说：“我们需要非凡的加速。” “我们的星球正在变暖。时钟即将结束。现在是制作或烘烤时间。

paras.en: “Fossil fuels must go the way of the dinosaurs,” he added. “And that won’t happen on its own. The dinosaurs did not have a lobby – fossil fuels do.”
paras.zh: “化石燃料必须走恐龙的道路，”他补充道。 “这不会自行发生。恐龙没有游说团体，但化石燃料有。”

paras.en: Guterres said oil and gas companies had distorted science and delayed action on the climate crisis, and called for a windfall tax on their bumper profits they have made from the Iran war. “It’s time to kick the habit and end the fossil-fuel addiction,” he said, to applause. “It’s time for governments to tax these windfall profits and use them to help vulnerable countries recover. Polluters must pay.”
paras.zh: 古特雷斯表示，石油和天然气公司歪曲了科学，推迟了应对气候危机的行动，并呼吁对其从伊朗战争中获得的巨额利润征收暴利税。 “是时候戒掉这个习惯，结束对化石燃料的依赖了，”他说，赢得了掌声。 “现在是政府对这些暴利征税并利用它们帮助脆弱国家复苏的时候了。污染者必须付出代价。”

paras.en: Unusually, Turkey is co-hosting Cop with Australia, with the leaders of both countries, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and Anthony Albanese respectively, each praising the partnership.
paras.zh: 不同寻常的是，土耳其与澳大利亚共同主办《警察》，两国领导人雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安和安东尼·阿尔巴内斯分别对这一伙伴关系表示赞赏。

paras.en: Erdoğan said he wants Cop31 to be remembered as a turning point in the climate crisis and called on countries to act, rather than just make promises. “Every minute we fail to meet the targets in the Paris agreement, the risks and costs we face continue to grow,” the Turkish president said. However, on Monday, away from the conference hall, Erdoğan celebrated the discovery of two new oilfields with an estimated in-situ potential of 135m barrels.
paras.zh: 埃尔多安表示，他希望第三十一届缔约方会议被视为气候危机的转折点，并呼吁各国采取行动，而不仅仅是做出承诺。土耳其总统表示：“我们每未能实现《巴黎协定》的目标，我们面临的风险和成本就会不断增加。”然而，周一，埃尔多安在会议厅外庆祝了两个新油田的发现，预计原地蕴藏量为 1.35 亿桶。

paras.en: In her speech before world leaders, Heine said every new oil well drilled and every piece of coal extracted was a threat to her country’s future. Without naming any individual oil or gas producer, she added: “The discovery of new fossil fuel resources is not something to celebrate but something to fear.”
paras.zh: 海涅在世界领导人面前的演讲中表示，每一口新钻探的油井和开采的每一块煤炭都对她国家的未来构成威胁。她没有点名任何个别石油或天然气生产商，但补充道：“新化石燃料资源的发现不是值得庆祝的事情，而是值得恐惧的事情。”

paras.en: Albanese said the conference was a “historic moment” for Australia. The country is one of the world’s biggest exporters of coal and liquified gas. Albanese said governments had a “solemn responsibility” to act on the climate crisis, but he was criticised for failing to mention fossil fuels in his speech.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内斯表示，这次会议对澳大利亚来说是一个“历史性时刻”。该国是世界上最大的煤炭和液化天然气出口国之一。阿尔巴内塞表示，各国政府负有采取行动应对气候危机的“庄严责任”，但他因在演讲中没有提及化石燃料而受到批评。

paras.en: The gathering of leaders was relatively threadbare. While 91 national leaders attended, according to the UN, major figures such as Donald Trump of the US and Xi Jinping of China were absent. Perhaps tellingly, some other leaders who declined to attend, including the French president, Emmanuel Macron, and the German chancellor, Friedrich Merz, are instead heading to Ireland for a conference on AI.
paras.zh: 领导人的聚会相对乏味。据联合国称，虽然有 91 位国家领导人出席，但美国唐纳德·特朗普和中国习近平等重要人物缺席。也许很能说明问题的是，其他一些拒绝出席的领导人，包括法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙和德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨，转而前往爱尔兰参加人工智能会议。

paras.en: Almost every country at Cop31 is lagging in cutting emissions, with insufficient finance for the nations most vulnerable to extreme heat, floods, fires and other climate-fuelled calamities.
paras.zh: 参加第三十一届缔约方会议的几乎每个国家在减排方面都落后了，对于那些最容易遭受极端高温、洪水、火灾和其他气候引发的灾难的国家来说，资金不足。

paras.en: Although the world is barrelling past the 1.5C limit and is entering the teeth of one of the strongest El Niño events in history, there is little sign that the talks will feature any further progress on phasing out planet-heating fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 尽管世界气温正在迅速突破 1.5 摄氏度的极限，并且正在进入历史上最强烈的厄尔尼诺事件之一，但几乎没有迹象表明会谈将在逐步淘汰全球供暖化石燃料方面取得任何进一步进展。

paras.en: “I’m getting a feeling of panic from around here, from the science community,” said Bill Hare, a climate scientist and chief executive of Climate Analytics, who described fraught conversations with rainforest and cryosphere scientists. “The mood is gradually darkening among scientists. In fact, people talk about feeling as though things have gone backwards.”
paras.zh: 气候科学家兼气候分析公司首席执行官比尔·黑尔（Bill Hare）表示：“我从这里、从科学界感受到了恐慌。”他描述了与雨林和冰冻圈科学家的紧张对话。 “科学家们的情绪正在逐渐阴暗。事实上，人们谈论的感觉好像事情已经倒退了。”

paras.en: Small island nations face an existential threat from rising sea levels and are some of the countries most exposed to catastrophe when global heating shoots past 1.5C. The UN Environment Programme has found that such overshoot is now inevitable, and warned that its effects on icy regions will be so calamitous it should be kept as brief and low as possible.
paras.zh: 小岛屿国家面临着海平面上升带来的生存威胁，并且是全球升温超过 1.5 摄氏度时最容易遭受灾难的国家之一。联合国环境规划署发现，这种超调现在是不可避免的，并警告说，其对冰天雪地的影响将是灾难性的，因此应尽可能保持短暂和较低的影响。

paras.en: Other world leaders stressed the urgency of this moment of multiple crises and the need for multilateralism to finally deliver. Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova, the president of North Macedonia, said: “We are the first generation to fully understand the consequences of our choices – and perhaps the last with time to change course. Future generations will live with the consequences of our decisions.”
paras.zh: 其他世界领导人强调了多重危机时刻的紧迫性以及多边主义最终发挥作用的必要性。北马其顿总统戈尔达娜·西利亚诺夫斯卡-达夫科娃表示：“我们是第一代充分了解我们选择的后果的人，也许也是最后一代，需要时间来改变方向。子孙后代将承受我们决定的后果。”

paras.en: Nataša Pirc Musar, the president of Slovenia, said: “If we cannot agree that human dignity and respect for nature must be at the heart of our decisions then, frankly, what is left to unite us?”
paras.zh: 斯洛文尼亚总统纳塔莎·皮尔克·穆萨尔 (Nataša Pirc Musar) 表示：“如果我们不能同意人类尊严和对自然的尊重必须成为我们决策的核心，那么坦率地说，还有什么可以团结我们呢？”

articles.title: Ex-member of radical Marxist group scales balcony, escapes house arrest in Argentina
articles.author: AFP

paras.en: A 74-year-old former member of Italy’s radical Marxist group the Red Brigades has escaped from house arrest in Argentina, the country’s security ministry confirmed on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 阿根廷安全部周三证实，意大利激进马克思主义团体“红色旅”的一名 74 岁前成员已逃离阿根廷的软禁。

paras.en: Authorities placed Leonardo Bertulazzi under house arrest in Buenos Aires in 2024, prior to his extradition to Italy to serve a 27-year prison sentence.
paras.zh: 2024 年，当局将莱昂纳多·贝尔图拉齐 (Leonardo Bertulazzi) 软禁在布宜诺斯艾利斯，随后将他引渡到意大利服刑 27 年。

paras.en: He had received the sentence in 1987 for joining a subversive association and belonging to an armed group.
paras.zh: 他于 1987 年因加入颠覆组织和武装团体而被判刑。

paras.en: After years on the run, Bertulazzi was first arrested by Argentine authorities in 2002. He was freed a few months later and secured refugee status in 2004, but was arrested again in 2024 after it was revoked.
paras.zh: 经过多年逃亡，贝尔图拉齐于 2002 年首次被阿根廷当局逮捕。几个月后他被释放，并于 2004 年获得难民身份，但在 2024 年被撤销后再次被捕。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Argentina’s security ministry offered a $13,000 reward for information leading to Bertulazzi’s recapture after he slipped out of detention.
paras.zh: 周三，阿根廷安全部悬赏 13,000 美元，悬赏 13,000 美元，以奖励贝尔图拉齐出狱后将其重新抓获的信息。

paras.en: The fugitive held a senior position in the Red Brigades, a radical Marxist organization responsible for attacks between 1969 and 1980, dubbed Italy’s “Years of Lead”.
paras.zh: 这名逃犯在红色旅中担任高级职务，这是一个激进的马克思主义组织，负责 1969 年至 1980 年间的袭击事件，被称为意大利的“领导之年”。

paras.en: The group most notoriously kidnapped and assassinated former prime minister Aldo Moro in 1978.
paras.zh: 该组织最臭名昭著的事件是 1978 年绑架并暗杀前总理阿尔多·莫罗。

paras.en: Local press went wild describing details of Bertulazzi’s escape from his residence in the capital, but authorities have not confirmed the veracity of any of the reports.
paras.zh: 当地媒体疯狂描述贝尔图拉齐逃离首都住所的细节，但当局尚未证实任何报道的真实性。

paras.en: He reportedly used a harness to lower himself from a fifth-floor balcony.
paras.zh: 据报道，他使用安全带从五楼的阳台上跳下来。

paras.en: Police noticed his ankle monitor had stopped transmitting movement data and headed to the house, where they found the device discarded and Bertulazzi nowhere to be found.
paras.zh: 警方注意到他的脚踝监视器已经停止传输运动数据，于是他们前往房子，发现该设备被丢弃，而贝尔图拉齐却不见踪影。

paras.en: Argentina approved his extradition to Italy in July 2025 after the country’s supreme court rejected a final appeal.
paras.zh: 在意大利最高法院驳回最终上诉后，阿根廷于 2025 年 7 月批准将他引渡至意大利。

articles.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough

paras.en: Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine have concluded after a second day.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国在阿布扎比举行的旨在结束乌克兰战争的三边会谈在第二天结束。

paras.en: Although the American side said they saw "some openings", there was no hint of any breakthroughs to end the nearly five year-long war sparked by Russia's invasion.
paras.zh: 尽管美方表示看到了“一些机会”，但没有迹象表明俄罗斯入侵引发的这场长达近五年的战争有任何突破性进展。

paras.en: However, both Moscow and Kyiv confirmed that a large-scale prisoner of war exchange was in the works and could be carried out soon.
paras.zh: 不过，莫斯科和基辅都证实，大规模战俘交换正在进行中，并将很快进行。

paras.en: Davyd Arakhamia from Ukraine's negotiating team said that this round of talks - the first since February - "was one of the hardest."
paras.zh: 乌克兰谈判小组的戴维德·阿拉卡米亚 (Davyd Arakhamia) 表示，本轮谈判是自二月份以来的首次谈判，“是最艰难的一轮”。

paras.en: "I believe the Russians came with very strict directives, so it was extremely difficult to soften the discussion," he said. But he added that he felt "good momentum" and urged for a second round of talks to be organised as soon as possible.
paras.zh: “我相信俄罗斯人带来了非常严格的指示，因此很难软化讨论，”他说。但他补充说，他感到“势头良好”，并敦促尽快组织第二轮会谈。

paras.en: Comments by Kremlin negotiator Vladimir Medinsky were less conciliatory. "Right now... a lot depends on Ukraine, on the position of the US, and on whether Europe comes to its senses," he said.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫谈判代表弗拉基米尔·梅丁斯基的评论则不太温和。 “目前……很大程度上取决于乌克兰、美国的立场以及欧洲是否清醒过来，”他说。

paras.en: After the talks it was announced that on Thursday US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner - President Donald Trump's son-in-law - would travel to Moscow to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin, and then to Dublin to speak to Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky.
paras.zh: 会谈后宣布，周四美国谈判代表史蒂夫·威特科夫和唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳将前往莫斯科会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，然后前往都柏林与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基交谈。

paras.en: The meetings in Abu Dhabi had been framed as centred around the "security architecture" of Europe.
paras.zh: 阿布扎比会议的框架是围绕欧洲的“安全架构”。

paras.en: For Kyiv, this may include reassurances that allies will come to its aid if Ukraine comes under attack again, despite the country not being a Nato member.
paras.zh: 对于基辅来说，这可能包括保证如果乌克兰再次受到攻击，盟国将提供援助，尽管该国不是北约成员国。

paras.en: For Moscow, a reworked "security framework" is likely to include a limit to the influence of Nato in eastern Europe - a central concern for the Kremlin since the alliance's eastward expansion.
paras.zh: 对于莫斯科来说，重新制定的“安全框架”可能包括限制北约在东欧的影响力——这是自北约东扩以来克里姆林宫的主要担忧。

paras.en: Earlier this week Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while the Kremlin's Medinsky said the world needed a "new" and "fair" security system.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，库什纳表示，美国希望在乌克兰、俄罗斯和欧洲之间“建立一个新的安全框架”，以“确保持久和平”，而克里姆林宫的梅丁斯基则表示，世界需要一个“新的”和“公平的”安全体系。

paras.en: That framework would serve as "a new Yalta and Potsdam", Medinsky said, referring to the 1940s summits in which the victorious Allied powers carved up post-war Europe into spheres of influence.
paras.zh: 梅丁斯基说，这一框架将成为“新的雅尔塔和波茨坦”，他指的是 20 世纪 40 年代的峰会，在这次峰会上，获胜的盟国将战后的欧洲瓜分成势力范围。

paras.en: Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin.
paras.zh: 乌克兰和欧洲长期以来一直担心美国现任政府对欧洲安全的承诺及其对克里姆林宫的软化。

paras.en: Representatives of Britain, Nato and various EU countries were also in Abu Dhabi and met with US and Ukrainian negotiators, but the Kremlin - with whom the EU does not officially communicate - said its delegation had not had any contact with them.
paras.zh: 英国、北约和欧盟各国的代表也在阿布扎比会见了美国和乌克兰谈判代表，但克里姆林宫 - 欧盟没有与克里姆林宫进行正式沟通 - 表示其代表团没有与他们进行任何接触。

paras.en: Moscow has been dismissive of European involvement, although Europeans have long argued that they are central to any post-war dynamics on their continent.
paras.zh: 莫斯科一直对欧洲的参与不屑一顾，尽管欧洲人长期以来一直认为欧洲对其大陆的战后动态至关重要。

paras.en: Many - particularly in eastern Europe - feel their security is linked to that of Ukraine. Agreements cannot be implemented "if no consensus can be reached among Nato members," a German government spokesperson said on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 许多人——尤其是东欧国家——认为他们的安全与乌克兰的安全息息相关。德国政府发言人周三表示，“如果北约成员国之间无法达成共识”，协议就无法实施。

paras.en: Kushner said the US was keen to bring the Europeans on board and said that getting them "added to the format" would be on the agenda for his talks with Putin.
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，美国热衷于让欧洲人参与进来，并表示让他们“加入到这种形式中”将是他与普京会谈的议程。

paras.en: There is also disagreement on whether discussions on a future security framework should be preceded by a ceasefire, as the Europeans and Kyiv would want, or whether the fighting only stops after an agreement has been reached, as the Kremlin has insisted.
paras.zh: 对于是否应该像欧洲人和基辅所希望的那样在讨论未来安全框架之前先停火，还是像克里姆林宫所坚持的那样，在达成协议后才停止战斗，也存在分歧。

paras.en: Any agreement on a peacetime security framework, however, is contingent on the war ending, Kushner noted. But that cannot occur "until there's an agreement on territory and on all other bilateral issues," he added.
paras.zh: 然而，库什纳指出，任何关于和平时期安全框架的协议都取决于战争的结束。但他补充说，“除非就领土和所有其他双边问题达成协议”，否则这种情况不会发生。

paras.en: Since talks began last year, a core obstacle to any settlement has been Ukraine's eastern region of Donetsk, which is mostly occupied by Russia. Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those areas, which it says are essential to its security.
paras.zh: 自去年谈判开始以来，任何解决方案的核心障碍一直是乌克兰东部的顿涅茨克地区，该地区大部分被俄罗斯占领。基辅希望冻结接触线，以保持对这些地区的控制，并称这对其安全至关重要。

paras.en: Moscow, meanwhile, has never backed down from its demand that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk it still holds. "Every inch" of land would be "returned to Russia one way or another", Medinsky said.
paras.zh: 与此同时，莫斯科从未放弃要求乌克兰放弃其仍拥有的顿涅茨克部分地区的要求。梅丁斯基说，“每一寸”土地都将“以某种方式归还给俄罗斯”。

paras.en: Kushner acknowledged that the territorial question remained the hardest, while Zelensky's chief of staff and negotiator Kyrylo Budanov refused to be drawn on whether Russia was still demanding a Ukrainian withdrawal from the region.
paras.zh: 库什纳承认，领土问题仍然是最棘手的问题，而泽连斯基的幕僚长兼谈判代表凯里洛·布达诺夫拒绝透露俄罗斯是否仍然要求乌克兰从该地区撤军。

paras.en: Later, Budanov admitted the talks had been "tough" and that Ukraine's priority was to ensure Russia could not attack it again.
paras.zh: 后来，布达诺夫承认谈判“艰难”，乌克兰的首要任务是确保俄罗斯无法再次攻击它。

paras.en: "These deals are very hard and complex, and this one is very emotional, very complex," Kushner said. "The reality is there is no trust right now between the sides and that is to be expected after a conflict like this."
paras.zh: 库什纳说：“这些交易非常艰难和复杂，而这一笔交易非常情绪化、非常复杂。” “现实情况是，双方之间目前不存在信任，在发生这样的冲突后，这是可以预料到的。”

articles.title: Missing 11-month-old baby found buried alive in a crate in South Carolina

paras.en: An 11-month-old baby has been rescued in South Carolina after officials say he was buried alive in a crate by his father.
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州一名 11 个月大的婴儿被救出，官方称他被父亲活埋在板条箱里。

paras.en: Koah Sharpe had been missing since Monday when he was taken by his father, Michael Comer, 25, according to the Lexington County Sheriff's Department. Comer was arrested on a burglary charge on Monday evening but his son was not with him.
paras.zh: 据列克星敦县治安部门称，科阿·夏普自周一被他 25 岁的父亲迈克尔·科默带走以来一直失踪。周一晚上，科默因入室盗窃罪被捕，但他的儿子并不在场。

paras.en: The baby was found on Tuesday "buried alive" and "clinging to life" not far from his father's house, Lexington County Sheriff Jay Koon said at a news conference. It is thought he had been there for 24 hours.
paras.zh: 列克星敦县治安官杰伊·库恩在新闻发布会上说，周二，这名婴儿被发现在离他父亲家不远的地方“被活埋”，“还活着”。据认为他已经在那里待了 24 小时。

paras.en: The child is now in hospital receiving care, Koon said, adding he was hopeful he would make a full recovery.
paras.zh: 库恩说，孩子现在正在医院接受治疗，并补充说他希望他能完全康复。

paras.en: Police are still deciding what further charges to bring against the father.
paras.zh: 警方仍在决定对这名父亲提出哪些进一步指控。

paras.en: The search for baby Koah began on Monday after his father took him from his mother's house.
paras.zh: 周一，在他的父亲将他从母亲家中带走后，寻找婴儿科阿的工作就开始了。

paras.en: Comer's mother was watching the child and had left her son alone with him briefly, Koon said, when he left abruptly with Koah.
paras.zh: 库恩说，科默的母亲当时正在看护孩子，并短暂地将儿子单独留在身边，然后科默就带着科阿突然离开了。

paras.en: Comer was seen travelling to multiple locations without the baby and was later arrested in Lexington County without Koah. A search party of 100 police and fire department officials were then sent to search for the child, the sheriff said.
paras.zh: 人们看到科默在没有带着孩子的情况下前往多个地点，后来在没有科阿的情况下在列克星敦县被捕。治安官称，随后派出 100 名警察和消防部门官员组成的搜救队前去搜寻这名儿童。

paras.en: He added that when they asked Comer where his son was, he "did not have much to say" about his whereabouts.
paras.zh: 他补充说，当他们问科默他儿子在哪里时，他对于他的下落“没有太多可说的”。

paras.en: Koon said that rescuers searched the woods near Comer's house and saw some "freshly disturbed dirt". As they began to dig, they heard a baby crying - something the sheriff described as "the most joyful sound you ever heard".
paras.zh: 库恩说，救援人员搜查了科默家附近的树林，看到了一些“刚刚被扰乱的泥土”。当他们开始挖掘时，他们听到婴儿的哭声，治安官将其描述为“你听过的最快乐的声音”。

paras.en: "The race was on. Everybody was getting down there trying to get him out," Koon added.
paras.zh: “比赛开始了。每个人都想把他赶出去，”库恩补充道。

paras.en: He said the crate was wrapped in a towel that probably provided enough air for Koah to survive for as long as he did, while the cold weather kept him from getting too hot.
paras.zh: 他说，板条箱上裹着一条毛巾，这可能为科阿提供了足够的空气，让他能够生存这么久，而寒冷的天气又让他不会变得太热。

paras.en: "The crate was, probably, I'm guessing about a two-foot [61cm] by two-foot dog crate. So, I think, once that crate hit the ground, he was probably up at least a foot from the top of that crate to the top of the ground," Koon explained.
paras.zh: “我猜测这个板条箱可能是一个两英尺（61厘米）乘两英尺的狗板条箱。所以，我认为，一旦板条箱落地，它可能会从板条箱顶部到地面至少一英尺，”库恩解释道。

paras.en: Of the parents relationship, the sheriff said there were "obviously some issues". Comer had previously pleaded guilty to domestic violence charges, court records show.
paras.zh: 关于父母的关系，警长表示“显然存在一些问题”。法庭记录显示，科默此前已承认家庭暴力指控。

paras.en: Comer's mother, Patricia Comer, told NBC News that Koah's mother had full custody of him but allowed her to supervise while her son watched him. She said her son had watched the baby before unsupervised without any problems.
paras.zh: 科默的母亲帕特里夏·科默告诉 NBC 新闻，科阿的母亲拥有他的完全监护权，但允许她在儿子监督时进行监督。她说，她的儿子之前曾在无人监管的情况下照看过婴儿，没有出现任何问题。

paras.en: "Honestly, I'm his mother, and I never expected this from him," Patricia Comer said.
paras.zh: “老实说，我是他的母亲，我从没想过他会这么做，”帕特里夏·科默说。

articles.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax

paras.en: Some 6,300 schools across Italy and more than 700 in Scotland and Northern Ireland have received bomb threats, according to local authorities.
paras.zh: 据地方当局称，意大利各地约 6,300 所学校以及苏格兰和北爱尔兰的 700 多所学校收到了炸弹威胁。

paras.en: In Italy a number of buildings were evacuated as a precaution but Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said checks so far had not indicated any evidence of "concrete danger".
paras.zh: 在意大利，作为预防措施，许多建筑物被疏散，但总理乔治亚·梅洛尼表示，迄今为止的检查尚未表明任何“具体危险”的证据。

paras.en: "These reports appear rather linked to a strategy intended to cause alarm and concern," she said on Facebook.
paras.zh: 她在脸书上表示：“这些报道似乎与旨在引起恐慌和担忧的策略有关。”

paras.en: Scotland's education secretary Mairi McAllan said there was no risk to the public and specialist cyber-crime officers were working to identify the source of the messages. In Northern Ireland education officials told schools to remain open unless otherwise advised by police.
paras.zh: 苏格兰教育大臣迈里·麦卡伦 (Mairi McAllan) 表示，公众不会面临任何风险，专门的网络犯罪官员正在努力查明信息的来源。在北爱尔兰，教育官员告诉学校保持开放，除非警方另有建议。

paras.en: It is unclear whether the incidents are connected.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这些事件是否有关联。

paras.en: "As a parent and as a constituency MSP I understand just how concerning this will be for parents, for pupils, for carers and for school staff," McAllan said.
paras.zh: 麦卡伦说：“作为一名家长和选区议员，我理解这对于家长、学生、看护者和学校工作人员来说是多么令人担忧。”

paras.en: Scottish police had earlier said that the warnings were "immediately assessed" as hoaxes. However some local authorities confirmed that some schools had been evacuated.
paras.zh: 苏格兰警方早些时候表示，这些警告“立即被评估”为恶作剧。不过，一些地方当局证实，一些学校已被疏散。

paras.en: "Our advice is that there is no requirement to evacuate schools or keep children away from education based solely on the content of the emails," Police Scotland said.
paras.zh: 苏格兰警方表示：“我们的建议是，没有必要仅仅根据电子邮件的内容就要求疏散学校或让儿童远离教育。”

paras.en: Italian officials said a single email appeared to have been sent on Wednesday to the inboxes of 6,300 out of a total of 7,476 state schools, and private schools were unaffected.
paras.zh: 意大利官员表示，周三似乎已向 7,476 所公立学校中的 6,300 个收件箱发送了一封电子邮件，私立学校未受影响。

paras.en: The message, said to be from a certain "Mikhail Andropov, leader of Vilayat di Misoginistan", caused alarm in many schools.
paras.zh: 这条消息据说是来自某位“米索吉斯坦省领导人米哈伊尔·安德罗波夫”，引起了许多学校的恐慌。

paras.en: The BBC has seen the email sent to Scottish schools which appeared to have similar wording, and also referenced the name Mikhail Andropov, although as leader of a "Red Owl" project.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司（BBC）看到发送给苏格兰学校的电子邮件似乎有类似的措辞，并且还提到了米哈伊尔·安德罗波夫（Mikhail Andropov）的名字，尽管他是“红猫头鹰”项目的领导者。

paras.en: Italy's Education Minister Giuseppe Valditara said the incidents involving Italian schools were probably a "cyber-attack, not a genuine risk", adding that there appeared to be a clear strategy behind the rash of threats in across Europe targeting flights, supermarkets and even hospitals.
paras.zh: 意大利教育部长朱塞佩·瓦尔迪塔拉表示，涉及意大利学校的事件可能是“网络攻击，而不是真正的风险”，并补充说，欧洲各地针对航班、超市甚至医院的一系列威胁背后似乎有一个明确的策略。

paras.en: Italian airports along with airlines elsewhere in Europe were hit by a series of bomb hoaxes last week that prompted a series of scares, evacuations and widespread disruption.
paras.zh: 意大利机场以及欧洲其他地区的航空公司上周遭受了一系列炸弹恶作剧袭击，引发了一系列恐慌、疏散和大范围的混乱。

paras.en: Although a number of threats were claimed by an extremist misogynistic group, it later denied any link to the false warnings.
paras.zh: 尽管一个极端厌女团体声称发出了一些威胁，但该组织后来否认与虚假警告有任何联系。

paras.en: On Wednesday one Milan headteacher, Anna Bertato, told Italian media she had checked the email address of the sender online: "It was already classified as spam by a student at a university in Taiwan."
paras.zh: 周三，米兰校长安娜·贝尔塔托 (Anna Bertato) 告诉意大利媒体，她已在网上检查了发件人的电子邮件地址：“该邮件已被台湾一所大学的一名学生归类为垃圾邮件。”

paras.en: Another Milan headteacher, Massimo Nunzio Barrella, told Adnkronos news agency that he had immediately realised the email was spam when it arrived in his inbox at 08:59 and he decided not to evacuate his school and reassured parents who phoned in.
paras.zh: 另一位米兰校长马西莫·农齐奥·巴雷拉 (Massimo Nunzio Barrella) 告诉 Adnkronos 通讯社，当这封电子邮件于 08:59 到达他的收件箱时，他立即意识到这是垃圾邮件，他决定不撤离学校，并向打电话来的家长保证。

paras.en: "The text seemed almost comical," said Barrella, "it was like a message from Martians: 'We have come to annihilate you.' I even had a bit of a laugh."
paras.zh: “这段文字看起来近乎滑稽，”巴雷拉说，“就像来自火星人的信息：‘我们是来消灭你们的。’”我什至有点笑了。”

paras.en: Although many schools were initially evacuated on Wednesday, the alarm was quickly lifted, and pupils were allowed to return to class. Some parents decided to take their children home for the day, but the majority of schools in Milan did not send their pupils home.
paras.zh: 尽管许多学校最初在周三疏散，但警报很快就解除了，学生们被允许返回课堂。一些家长决定带孩子回家，但米兰的大多数学校并没有送学生回家。

paras.en: Some 280 school head teachers had already received threats in recent days, according to Italian reports.
paras.zh: 据意大利报道，近几天已有约 280 名学校校长受到威胁。

paras.en: In a statement, the head of the central Umbria region Stefania Proietti said "checks conducted so far in Umbrian schools have proved negative, and law enforcement is working rapidly and carefully to verify each report".
paras.zh: 翁布里亚中部地区负责人斯特凡尼亚·普罗耶蒂（Stefania Proietti）在一份声明中表示，“迄今为止在翁布里亚学校进行的检查结果呈阴性，执法部门正在迅速而仔细地核实每份报告”。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: 卡莱尔推出EL121盘式制动器，提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州麦地那， 2023年9月12日） – Carlisle Brake & Friction很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用运输卡车的EL121盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为延长寿命或EL系列， EL121将是该系列推出的第一个摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的EL121系列摩擦材料几乎使前桥、矿用拖车刹车片的使用寿命翻了一番。其结果是增加了设备的正常运行时间，并降低了使用OEM卡钳和转子的维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自主运输卡车经历更高的衬垫温度，随着减速器和常用制动器的应用，由于制动周期的增加，导致衬垫磨损升高。EL121具有高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片寿命，并具有一致的耐褪色制动性能。EL121是当今自主矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: “我们知道，矿山运营商需要让他们的运输卡车在工作中，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新可以使前桥矿用拖车刹车片的使用寿命提高一倍，并且可以替代现有的OEM刹车片。这些都经过了彻底的实验室测试以及在小松830E-1卡车上的现场测试，” Carlisle Brake & Friction摩擦产品产品线总监Ron Ratell说。

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.
paras.zh: EL121 Friction已通过动力学测试以复制应用，并被证明可提供创新的高能材料以满足市场需求。EL121盘式刹车片还配备了经过行业验证的机械固定系统，背板技术旨在实现卓越的粘接和耐用性，即使在最恶劣的非公路环境中也能承受恶劣条件。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的EL121系列盘式刹车片现已通过卡莱尔授权经销商和分销商发售。如需了解更多信息，请访问https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el。要查找您附近的授权卡莱尔经销商，请搜索我们的在线经销商列表https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag
paras.zh: Carlisle发布农业视频突出显示解决方案

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction推出全新产品解决方案视频： Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications ，展示适用于农业设备的所有最新运动控制技术，特别是拖拉机应用。

paras.en: From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
paras.zh: 从动力阀到盘式制动器，再到PTO和梭式离合器摩擦选项，本视频详细介绍了卡莱尔最新制动系统和动力总成解决方案的所有功能和优势。

paras.en: For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.
paras.zh: 为了改进可视化效果，视频在标准拖拉机模型中展示了3D动画和产品配件演示。

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱尔苏州获得卡特彼勒SER认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在27,000家供应商中， 250家是卡特彼勒授予的入选公司。Carlisle是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速器摩擦产品供应商，是全球唯一获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction全球销售副总裁Doug Wagner表示： “我们很荣幸被卡特彼勒认可为认证级别供应商。“该奖项表彰了支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的出色努力和奉献精神。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle获得了SER认证，以表彰该公司对支持卡特彼勒全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. articles.title: What OSHA Cites Most in Collision Centers
articles.author: KPA

paras.en: By Zach Pucillo, Regulatory Director, KPA
paras.zh: 作者： KPA监管总监Zach Pucillo

paras.en: OSHA’s best-known top 10 list is dominated by construction hazards like falls, scaffolding, and ladders. But when you look at last year’s official citation data for collision centers, a different set of standards rises to the top.
paras.zh: OSHA最著名的前10名名单主要是建筑危险，如坠落、脚手架和梯子。但是，当您查看去年碰撞中心的官方引用数据时，一套不同的标准上升到了顶峰。

paras.en: From October 2024 through September 2025, OSHA issued 199 citations to collision centers across 10 standards. Respiratory protection and hazard communication alone made up nearly three quarters of them. Here are the top five – and if you’re interested in the full list, download KPA’s OSHA Top 10 Guide for Collision Centers.
paras.zh: 从2024年10月到2025年9月， OSHA向碰撞中心发出了199次引用，涉及10个标准。仅呼吸防护和危害沟通就占其中的近四分之三。以下是前五名–如果您对完整列表感兴趣，请下载KPA的OSHA碰撞中心十大指南。

paras.en: OSHA penalties can exceed $16,550 per serious violation, and as much per day for every day the issue isn’t fixed by OSHA’s deadline. Willful or repeated violations can cost 10 times as much.
paras.zh: 每次严重违规行为的OSHA罚款可能超过16,550 $ ，并且每天的罚款金额与OSHA截止日期未解决的问题相同。故意或反复的违规行为可能要花费10倍的费用。

paras.en: Sanding, priming, and spraying put dust, solvent vapors, and isocyanates in the air your techs breathe. OSHA expects you to control that air first through booths, ventilation, and less toxic products. When that isn’t enough, respirators are required, and so is a full program behind them.
paras.zh: 打磨、预涂和喷涂将灰尘、溶剂蒸气和异氰酸酯放入您的技术人员呼吸的空气中。OSHA希望您首先通过展位、通风和毒性较低的产品来控制空气。如果这还不够，就需要呼吸器，还需要一个完整的计划。

paras.en: That program is where shops get cited. A respirator on the hook doesn’t count if the tech wearing it was never medically evaluated, never fit tested, or never trained. OSHA also expects a written program, regular equipment checks, and records showing all of it happened.
paras.zh: 该计划是商店被引用的地方。如果佩戴呼吸器的技术人员从未接受过医学评估，从未接受过测试，或者从未接受过培训，则挂钩上的呼吸器不计算在内。OSHA还希望提供书面程序、定期设备检查和记录，以显示所有情况。

paras.en: Here’s a test you can try: if a tech couldn’t tell you when they were last fit tested, you likely have a gap.
paras.zh: 以下是一个您可以尝试的测试：如果技术人员无法告诉您他们最后一次测试的时间，那么您可能有差距。

paras.en: - Do you have a written respiratory protection program?
paras.zh: -您是否有书面的呼吸防护计划？

paras.en: - Has every respirator wearer been medically evaluated and fit tested?
paras.zh: -每个佩戴呼吸器的人都接受过医学评估和验配吗？

paras.en: - Are respirators inspected, maintained, and replaced when they stop working?
paras.zh: -当呼吸器停止工作时，是否对其进行检查、维护和更换？

paras.en: The Hazard Communication Standard is how you’re supposed to inform employees about dangerous chemicals in the workplace. It covers labeling, tracking, and training. Anywhere workers could be exposed to a chemical related injury, you need a safety data sheet (SDS) for each of those chemicals in the operation, a written hazard communication plan, and training for every exposed worker. SDS’s are considered medical records and need to be maintained at the establishment for 30 years.
paras.zh: 危害沟通标准是您应该如何告知员工有关工作场所危险化学品的信息。它涵盖标签、跟踪和培训。在工人可能暴露于化学品相关伤害的任何地方，您都需要操作中每种化学品的安全数据表（ SDS ）、书面危害沟通计划以及对每位暴露工人的培训。SDS被视为医疗记录，需要在机构保存30年。

paras.en: Violations usually come down to improper container labeling. Dealers may fail to label containers properly, omit substances from their chemical inventory, or fail to obtain SDS from manufacturers. Many get cited for not maintaining a written plan at all.
paras.zh: 违规行为通常归结为容器标签不当。经销商可能无法正确标记容器，从其化学品库存中省略物质，或未能从制造商处获得SDS。许多人因为根本没有书面计划而被引用。

paras.en: In one example I’ve seen, a dealership service technician was performing an inspection on a trade-in vehicle he had brought into the shop. While the hood was open and his back was turned, the engine caught fire due to a bad wiring connection. When the tech noticed this, he panicked, turned back to his work bench, and saw a bottle of tea sitting there. He opened the bottle and went to dump it on the fire to extinguish it. The problem was, the technician used that same bottle the day before to collect a fuel sample. Needless to say, the fire erupted and caught the employees’ clothes on fire as well. This incident shows why we need to continue supporting consistent efforts to comply with the hazard communication standard.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: - Is a written copy of your updated Hazard Communication Program available to all employees?
paras.zh: -是否向所有员工提供最新危险沟通计划的书面副本？

paras.en: - Does everyone have access to an SDS for every chemical on site?
paras.zh: -每个人都可以获得现场每种化学品的SDS吗？

paras.en: - Are all secondary chemical containers labeled?
paras.zh: -所有二级化学品容器都贴有标签吗？

paras.en: Atomized paint and solvent can ignite fast. OSHA requires approved booths or spray rooms, ventilation that removes vapors and overspray, electrical equipment rated for hazardous locations, and safe handling of flammable materials.
paras.zh: 雾化涂料和溶剂可以快速点燃。OSHA要求获得批准的展位或喷洒室、去除蒸汽和过度喷洒的通风、危险场所的电气设备以及易燃材料的安全处理。

paras.en: Most violations come from maintenance slipping. Filters clog, airflow drops, and overspray builds up on walls and floors. A non-rated fan, light, or charger ends up in the booth. Each one is a fire risk.
paras.zh: 大多数违规行为来自维护滑倒。过滤器堵塞、气流滴落和过度喷洒积聚在墙壁和地板上。非额定风扇、电灯或充电器最终会出现在展位上。每个人都有火灾风险。

paras.en: Visible overspray on booth walls and solvent smells that hang around after spraying are both signs your ventilation isn’t keeping up.
paras.zh: 喷洒后，展位墙壁上可见的过度喷洒和悬浮的溶剂气味都表明您的通风跟不上。

paras.en: - Are booth filters changed on schedule?
paras.zh: -展位过滤器是否按时更换？

paras.en: - Is overspray buildup cleaned routinely?
paras.zh: -是否定期清洁过度喷洒积聚物？

paras.en: - Is all electrical equipment in spray areas rated for hazardous locations?
paras.zh: -喷洒区域的所有电气设备是否都被评为危险位置？

paras.en: Many shops have plenty of gloves, glasses, and hearing protection and still get cited. The PPE standard requires a written, certified hazard assessment that identifies what PPE each task needs. Without it, you’re out of compliance no matter what’s on the shelf.
paras.zh: 许多商店都有大量的手套、眼镜和听力保护装置，但仍然会被引用。PPE标准要求进行书面的、经过认证的危害评估，以确定每项任务所需的PPE。没有它，无论货架上有什么，您都无法合规。

paras.en: Shortcuts are the other problem. A quick grind or a small batch of mixing feels too short to bother with eye protection. Once that becomes normal, enforcement is hard to defend.
paras.zh: 快捷方式是另一个问题。快速研磨或小批量搅拌感觉太短，无法保护眼睛。一旦这成为常态，执法就很难辩护。

paras.en: If PPE use looks different on Saturday than it does on Tuesday, an inspector will notice.
paras.zh: 如果周六的个人防护装备使用情况与周二有所不同，检查员会注意到。

paras.en: - Do you have a written, certified hazard assessment by task?
paras.zh: -您是否有一份经认证的书面风险评估（按任务） ？

paras.en: - Is PPE provided at no cost and replaced when damaged?
paras.zh: -个人防护装备是否免费提供，损坏时是否更换？

paras.en: - Is PPE use enforced the same way across every tech and shift?
paras.zh: -在每个技术和班次中，个人防护装备的使用方式是否相同？

paras.en: Lacquer thinner, reducers, MEK, and gun cleaners are everyday products in a body shop, which is exactly why they get treated casually. Containers get left open, stored outside approved cabinets, or parked near grinders and other ignition sources. OSHA limits how much can sit outside a flammable storage cabinet or room, and the limits are tighter for the most volatile liquids.
paras.zh: 稀漆剂、减速机、MEK和枪支清洁剂是车身车间的日常用品，这正是它们得到随意对待的原因。容器保持打开状态，存放在经批准的机柜外，或停放在研磨机和其他点火源附近。OSHA限制了在易燃储物柜或房间外放置的容量，对于最易挥发的液体，限制更严格。

paras.en: Walk the shop at the end of the day and count the open containers. That number tells you a lot.
paras.zh: 在一天结束时漫步商店，数一数打开的容器。这个数字告诉你很多。

paras.en: - Are flammable liquids stored in approved containers and cabinets?
paras.zh: -易燃液体是否储存在批准的容器和柜子中？

paras.en: - Are you within storage limits outside the cabinet?
paras.zh: -您是否在橱柜外的存储限制内？

paras.en: - Are ignition sources kept away from storage and transfer areas?
paras.zh: -点火源是否远离储存和转移区域？

paras.en: KPA’s OSHA Top 10 for Collision Centers covers the other five standards on the list: air contaminants, exit routes, noise exposure, sanitation, and medical services and first aid. Each one includes warning signs and a prevention checklist you can walk your shop with.
paras.zh: KPA的OSHA碰撞中心十大标准涵盖了名单上的其他五个标准：空气污染物、出口路线、噪音暴露、卫生设施、医疗服务和急救。每一个都包含警告标志和预防检查清单，您可以在商店中随身携带。

articles.title: Georgia, Oklahoma, Kansas elect new insurance commissioners; California still counting votes
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: In Georgia, Democrat Keisha Sean Waites defeated incumbent Republican John King, winning 54% of the vote.
paras.zh: 在佐治亚州，民主党人凯莎·肖恩·韦特斯 (Keisha Sean Waites) 击败了现任共和党人约翰·金 (John King)，赢得了 54% 的选票。

paras.en: King has held the position since 2019, when he was appointed by the Governor. He was elected for a full term in 2022.
paras.zh: King 自 2019 年由总督任命以来一直担任该职位。他于 2022 年当选，任期满。

paras.en: Sean Waites is a former state representative and Atlanta city councilwoman.
paras.zh: 肖恩·韦茨 (Sean Waites) 是前州代表和亚特兰大市议员。

paras.en: She also previously worked as a disaster reservist/commercial loan specialist for the U.S. Small Business Administration Disaster Assistance Division and in several Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) roles, according to her LinkedIn.
paras.zh: 根据她的 LinkedIn 信息，她此前还曾担任美国小企业管理局灾难援助部门的灾难预备役人员/商业贷款专家，以及联邦紧急事务管理局 (FEMA) 的多个职位。

paras.en: Waites says that the rate freeze initiative is a top priority on her campaign page. This includes aggressively reviewing and challenging unjustified auto and home insurance rate hikes.
paras.zh: 韦茨表示，冻结利率举措是她竞选页面上的首要任务。这包括积极审查和挑战不合理的汽车和家庭保险费率上涨。

paras.en: She also wants to end ZIP code and credit score discrimination by investing in modern equipment and faster response times for Georgia’s rural and underserved communities.
paras.zh: 她还希望通过投资现代设备并为佐治亚州的农村和服务欠缺的社区提供更快的响应时间，结束邮政编码和信用评分歧视。

paras.en: Another of Waites’s priorities is a “Consumer Fraud Strike Force” to protect seniors and vulnerable families from predatory insurance scams.
paras.zh: 韦特斯的另一个优先事项是建立“消费者欺诈打击部队”，以保护老年人和弱势家庭免受掠夺性保险诈骗。

paras.en: Republican Bob Sullivan won the race for Insurance Commissioner in Oklahoma with 59% of the vote. He ran against Democrat Craig MacIntyre.
paras.zh: 共和党人鲍勃·沙利文 (Bob Sullivan) 以 59% 的选票赢得俄克拉荷马州保险专员竞选。他与民主党人克雷格·麦金泰尔竞选。

paras.en: Current commissioner, Glen Mulready, has reached the end of his second term. Insurance commissioners in the state hold the position for four years and are limited to eight-years in the position.
paras.zh: 现任专员格伦·马尔雷迪 (Glen Mulready) 的第二个任期即将结束。该州保险专员的任期为四年，最长为八年。

paras.en: Sullivan identifies himself as a “property and casualty insurance expert” on his campaign website.
paras.zh: 沙利文在他的竞选网站上将自己称为“财产和伤亡保险专家”。

paras.en: He states his expertise includes being a certified insurance counselor, certified risk manager, chartered property and casualty underwriter, associate in Fidelity & Surety Bonding and a certified environmental specialist.
paras.zh: 他表示，他的专业知识包括成为一名经过认证的保险顾问、经过认证的风险经理、特许财产和伤亡承保人、Fidelity & Surety Bonding 助理以及经过认证的环境专家。

paras.en: Sullivan currently works for the Alera Group and previously for Rich and Cartmill, the website states.
paras.zh: 该网站称，沙利文目前在 Alera Group 工作，此前曾在 Rich 和 Cartmill 工作。

paras.en: “Bob has seen carriers pull out of Oklahoma, leaving entire industries with one option and homeowners forced to pay more—or go without,” the website states. “He’s running to restore competition, cut costs, and deliver fast, fair claims for the people who actually pay the premiums.”
paras.zh: 该网站称：“鲍勃看到运营商撤出俄克拉荷马州，让整个行业只有一种选择，而房主被迫支付更多费用，或者放弃。” “他竞选的目的是恢复竞争、削减成本，并为实际支付保费的人提供快速、公平的索赔。”

paras.en: Kansas voters elected Republican Daniel Hawkins to the insurance commissioner position with 58% of the vote. He ran against Democrat Dinah Sykes.
paras.zh: 堪萨斯州选民以 58% 的选票选举共和党人丹尼尔·霍金斯 (Daniel Hawkins) 担任保险专员一职。他与民主党人黛娜赛克斯竞选。

paras.en: The four-year position has no term limits. Vicki Schmidt, a Republican, has served in the role since 2019. She did not run again so she could pursue the Republican nomination for governor.
paras.zh: 该职位为期四年，没有任期限制。共和党人维姬·施密特 (Vicki Schmidt) 自 2019 年起担任该职务。她没有再次竞选，以便争取共和党州长提名。

paras.en: Hawkins, Republican speaker of the Kansas House of Representatives, started a career in the insurance business in 1995. He specialized in employee benefits for small businesses, according to the website.
paras.zh: 堪萨斯州众议院共和党议长霍金斯于1995年开始从事保险业务。据该网站称，他专门为小型企业提供员工福利。

paras.en: He was elected to the Kansas House in 2013.
paras.zh: 他于2013年当选为堪萨斯州众议院议员。

paras.en: “As Insurance Commissioner, I will wake up early every day and get to work, making sure we have an Insurance Department that stands strong for the hardworking people of Kansas,” Hawkins says on the website. “I’ll never stop fighting to lower costs, improve transparency, and hold fraudsters accountable.”
paras.zh: 霍金斯在网站上表示：“作为保险专员，我每天都会早起并开始工作，确保我们的保险部门能够为堪萨斯州勤劳的人民服务。” “我将永远不会停止努力降低成本、提高透明度并追究欺诈者的责任。”

paras.en: Hawkins’ website states he will focus on lower costs, holding the powerful and fraudsters accountable, and restoring competition and choice.
paras.zh: 霍金斯的网站称，他将专注于降低成本、追究有权势者和欺诈者的责任，以及恢复竞争和选择。

paras.en: As of Wednesday evening, the California race for two Democrats running for the Insurance Commissioner position was still too close to call.
paras.zh: 截至周三晚间，加州两名民主党人竞选保险专员职位的竞争仍然势均力敌。

paras.en: Jane Kim had 52.2% of the vote and Ben Allen 47.8%, as of Wednesday evening.
paras.zh: 截至周三晚上，简·金 (Jane Kim) 的得票率为 52.2%，本·艾伦 (Ben Allen) 的得票率为 47.8%。

paras.en: Political Action Committees (PACs) have contributed a record $6 million in campaign donations to the California Insurance Commission race, according to a CalMatters report.
paras.zh: 根据 CalMatters 的一份报告，政治行动委员会 (PAC) 为加州保险委员会竞选提供了创纪录的 600 万美元竞选捐款。

paras.en: The article says this includes $3.2 million to support Allen and $1.5 million to oppose Kim.
paras.zh: 文章称，这包括320万美元用于支持艾伦， 150万美元用于反对金正恩。

paras.en: Kim previously served on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, as California political director for Bernie Sanders, and as California director for the Working Families Party, according to her campaign website.
paras.zh: 根据她的竞选网站， Kim曾在旧金山监事会任职，曾担任伯尼·桑德斯的加利福尼亚州政治总监，以及工薪家庭党的加利福尼亚州总监。

paras.en: Her priorities focus on “affordable, available insurance for all,” the website states. She proposes a single-payer disaster insurance policy for state residents.
paras.zh: 该网站称，她的首要任务是“为所有人提供负担得起的保险”。她为州居民提出了单一付款人的灾难保险政策。

paras.en: The website also says she’ll ensure premiums cover claims, or lower them.
paras.zh: 该网站还表示，她将确保保险费覆盖索赔，或降低索赔金额。

paras.en: “Insurance companies should spend premium dollars on their intended purpose: protecting policyholders,” the website states. “If companies collect more than they need to cover claims and a reasonable profit, that money should go back to policyholders or be invested in statewide resilience, not huge payouts at our expense — like the $27 million salary one insurance company CEO was paid last year.”
paras.zh: 该网站称： “保险公司应将保费美元用于其预期目的：保护投保人。” “如果公司的收入超过了支付索赔和合理利润所需的收入，那么这笔钱应该返还给保单持有人，或者投资于全州的韧性，而不是像去年保险公司首席执行官支付的2700万美元那样，由我们承担巨额支出。”

paras.en: Allen has served in the state’s legislature since 2014, according to his campaign website. He lists climate and environmental policies as a focus during his tenure.
paras.zh: 根据他的竞选网站，艾伦自2014年以来一直在该州的立法机构任职。他将气候和环境政策列为任职期间的重点。

paras.en: Allen’s plan focuses on strengthening the state’s insurance market as wildfires and climate disasters intensify.
paras.zh: 随着野火和气候灾难的加剧，艾伦的计划侧重于加强该州的保险市场。

paras.en: “My plan will restore a competitive insurance market, ensure Californians are treated fairly after disasters, and build resilient communities that can withstand the climate challenges ahead,” he states on his website.
paras.zh: 他在自己的网站上表示： “我的计划将恢复竞争激烈的保险市场，确保加州人在灾难发生后得到公平对待，并建立能够承受未来气候挑战的有韧性的社区。”

paras.en: Fighting insurers that “deny and delay” and post-disaster insurer compliance are other planned action items, Allen’s site claims.
paras.zh: Allen的网站声称，打击“拒绝和拖延”以及灾后保险公司合规是其他计划中的行动项目的保险公司。

paras.en: This would include higher upfront payments for coverage, requiring insurers to clearly explain claim denials and maintain post-disaster real-time reporting on delays and outstanding claims.
paras.zh: 这将包括更高的承保前期付款，要求保险公司明确解释索赔被拒绝的原因，并保持灾后实时报告延误和未决索赔。
