articles.title: DENSO Sponsors EcoCAR Innovation Challenge
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: DENSO is sponsoring the EcoCAR Innovation Challenge, a four-year collegiate engineering competition that prepares students to become future leaders in mobility, technology and innovation. Through its sponsorship, DENSO is providing advanced radar sensors, engineering volunteer support and financial contributions to help students gain hands-on experience solving real-world automotive challenges.
paras.zh: DENSO 赞助 EcoCAR 创新挑战赛，这是一项为期四年的大学工程竞赛，旨在帮助学生成为移动、技术和创新领域的未来领导者。通过赞助，DENSO 提供先进的雷达传感器、工程志愿者支持和财务捐助，帮助学生获得解决现实世界汽车挑战的实践经验。

paras.en: Managed by Argonne National Laboratory as part of the U.S. Department of Energy’s Advanced Vehicle Technology Competitions program, the EcoCAR Innovation Challenge brings together 20 university teams from across North America. Students apply advanced engineering, super intelligence and entrepreneurial thinking to develop mobility solutions while building the technical and professional skills needed for future careers.
paras.zh: EcoCAR 创新挑战赛由阿贡国家实验室管理，是美国能源部先进车辆技术竞赛计划的一部分，汇聚了来自北美各地的 20 个大学团队。学生运用先进的工程、超智能和创业思维来开发移动解决方案，同时培养未来职业所需的技术和专业技能。

paras.en: “DENSO is committed to creating safer, smarter and more sustainable mobility while helping develop the next generation of engineers and technology leaders,” said Mike Murzyn, leader of DENSO’s North America Peace of Mind business group. “EcoCAR gives students the opportunity to work on real-world technologies, collaborate with industry experts and solve meaningful engineering challenges. We’re proud to support a program that helps build the technical talent, creativity and leadership needed to shape the future of mobility.”
paras.zh: “DENSO 致力于创造更安全、更智能和更可持续的移动出行，同时帮助培养下一代工程师和技术领导者，”DENSO 北美安心业务组负责人 Mike Murzyn 表示。 “EcoCAR 为学生提供了研究现实技术、与行业专家合作并解决有意义的工程挑战的机会。我们很自豪能够支持一个项目，帮助培养塑造未来移动出行所需的技术人才、创造力和领导力。”

paras.en: Technology Donation and Industry Relevance
paras.zh: 技术捐赠和行业相关性

paras.en: As part of its commitment, DENSO is donating advanced radar sensing technology to support vehicle development activities within the competition. DENSO has decades of experience developing sensing technologies that help enable advanced driver-assistance systems and safer mobility solutions. By providing students with access to industry-relevant technologies, the company said it is helping bridge the gap between classroom learning and real-world engineering applications.
paras.zh: 作为其承诺的一部分，电装将捐赠先进的雷达传感技术来支持竞赛中的车辆开发活动。 DENSO 拥有数十年开发传感技术的经验，有助于实现先进的驾驶员辅助系统和更安全的移动解决方案。该公司表示，通过为学生提供行业相关技术，它正在帮助缩小课堂学习与实际工程应用之间的差距。

paras.en: Competition Focus Areas and Skill Development
paras.zh: 竞赛重点领域和技能发展

paras.en: The competition challenges students to develop advanced vehicle technologies across areas such as connected and automated vehicles, battery systems, powertrain development, innovation and entrepreneurship. Through collaboration with industry sponsors and technical experts, participants gain experience that extends beyond engineering fundamentals to include project management, communication and commercialization skills.
paras.zh: 该竞赛挑战学生在互联和自动驾驶汽车、电池系统、动力总成开发、创新和创业等领域开发先进的汽车技术。通过与行业赞助商和技术专家的合作，参与者获得的经验不仅限于工程基础知识，还包括项目管理、沟通和商业化技能。

articles.title: Hybrids Forecast to Reach 32% of U.S. Sales by 2035
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Hybrids are playing a larger role in how Americans move toward electrified vehicles. A new report from the Auto Care Association and MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers forecasts substantial hybrid sales growth over the next decade. Meanwhile, U.S. battery electric vehicle (BEV) adoption continues at a slower pace than in China and Europe.
paras.zh: 混合动力汽车在美国人转向电动汽车的过程中发挥着越来越大的作用。汽车护理协会和 MEMA 售后市场供应商的一份新报告预测，未来十年混合动力车销量将大幅增长。与此同时，美国纯电动汽车 (BEV) 的采用速度仍然慢于中国和欧洲。

paras.en: Developed with Strategy&, PwC’s strategy division, the 2026 Joint Powertrain Trends & Outlook Forecast projects significant growth for hybrids. Their share of U.S. new-vehicle sales will increase from 17% in 2026 to 32% in 2035. The report also forecasts BEV market share will rise from 8% in 2025 to 25% in 2035.
paras.zh: 2026 年动力总成联合趋势与展望预测由普华永道战略部门思略特共同开发，预计混合动力汽车将出现显着增长。它们在美国新车销量中的份额将从2026年的17%增加到2035年的32%。报告还预测纯电动汽车的市场份额将从2025年的8%增加到2035年的25%。

paras.en: The findings point to a transition that includes an important hybrid phase before BEVs become more prominent.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，在纯电动汽车变得更加突出之前，存在一个过渡，其中包括一个重要的混合动力阶段。

paras.en: Hybrids Lead Key Powertrain Forecast Findings
paras.zh: 混合动力车引领关键动力总成预测结果

paras.en: – Hybrids are gaining share. The report forecasts hybrids will account for 32% of U.S. new-vehicle sales in 2035, compared with 17% in 2026.
paras.zh: – 混合动力车的市场份额正在增加。该报告预测，到 2035 年，混合动力车将占美国新车销量的 32%，而 2026 年这一比例为 17%。

paras.en: – U.S. BEV adoption trails other markets. BEVs accounted for approximately 6% of U.S. new-vehicle sales in the first half of 2026. That compares with 38% in China and an estimated 23% in European markets.
paras.zh: – 美国纯电动汽车的采用率落后于其他市场。 2026 年上半年，纯电动汽车约占美国新车销量的 6%。相比之下，中国的这一比例为 38%，欧洲市场的这一比例约为 23%。

paras.en: – Price remains a hurdle. Automakers are placing greater emphasis on models priced below $45,000, a segment that accounts for more new-vehicle sales.
paras.zh: – 价格仍然是一个障碍。汽车制造商更加重视价格低于 45,000 美元的车型，这一细分市场占新车销量的大部分。

paras.en: – Hybrids can cost less to own. Despite higher purchase prices, hybrids have lower three-year ownership costs than comparable internal combustion engine vehicles. Lower fuel costs and higher residual values contribute to the difference.
paras.zh: – 混合动力车的拥有成本更低。尽管购买价格较高，但混合动力汽车的三年拥有成本比同类内燃机汽车低。较低的燃料成本和较高的残值造成了差异。

paras.en: – Buyers will have more choices. The report expects the number of hybrid models to triple between 2025 and 2035. These include full hybrids, plug-in hybrids and range-extended vehicles.
paras.zh: – 买家将有更多选择。该报告预计，2025 年至 2035 年间，混合动力车型的数量将增加两倍。其中包括全混合动力汽车、插电式混合动力汽车和增程式汽车。

paras.en: What the Forecast Means for the Aftermarket
paras.zh: 预测对售后市场意味着什么

paras.en: The report also puts the powertrain shift in the context of a growing aftermarket. The U.S. light-vehicle aftermarket, including warranty and post-warranty activity, will grow from $543 billion in 2026 to $733 billion in 2035. That represents an increase of approximately $190 billion, or 3.4% annually.
paras.zh: 该报告还将动力总成的转变放在不断增长的售后市场的背景下。美国轻型汽车售后市场（包括保修和保修后活动）将从 2026 年的 5,430 亿美元增长到 2035 年的 7,330 亿美元。这意味着增长约 1,900 亿美元，即每年增长 3.4%。

paras.en: Consumers’ “repair, don’t replace” response to the cost of new and gently used vehicles drives growth. Price and product mix also contribute to growth as vehicle population growth remains modest.
paras.zh: 消费者对新车和旧车成本的“修理，而不是更换”反应推动了增长。由于车辆保有量增长仍然温和，价格和产品组合也有助于增长。

paras.en: Within the post-warranty market, the report forecasts parts revenue associated with electrification will grow approximately 24% annually through 2035. It also projects ADAS hardware revenue will grow approximately 23% annually.
paras.zh: 该报告预测，在保修后市场中，到 2035 年，与电气化相关的零部件收入将每年增长约 24%。 它还预计 ADAS 硬件收入将每年增长约 23%。

paras.en: “The shift toward electrification is not happening in one straight line,” said Philip Atkins, director of strategic research and planning at MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers. “Hybrids are becoming a bigger part of the picture, and suppliers need to plan for that reality. The mix of vehicles on the road will keep changing, and understanding where that demand is headed will help companies make better decisions about products and investment. This report will help companies do that.”
paras.zh: MEMA 售后市场供应商战略研究和规划总监 Philip Atkins 表示：“向电气化的转变并不是直线发生的。” “混合动力汽车正在占据更重要的地位，供应商需要针对这一现实进行规划。道路上的车辆组合将不断变化，了解需求的走向将有助于公司在产品和投资方面做出更好的决策。这份报告将帮助公司做到这一点。”

paras.en: “Price and choice matter to consumers, and the forecast makes that clear,” said Michael Chung, executive director of market intelligence at Auto Care Association. “As more hybrid models become available and automakers focus on affordability, the market is responding. This research helps aftermarket businesses understand the vehicles they will be serving in the years ahead.”
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会市场情报执行董事迈克尔·钟 (Michael Chung) 表示：“价格和选择对消费者来说很重要，这一点的预测表明了这一点。” “随着越来越多的混合动力车型上市以及汽车制造商关注可负担性，市场正在做出反应。这项研究有助于售后市场企业了解他们将在未来几年服务的车辆。”

paras.en: Auto Care Association and MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers members can access the 2026 Joint Powertrain Trends & Outlook Forecast as a membership benefit.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会和 MEMA 售后市场供应商会员可以享受 2026 年联合动力总成趋势和前景预测作为会员权益。

paras.en: Nonmembers can purchase the report at digital.autocare.org or mema.org.
paras.zh: 非会员可以在 digital.autocare.org 或 mema.org 上购买该报告。

articles.title: Coach K on ‘Building Trust and Sharing Ownership’
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: Pictured (from left): Bill Babcox, Chairman and CEO of Babcox Media, with Mike Krzyzewski, aka Coach K.
paras.zh: 图（左起）：Babcox Media 董事长兼首席执行官比尔·巴布克斯 (Bill Babcox) 与迈克·沙舍夫斯基 (Mike Krzyzewski)，又名教练 K.

paras.en: Automotive aftermarket leaders can build stronger teams by adapting how they communicate, holding their best people accountable and giving employees ownership of the work, Mike Krzyzewski told AAPEX attendees at the Keynote Breakfast on November 3, 2026.
paras.zh: Mike Krzyzewski 在 2026 年 11 月 3 日的主题早餐会上对 AAPEX 与会者表示，汽车售后市场领导者可以通过调整沟通方式、让最优秀的人员承担责任并赋予员工工作所有权来建立更强大的团队。

paras.en: The former Duke basketball coach, known as Coach K, drew on his experiences at West Point and with U.S. Olympic teams to explain how preparation and trust help talented people succeed together. His message for an industry built on relationships centered on what leaders do every day to make those relationships stronger.
paras.zh: 这位前杜克大学篮球教练，被称为 K 教练，利用他在西点军校和美国奥运代表队的经历来解释准备和信任如何帮助有才华的人共同取得成功。他向建立在关系基础上的行业传达的信息是，领导者每天所做的事情可以使这些关系更加牢固。

paras.en: “It’s on you as the leader to get your message across,” Krzyzewski said.
paras.zh: “作为领导者，你有责任传达你的信息，”沙舍夫斯基说。

paras.en: That responsibility requires leaders to keep learning. Throughout his career, he said, he viewed himself as becoming something better, with improvement always ahead of him. He encouraged attendees to approach their time at the show the same way: renew relationships, learn something new and return to their businesses better prepared.
paras.zh: 这种责任要求领导者不断学习。他说，在他的整个职业生涯中，他认为自己正在变得更好，进步总是在他前面。他鼓励与会者以同样的方式对待他们在展会上的时间：更新关系，学习新东西，并为重返业务做好更好的准备。

paras.en: Krzyzewski traced several leadership principles to West Point, including responding to setbacks by looking for solutions and building relationships in which people tell one another the truth immediately. He described that foundation as the speed to trust. When people can believe what their teammates say, they can move forward together with confidence.
paras.zh: 沙舍夫斯基将几条领导原则追溯到西点军校，包括通过寻找解决方案来应对挫折，以及建立人们立即告诉彼此真相的关系。他将这个基础描述为信任的速度。当人们能够相信队友所说的话时，他们就能满怀信心地共同前进。

paras.en: Preparation was another lesson, reinforced by his college coach, Bob Knight. Everyone wants to win, Krzyzewski said. The difference is how much work people will do to prepare themselves for it. His goal was to make his teams worthy of winning.
paras.zh: 准备工作是另一堂课，他的大学教练鲍勃·奈特（Bob Knight）强化了这一点。沙舍夫斯基说，每个人都想赢。区别在于人们会为此做多少准备工作。他的目标是让他的球队值得获胜。

paras.en: That preparation still left room for adjustments. He wrote practice plans the night before, then changed them when he or his assistants saw something that needed attention. Agility, adaptability and accountability formed his leadership framework. Agility meant reading the situation and responding. A plan gave the team direction, while observations during the work helped determine what should happen next.
paras.zh: 这项准备工作仍然留有调整的空间。他在前一天晚上写下了练习计划，然后当他或他的助手看到需要注意的事情时就改变了计划。敏捷性、适应性和责任感构成了他的领导框架。敏捷意味着了解情况并做出反应。计划为团队提供了方向，而工作期间的观察有助于确定下一步应该发生什么。

paras.en: Accountability, Krzyzewski said, means telling the truth. That includes recognizing good work and useful ideas alongside addressing problems. Doing both takes time and attention.
paras.zh: 沙舍夫斯基说，责任意味着说实话。这包括在解决问题的同时认可良好的工作和有用的想法。两者都需要时间和注意力。

paras.en: One of his toughest examples involved Kobe Bryant before the 2008 Beijing Olympics. During an exhibition game against Australia, Bryant began taking shots that fell outside the team’s expectations. Other players noticed, leaving Krzyzewski responsible for addressing it.
paras.zh: 他最艰难的例子之一是 2008 年北京奥运会前的科比·布莱恩特。在对阵澳大利亚的一场表演赛中，科比的投篮开始超出了球队的预期。其他球员注意到了，让沙舍夫斯基负责解决这个问题。

paras.en: He and his staff assembled video of the shots. The next morning, he showed Bryant the footage and explained how those decisions could undermine the team. Bryant accepted the correction.
paras.zh: 他和他的工作人员收集了这些镜头的视频。第二天早上，他向科比展示了这段录像，并解释了这些决定将如何损害球队。科比接受了更正。

paras.en: Weeks later, during the gold medal game against Spain, Bryant helped rally his teammates during a timeout. Players spoke up, took ownership of the moment and made the plays needed to win.
paras.zh: 几周后，在对阵西班牙的金牌比赛中，科比在暂停期间帮助队友团结起来。球员们大声疾呼，掌握了比赛的主动权，并做出了取胜所需的比赛。

paras.en: For Krzyzewski, that was evidence of a winning attitude developed through the team’s daily work. Leaders cannot anticipate every decision their people will need to make. They can establish the expectations and trust that help people make those decisions together.
paras.zh: 对于沙舍夫斯基来说，这是团队通过日常工作培养出的胜利态度的证据。领导者无法预测员工需要做出的每一个决定。他们可以建立期望和信任，帮助人们共同做出这些决定。

paras.en: Krzyzewski said he became more committed to empowerment as his career progressed. He asked players for input on practice plans and defensive decisions, giving them ownership of how the team would execute.
paras.zh: 沙舍夫斯基表示，随着职业生涯的发展，他变得更加致力于赋权。他要求球员们就训练计划和防守决策提出意见，让他们对球队的执行方式有自主权。

paras.en: He also wanted assistants to think like head coaches, developing their judgment while improving his own.
paras.zh: 他还希望助理教练能够像主教练一样思考，在提高自己判断力的同时培养他们的判断力。

paras.en: “You can’t teach them everything, but you can create an environment where they feel comfortable in using their talents,” he said.
paras.zh: “你无法教他们一切，但你可以创造一个环境，让他们能够轻松地发挥自己的才能，”他说。

paras.en: The same principle applied to values. Teams needed shared standards that members upheld together, including honesty, respect and responsibility for one another.
paras.zh: 同样的原则也适用于价值观。团队需要成员共同维护的共同标准，包括彼此的诚实、尊重和责任。

paras.en: “My values stayed the same. How I communicated them changed,” Krzyzewski said.
paras.zh: “我的价值观保持不变。我传达这些价值观的方式发生了变化，”沙舍夫斯基说。

paras.en: For leaders working through change, that distinction provides a practical starting point: keep the standards clear, listen to the team and give people the confidence to act on them.
paras.zh: 对于致力于变革的领导者来说，这种区别提供了一个实际的起点：保持标准清晰，倾听团队的意见，并让人们有信心按照这些标准采取行动。

articles.title: TrakMotive Earns Global TÜV Certification
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: TrakMotive announced that its global CV axle product range has achieved TÜV certification.
paras.zh: TrakMotive宣布其全球CV车桥产品系列已获得TÜV认证。

paras.en: The certification covers more than 9,700 CV axle SKUs across Europe, the United States and Mexico. The certified range includes:
paras.zh: 该认证涵盖欧洲、美国和墨西哥的 9,700 多个 CV 车轴 SKU。认证范围包括：

paras.en: - More than 3,700 SKUs for the United States
paras.zh: - 超过 3,700 个美国 SKU

paras.en: TÜV certification is recognized globally as an independent verification of product quality, testing, and manufacturing processes. TÜV-certified products are widely used across industries including automotive, electronics, industrial equipment, and medical devices.
paras.zh: TÜV 认证是全球公认的产品质量、测试和制造工艺的独立验证。 TÜV 认证的产品广泛应用于汽车、电子、工业设备和医疗器械等行业。

paras.en: TÜV conducted extensive product validation and manufacturing audits to confirm compliance with established quality and performance standards. The certification also includes ongoing annual surveillance audits and periodic product testing to maintain compliance.
paras.zh: TÜV 进行了广泛的产品验证和制造审核，以确认符合既定的质量和性能标准。该认证还包括持续的年度监督审核和定期产品测试，以保持合规性。

paras.en: “This certification represents a significant milestone for our global CV Axle program,” said Robert Zhu, TrakMotive’s Global CEO. “Achieving TÜV certification across such a broad product range demonstrates our long-term commitment to delivering dependable, high-quality products to customers worldwide.”
paras.zh: TrakMotive 全球首席执行官 Robert Zhu 表示：“这项认证代表了我们全球 CV 车桥计划的一个重要里程碑。” “在如此广泛的产品范围内获得 TÜV 认证，体现了我们为全球客户提供可靠、高质量产品的长期承诺。”

paras.en: TrakMotive says it plans to incorporate the TÜV certification mark and QR verification system across various customer touchpoints, including catalogs, digital platforms, packaging, labels, and select product markings, in accordance with TÜV usage guidelines.
paras.zh: TrakMotive 表示，计划根据 TÜV 使用指南，将 TÜV 认证标志和 QR 验证系统纳入各个客户接触点，包括目录、数字平台、包装、标签和精选产品标记。

articles.title: Exide Showcasing Automotive Battery Lineup at Automechanika Dubai
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Exide Technologies, a provider of battery solutions for automotive and industrial applications, will showcase its portfolio of automotive batteries at Automechanika Dubai 2026, Nov. 10-12 at the Dubai Exhibition Centre. The event is the MEA region’s largest international platform for the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: Exide Technologies 是一家汽车和工业应用电池解决方案提供商，将于 11 月 10 日至 12 日在迪拜展览中心举行的 Automechanika Dubai 2026 展会上展示其汽车电池产品组合。该活动是中东和非洲地区最大的汽车售后市场国际平台。

paras.en: Exide Technologies will welcome customers and industry professionals from across the GCC, Africa, Asia and the wider MEA region at Hall N, Stand 06164. The company said it will present its Automotive premium brands and product portfolio, including battery solutions for light vehicle (LV), commercial vehicle (CV), motorcycle, and marine and leisure applications.
paras.zh: Exide Technologies 将在 N 厅 06164 号展位迎接来自海湾合作委员会、非洲、亚洲和更广泛的 MEA 地区的客户和行业专业人士。该公司表示，将展示其汽车优质品牌和产品组合，包括轻型汽车 (LV)、商用车 (CV)、摩托车以及船舶和休闲应用的电池解决方案。

paras.en: As a European battery manufacturer with extensive OE experience, Exide Technologies will use the event to show how its expertise and broad product portfolio address the requirements of vehicles and operating conditions across these markets, the company said.
paras.zh: Exide Technologies 表示，作为一家拥有丰富 OE 经验的欧洲电池制造商，Exide Technologies 将利用此次活动展示其专业知识和广泛的产品组合如何满足这些市场的车辆和运行条件的要求。

paras.en: Battery Solutions for Regional Conditions
paras.zh: 适合地区条件的电池解决方案

paras.en: At Automechanika Dubai, Exide Technologies will highlight battery solutions for a wide range of vehicle applications, with emphasis on technologies relevant to the GCC, MEA and African markets:
paras.zh: 在迪拜汽配展上，Exide Technologies 将重点介绍适用于各种车辆应用的电池解决方案，重点关注与 GCC、MEA 和非洲市场相关的技术：

paras.en: - Exide Technologies’ light vehicle battery range, with a focus on heat-resistant batteries developed for high-temperature environments and demanding climatic conditions.
paras.zh: - Exide Technologies 的轻型汽车电池系列，重点关注为高温环境和苛刻气候条件开发的耐热电池。

paras.en: - The company’s commercial vehicle battery range for heavy-duty applications, including solutions designed to meet the requirements of demanding operating conditions.
paras.zh: - 该公司适用于重型应用的商用车电池系列，包括旨在满足苛刻操作条件要求的解决方案。

paras.en: - 12V battery technology and future mobility, with Exide experts available to discuss industry trends and the continuing role of 12V lead-acid batteries in today’s and tomorrow’s mobility solutions.
paras.zh: - 12V 电池技术和未来移动性，Exide 专家将讨论行业趋势以及 12V 铅酸电池在当今和未来移动解决方案中的持续作用。

paras.en: The company’s participation in Automechanika Dubai 2026 reflects its focus on developing business and customer relationships beyond Europe, particularly across the GCC, African and Asian markets.
paras.zh: 该公司参加 2026 年迪拜汽配展反映出其致力于发展欧洲以外的业务和客户关系，特别是在海湾合作委员会、非洲和亚洲市场。

paras.en: Gianluca Zucchetti, director, export automotive AM at Exide Technologies, said: “Automechanika Dubai gives us an important opportunity to meet customers and partners from across the GCC, Africa, Asia and the wider MEA region. These markets have diverse requirements, and we are looking forward to presenting our broad portfolio and discussing the battery technologies that are particularly relevant to local operating conditions. It is also a valuable opportunity to exchange views on how the automotive aftermarket is evolving and the role that 12V batteries will continue to play in future mobility.”
paras.zh: Exide Technologies 出口汽车增材制造总监 Gianluca Zucchetti 表示：“迪拜汽配展为我们提供了一个重要的机会，可以与来自海湾合作委员会、非洲、亚洲和更广泛的中东和非洲地区的客户和合作伙伴见面。这些市场有不同的需求，我们期待展示我们广泛的产品组合，并讨论与当地运营条件特别相关的电池技术。这也是一个宝贵的机会，可以就汽车售后市场如何发展以及 12V 电池在未来继续发挥的作用交换意见。”流动性。”

articles.title: NTN Employees Volunteer at Local Food Pantry
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corporation of America recently held a Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. On Oct. 27, 12 NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving. Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags for distribution to families throughout the community. Team members followed a “trick-or-treat”-style shopping process, collecting and packing items at various food stations. Items included cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix and other household necessities.
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司最近在伊利诺伊州埃尔克格罗夫村的埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室举办了社区精神与参与活动。 10 月 27 日，12 名 NTN 员工自愿在感恩节前帮助应对粮食不安全问题并支持当地家庭。志愿者花了一上午的时间组装了大约 400 个感恩节食品袋，分发给整个社区的家庭。团队成员遵循“不给糖就捣蛋”式的购物流程，在各个食品站收集和包装物品。商品包括食用油、罐装蔬菜、罐装南瓜、土豆泥、通心粉和奶酪、肉汁、布朗尼蛋糕粉和其他家庭必需品。

paras.en: In the afternoon, NTN employees helped pantry staff organize and store five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers would have needed up to a month. The NTN team completed the same work in just a few hours.
paras.zh: 下午，NTN员工帮助食品储藏室工作人员整理并存放了五个托盘的捐赠食品。据食品储藏室经理称，储藏室的正式员工和志愿者最多需要一个月的时间。 NTN团队在短短几个小时内完成了同样的工作。

paras.en: “Helping to address food insecurity is an important part of NTN’s commitment to being a responsible corporate citizen,” said Tom Mohrdieck, president and CEO of NTN Bearing Corporation of America. “This volunteer event directly supports NTN’s global Sustainable Development Goal of Zero Hunger while allowing our employees to make a meaningful difference for families in our community. Knowing that the food bags assembled will help nearly 900 families celebrate Thanksgiving made this an especially impactful event for our team. NTN is grateful for the opportunity to support the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry and the vital services it provides throughout the year.”
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司总裁兼首席执行官 Tom Mohrdieck 表示：“帮助解决粮食不安全问题是 NTN 致力于成为负责任的企业公民的重要组成部分。” “这次志愿者活动直接支持 NTN 的全球零饥饿可持续发展目标，同时让我们的员工为社区家庭做出有意义的改变。我们知道组装的食品袋将帮助近 900 个家庭庆祝感恩节，这对我们的团队来说是一次特别有影响力的活动。NTN 非常感谢有机会支持埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室及其全年提供的重要服务。”

paras.en: Community Engagement Program Supports Local Organizations
paras.zh: 社区参与计划支持当地组织

paras.en: NTN launched its Community Spirit & Engagement Program in January 2023. The program reflects the company’s commitment to responsible, ethical operations and supporting communities where it operates.
paras.zh: NTN 于 2023 年 1 月启动了社区精神和参与计划。该计划反映了公司对负责任、道德运营和支持其运营所在社区的承诺。

paras.en: Its goals include contributing time and resources to charitable organizations and encouraging employees to participate in their communities. The program also seeks to build partnerships with other groups and organizations.
paras.zh: 其目标包括为慈善组织贡献时间和资源，并鼓励员工参与社区活动。该计划还寻求与其他团体和组织建立伙伴关系。

paras.en: Food Pantry Serves 1,100 Families Monthly
paras.zh: 食品储藏室每月为 1,100 个家庭提供服务

paras.en: The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity. The pantry serves approximately 1,100 families monthly through a client-choice model. This approach allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a convenient, dignified manner.
paras.zh: 埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室为面临粮食不安全的居民提供粮食援助和相关支持服务。该食品储藏室每月通过客户选择模式为大约 1,100 个家庭提供服务。这种方法使家庭能够以方便、有尊严的方式获得营养食品和家庭必需品。

paras.en: Through partnerships with community organizations, donors and volunteers, the pantry helps local families access resources throughout the year. The pantry expects to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags from the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.
paras.zh: 通过与社区组织、捐助者和志愿者的合作，食品储藏室全年帮助当地家庭获取资源。该食品储藏室预计将在这个假期向近 900 个家庭分发感恩节食品袋。

articles.title: Federated Auto Parts Launches Holiday Diecast Giveaway
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: To celebrate the holiday season, Federated Auto Parts is conducting its annual diecast giveaway. Five winners of a limited-edition Federated collectible will be announced each Friday on the Federated Facebook pages beginning Nov. 13, with the final winners announced on Dec. 11.
paras.zh: 为了庆祝节日，联邦汽车配件公司正在举办年度压铸赠品活动。从 11 月 13 日开始，Federated 限量版收藏品的五名获奖者将于每周五在 Federated Facebook 页面上公布，最终获奖者将于 12 月 11 日公布。

paras.en: “The holiday season is the perfect time to give back to our Facebook followers, and our annual diecast giveaway is one way we can show our appreciation,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “These limited-edition Federated collectibles are sure to be a hit with the winners, whether they add them to their collections, give them as stocking stuffers or keep them as a special holiday treat.”
paras.zh: Federated Auto Parts 营销总监约翰·马库姆 (John Marcum) 表示：“节日季是回馈 Facebook 粉丝的最佳时机，每年的压铸赠品是我们表达谢意的一种方式。” “这些限量版联邦收藏品肯定会受到获奖者的欢迎，无论他们将它们添加到他们的收藏中，将它们作为圣诞礼物还是将它们作为特殊的节日礼物。”

paras.en: To enter for a chance to win, visit Federated Auto Parts and Federated Car Care on Facebook by Dec. 3 and click on the mobile link in the first post to complete the entry form. Participants can earn extra entries by sharing the contest with Facebook friends.
paras.zh: 要获得获奖机会，请于 12 月 3 日之前访问 Facebook 上的 Federated Auto Parts 和 Federated Car Care，然后单击第一篇文章中的移动链接来填写报名表。参赛者可以通过与 Facebook 好友分享比赛来赚取额外的参赛资格。

articles.title: Bo Fisher Receives 2026 AWDA Lifetime Achievement Award
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, presented its 2026 Lifetime Achievement Award in honor of Martin Fromm to Bo Fisher, Chairman and CEO of Fisher Auto Parts. The award was presented by AWDA Chairperson Fletcher Lord III on November 1 at AWDA’s 2026 Annual Conference in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 向费舍尔汽车零部件公司董事长兼首席执行官博·费舍尔颁发了 2026 年终身成就奖，以纪念马丁·弗洛姆 (Martin Fromm)。该奖项由 AWDA 主席 Fletcher Lord III 于 11 月 1 日在拉斯维加斯举行的 AWDA 2026 年年会上颁发。

paras.en: AWDA’s Lifetime Achievement Award recognizes individuals who have, over the course of many years, distinguished themselves through their unselfish commitment to, and high level of performance within, the motor vehicle aftermarket industry. The award is named in honor of former AWDA President Martin Fromm.
paras.zh: AWDA 的终身成就奖旨在表彰多年来通过对机动车辆售后市场行业的无私奉献和高水平表现而脱颖而出的个人。该奖项以 AWDA 前主席马丁·弗洛姆 (Martin Fromm) 的名字命名。

paras.en: As chairman and CEO of Fisher Auto Parts, Fisher has built upon a remarkable family legacy while leading one of the industry’s most respected independent distribution organizations. Under his leadership, the company expanded to approximately 500 company-owned locations and many more independent locations across 18 states, achieving tenfold growth over two decades while remaining debt-free.
paras.zh: 作为费舍尔汽车零部件公司的董事长兼首席执行官，费舍尔继承了卓越的家族遗产，同时领导着业内最受尊敬的独立分销组织之一。在他的领导下，该公司在 18 个州开设了约 500 个自营地点和更多独立地点，在二十年里实现了十倍的增长，同时保持无债务。

paras.en: Fisher has championed collaboration among independent distributors and built an organization grounded in relationships, customer service, integrity and commitment to the professional automotive service industry. His dedication to education continues the vision of his father, Art Fisher, through the Art Fisher Memorial Scholarship program, annual scholarships and the KOI/Fisher Training Cavalcade. His contributions earned him the Mort Schwartz Excellence in Education Award.
paras.zh: 费舍尔倡导独立分销商之间的合作，并建立了一个以关系、客户服务、诚信和对专业汽车服务行业的承诺为基础的组织。他对教育的奉献精神通过 Art Fisher 纪念奖学金计划、年度奖学金和 KOI/Fisher 培训队伍延续了他父亲 Art Fisher 的愿景。他的贡献为他赢得了莫特·施瓦茨卓越教育奖。

paras.en: Throughout his career, Fisher has demonstrated humility, loyalty, generosity and a willingness to share knowledge and opportunity. His legacy extends beyond the company he has grown to the industry he has strengthened, the people he has inspired and the opportunities he has created.
paras.zh: 在他的整个职业生涯中，费舍尔表现出了谦逊、忠诚、慷慨以及分享知识和机会的意愿。他的遗产不仅限于他所发展的公司，还包括他所强化的行业、他所激励的人们以及他所创造的机会。

articles.title: Parts Authority Announces 2026 Vendor Partner Awards
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Parts Authority, distributor of automotive replacement parts, tools and equipment, announced the winners of its 2026 vendor awards at AWDA/AAPEX Industry Week. The awards honor the suppliers and representatives whose work over the past year did the most to move the business forward.
paras.zh: 汽车替换零件、工具和设备分销商 Parts Authority 在 AWDA/AAPEX 工业周上宣布了 2026 年供应商奖的获奖者。该奖项旨在表彰过去一年中为推动业务发展作出最大贡献的供应商和代表。

paras.en: “Every one of these partners helped us serve our customers better this year,” said Clark Hale, CEO of Parts Authority. “We are grateful for the effort, reliability, and trust behind these results, and we congratulate everyone recognized.”
paras.zh: “今年，这些合作伙伴中的每一位都帮助我们更好地为客户服务，”Parts Authority 首席执行官克拉克·黑尔 (Clark Hale) 说道。 “我们对这些成果背后的努力、可靠性和信任表示感谢，并向所有获得认可的人表示祝贺。”

paras.en: Supplier of the Year: SKF. Parts Authority’s top vendor honor went to SKF for its outstanding overall contribution and the strength of its partnership across the year.
paras.zh: 年度供应商：SKF。 Parts Authority 授予 SKF 最高供应商荣誉，以表彰其全年杰出的整体贡献和强大的合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: Import Supplier of the Year: Bosch. Bosch was recognized for delivering the quality products and dependable support that Parts Authority’s import customers count on.
paras.zh: 年度进口供应商：博世。博世因提供 Parts Authority 进口客户所信赖的优质产品和可靠支持而获得认可。

paras.en: Partnership Award: DRiV. DRiV was elected for broad strategic synergy and continuous multi-category collaboration across product lines.
paras.zh: 合作伙伴奖：DRiV。 DRiV 因其广泛的战略协同和跨产品线的持续多类别合作而当选。

paras.en: Supply Chain Award: Deka. Deka was honored for keeping product moving with consistency and dependability, a key factor in meeting customer demand.
paras.zh: 供应链奖：Deka。 Deka 因保持产品的一致性和可靠性而感到荣幸，这是满足客户需求的关键因素。

paras.en: Marketing Excellence Award: Dorman. Recognized for creative installer engagement, high-impact technician education, and targeted merchandising programs that accelerated new-to-market part adoption.
paras.zh: 营销卓越奖：多尔曼。因其创造性的安装人员参与、高影响力的技术人员教育以及加速新市场零件采用的有针对性的销售计划而受到认可。

paras.en: Catalog and Data Award: Mevotech. Mevotech was recognized for the quality of its product data, including accurate listings and rich content that make parts easier to find and sell.
paras.zh: 目录和数据奖：Mevotech。 Mevotech 因其产品数据的质量而受到认可，包括准确的列表和丰富的内容，使零件更容易查找和销售。

paras.en: Brand Recognition Award: Gates. Gates received this award for a brand reputation built on quality and trust that continues to resonate with customers.
paras.zh: 品牌认可奖：盖茨。盖茨因其建立在质量和信任之上的品牌声誉而获得这一奖项，并持续与客户产生共鸣。

paras.en: New Vendor Award: Sylvania. Sylvania was welcomed with this inaugural recognition for making a strong first impression as a new Parts Authority partner.
paras.zh: 新供应商奖：Sylvania。 Sylvania 作为新的 Parts Authority 合作伙伴给人留下了深刻的第一印象，受到了这一首次认可的欢迎。

paras.en: Vendor Representative of the Year: Parts Authority named two honorees this year, Norman Charleville of Premium Guard and George Greene of Arnott Industries, for their dependable support and their role in strengthening the relationship between their companies and Parts Authority.
paras.zh: 年度供应商代表：Parts Authority 提名了今年的两位获奖者：Premium Guard 的 Norman Charleville 和 Arnott Industries 的 George Greene，以表彰他们的可靠支持以及在加强公司与 Parts Authority 之间关系方面所发挥的作用。

paras.en: Manufacturer Representative of the Year: Jim Guy of NA Williams and Hector Garcia of Stan Padover Associates, Inc. were recognized for their teamwork, their skill in balancing multi-line portfolios, supporting regional inventory initiatives, and strengthening branch-level vendor relationships.
paras.zh: 年度制造商代表：NA Williams 的 Jim Guy 和 Stan Padover Associates, Inc. 的 Hector Garcia 因其团队合作、平衡多线产品组合、支持区域库存计划和加强分支机构级供应商关系的技能而获得认可。

paras.en: The Road Warrior Award recognizes representatives who go the extra mile for customers and colleagues. This year’s recipients are:
paras.zh: 道路勇士奖旨在表彰那些为客户和同事付出额外努力的代表。今年的获奖者是：

paras.en: - Justin Masseo, Glazier Sales Associates
paras.zh: - Justin Masseo，Glazier 销售助理

paras.en: - William Shost, Glazier Sales Associates
paras.zh: - William Shost，Glazier 销售助理

paras.en: “These individuals show up, stay engaged, and make a difference every day,” said Hale. “We are proud to call them partners.”
paras.zh: “这些人每天都会出现、保持参与并做出改变，”黑尔说。 “我们很自豪称他们为合作伙伴。”

articles.title: The Case for Fewer SKUs
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Every automotive parts store faces the same inventory challenge: having the right parts available without tying up too much capital. With thousands of SKUs competing for limited shelf space, finding the right balance isn’t easy.
paras.zh: 每个汽车零部件商店都面临着同样的库存挑战：在不占用太多资金的情况下拥有合适的零部件。由于数以千计的 SKU 争夺有限的货架空间，找到适当的平衡并不容易。

paras.en: Bill Nunnery, senior director, sales and marketing, Global Aftermarket at Dana Incorporated, believes SKU consolidation can help stores address that challenge while improving customer service.
paras.zh: 达纳公司全球售后市场销售和营销高级总监 Bill Nunnery 认为，SKU 整合可以帮助商店应对这一挑战，同时改善客户服务。

paras.en: “The one challenge that every distributor is faced with is having the right part at the right place at the right time,” Nunnery said.
paras.zh: “每个分销商面临的一个挑战是在正确的时间、正确的地点提供正确的零件，”Nunnery 说。

paras.en: Inventory management involves more than keeping shelves stocked. Stores must also consider how much working capital they invest in inventory and whether those products generate sufficient sales.
paras.zh: 库存管理不仅仅涉及保持货架库存。商店还必须考虑他们在库存上投资了多少营运资金以及这些产品是否产生了足够的销售额。

paras.en: Nunnery said the industry has little tolerance for slow-moving inventory, particularly as shelf space becomes increasingly valuable. Carrying similar products from multiple suppliers can further complicate inventory management. Reducing redundant SKUs can help stores control costs while simplifying the purchasing process.
paras.zh: Nunnery 表示，该行业对库存缓慢流动的容忍度很低，尤其是在货架空间变得越来越有价值的情况下。从多个供应商那里购买类似的产品可能会使库存管理进一步复杂化。减少冗余 SKU 可以帮助商店控制成本，同时简化采购流程。

paras.en: “And so minimizing the complexity and choices is always a good thing for the customer,” Nunnery said.
paras.zh: “因此，最大限度地减少复杂性和选择对客户来说始终是一件好事，”Nunnery 说。

paras.en: That means fewer overlapping options to navigate while helping customers identify the appropriate products for their applications.
paras.zh: 这意味着导航的重叠选项更少，同时帮助客户确定适合其应用的产品。

paras.en: Counter pros see firsthand which products customers request most often and which alternatives can serve multiple applications. That experience can provide valuable insight into inventory decisions, particularly when stores evaluate overlapping products or identify opportunities to simplify their assortments.
paras.zh: 柜台专业人员可以直接了解客户最常需要哪些产品以及哪些替代品可以服务于多种应用。这种经验可以为库存决策提供有价值的见解，特别是当商店评估重叠产品或确定简化其分类的机会时。

paras.en: Nunnery pointed to Dana’s Reinzosil universal sealing compound as an example of how SKU consolidation can benefit parts stores and repair shops.
paras.zh: Nunnery 指出，Dana 的 Reinzosil 通用密封剂是 SKU 整合如何使零件店和维修店受益的示例。

paras.en: According to Nunnery, one tube of Reinzosil can replace 10 to 12 conventional RTV sealant varieties. That allows distributors to reduce inventory requirements while offering a product that serves multiple applications.
paras.zh: 据 Nunnery 介绍，一管 Reinzosil 可以替代 10 至 12 种传统 RTV 密封胶品种。这使得分销商能够减少库存需求，同时提供服务于多种应用的产品。

paras.en: The benefits extend into the repair bay. A technician might otherwise keep 10 or 12 different tubes of RTV sealant in a toolbox. Those tubes take up space, and their contents have a limited shelf life.
paras.zh: 这些好处还延伸到了维修区。否则，技术人员可能会在工具箱中保存 10 或 12 管不同的 RTV 密封剂。这些管子占用空间，而且其内容物的保质期有限。

paras.en: “You’ve got to remember this is a perishable item,” Nunnery said.
paras.zh: “你必须记住，这是一种容易腐烂的物品，”纳纳里说。

paras.en: Consolidating those products into one sensor-safe solution can simplify inventory management for technicians while reducing the number of individual products they must purchase and maintain. The same principle applies at the parts store.
paras.zh: 将这些产品整合到一个传感器安全的解决方案中可以简化技术人员的库存管理，同时减少他们必须购买和维护的单个产品的数量。同样的原则也适用于零件店。

paras.en: Nunnery noted that an automotive retailer or independent parts store might dedicate 10 to 12 linear feet of shelf space to RTV products. He estimated that consolidating the category around a universal solution could reduce merchandising requirements by 70% to 80%. That would free valuable space for other products without requiring additional shelving or warehouse capacity.
paras.zh: Nunnery 指出，汽车零售商或独立零部件商店可能会专门为 RTV 产品预留 10 至 12 英尺的货架空间。他估计，围绕通用解决方案整合品类可以将销售需求减少 70% 至 80%。这将为其他产品释放宝贵的空间，而无需额外的货架或仓库容量。

paras.en: Of course, reducing SKUs shouldn’t come at the expense of product availability or application coverage. Nunnery emphasized that distributors must evaluate consolidation opportunities with their customers’ needs in mind.
paras.zh: 当然，减少 SKU 不应以牺牲产品可用性或应用程序覆盖范围为代价。 Nunnery 强调，分销商必须考虑客户的需求来评估整合机会。

paras.en: “I think when they’re deciding on consolidation, I think it always, again, it starts with the customer first,” he said.
paras.zh: “我认为，当他们决定整合时，我认为总是以客户为先，”他说。

paras.en: That philosophy should guide inventory decisions throughout the distribution chain. Manufacturers and distributors can use category management analytics to identify opportunities to reduce inventory while maintaining appropriate application coverage.
paras.zh: 这一理念应该指导整个分销链的库存决策。制造商和分销商可以使用类别管理分析来确定减少库存的机会，同时保持适当的应用覆盖范围。

paras.en: Ultimately, successful SKU consolidation requires collaboration between manufacturers and distributors. The objective isn’t simply to stock fewer products. It’s to reduce unnecessary complexity, make better use of available resources and ensure customers can get the products they need.
paras.zh: 最终，成功的 SKU 整合需要制造商和分销商之间的合作。目标不仅仅是减少产品库存。这是为了减少不必要的复杂性，更好地利用可用资源并确保客户可以获得他们需要的产品。

paras.en: For parts stores, that’s a strategy that can benefit both sides of the counter.
paras.zh: 对于零件店来说，这是一种对柜台双方都有利的策略。

articles.title: Rare fifth-century burials of Germanic chieftains with dazzling weapons and warhorses discovered in France
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists excavating in northeastern France have unearthed a small fifth-century cemetery containing the graves of two Germanic chieftains and two warhorses. The burial ground is providing new information about the transitional period after the fall of the Roman Empire.
paras.zh: 考古学家在法国东​​北部挖掘发现了一个五世纪的小墓地，里面埋葬着两位日耳曼酋长和两匹战马。该墓地提供了有关罗马帝国灭亡后过渡时期的新信息。

paras.en: The burial complex was discovered near the city of Colmar, just a few miles from the Rhine River, which forms the border between France and Germany. This area had a Gallo-Roman village from the first to the third centuries, and archaeologists found several ancient houses, hearths, wells and craft areas, according to a Nov. 6 translated statement from the French National Institute for Preventive Archaeological Research (Inrap).
paras.zh: 该墓葬群是在科尔马市附近发现的，距离法国和德国边界的莱茵河仅几英里。根据法国国家预防考古研究所 (Inrap) 11 月 6 日翻译的声明，该地区从一世纪到三世纪就有一个高卢罗马村庄，考古学家发现了几处古老的房屋、壁炉、水井和手工艺区。

paras.en: Archaeologists also uncovered a rare fifth-century cemetery at the site, which was used from about A.D. 450 to 500, a critical time period in Western Europe because of the collapse of the Roman Empire. While scholars have debated for centuries about why the empire fell, one key issue was the repeated occupation of Rome in the fifth century by Germanic tribes known as the Goths and the Vandals.
paras.zh: 考古学家还在该遗址发现了一座罕见的五世纪墓地，该墓地的使用时间约为公元 450 年至 500 年，这是罗马帝国崩溃后西欧的一个关键时期。尽管学者们对帝国衰落的原因争论了几个世纪，但一个关键问题是五世纪时被称为哥特人和汪达尔人的日耳曼部落反复占领罗马。

paras.en: Archaeologists discovered 11 adult graves, three graves of children and two horse burials at the site, according to the statement. In two of the female burials, archaeologists found silver bird-shaped brooches, glass bead necklaces and a bone comb, suggesting that these may have been high-status women.
paras.zh: 声明称，考古学家在现场发现了11座成人坟墓、3座儿童坟墓和两座马墓。在两处女性墓葬中，考古学家发现了银质鸟形胸针、玻璃珠项链和骨梳，表明这些墓葬可能是地位较高的女性。

paras.en: But two of the male burials, in particular, stood out because of their high-quality grave goods, including a sword with a partially preserved wooden scabbard, a shield, a javelin and a scramasax, a type of Germanic short sword, which was decorated with a gold-and-garnet accessory. The weapons are characteristic of the burials of Germanic chieftains or mercenaries, according to the archaeologists, and two horses were buried nearby with their harnesses.
paras.zh: 但其中两座男性墓葬因其高品质的随葬品而引人注目，其中包括一把部分保存有木质刀鞘的剑、一面盾牌、一把标枪和一把双刃斧（一种日耳曼短剑，上面装饰着黄金和石榴石配件）。据考古学家称，这些武器是日耳曼酋长或雇佣兵墓葬的特征，附近埋有两匹马和他们的挽具。

paras.en: In addition to the weapons and warhorses, archaeologists noticed evidence on the men's bones that hinted that the individuals were likely warriors. Two people suffered stab wounds that showed no signs of healing, which suggests they died quickly and violently, according to the statement. And another man's right knee bones had completely fused together, which would have prevented him from bending it. This condition, called ankylosis, commonly results from an improperly healed injury.
paras.zh: 除了武器和战马之外，考古学家还注意到这些人骨头上的证据，这些证据表明这些人可能是战士。声明称，有两人被刺伤，没有愈合的迹象，这表明他们死得迅速而暴力。而另一个人的右膝骨已经完全融合在一起，根本无法弯曲。这种情况称为强直，通常是由于损伤愈合不当造成的。

paras.en: The archaeologists believe the warrior's grave goods weren't just for show, but further study of the skeletons is planned to confirm whether the injuries seen during the excavation could have been sustained in a conflict.
paras.zh: 考古学家认为，这位战士的随葬品不仅仅是为了展示，而且计划对骨骼进行进一步研究，以确认挖掘过程中看到的伤害是否可能是在冲突中造成的。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Few Germanic settlements and cemeteries from the fifth century have been found, so the newly excavated site should provide important information about the upheavals linked to the fall of the Western Roman Empire and how that political collapse affected communities on the edge of the empire.
paras.zh: 几乎没有发现五世纪的日耳曼定居点和墓地，因此新发掘的遗址应该提供有关与西罗马帝国衰落相关的动乱以及政治崩溃如何影响帝国边缘社区的重要信息。

paras.en: Can you identify these historical objects of war? Test your smarts with our weapons of the world quiz!
paras.zh: 你能认出这些战争历史文物吗？用我们的世界武器测验来测试你的智慧！

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Would you learn to lucid dream if you could?
articles.author: Nicoletta Lanese

paras.en: During dreams, bizarre scenes you encounter can seem as tangible as reality; you feel as though you're really flying through the sky or being chased through a jungle of bright-purple trees. But in special cases, people realize they're in the midst of a dream as it's unfolding.
paras.zh: 在梦中，你遇到的奇异场景就像现实一样真实；你感觉自己好像真的在天空中飞翔，或者在一片亮紫色树木的丛林中被追赶。但在特殊情况下，人们会意识到自己正处于梦境之中。

paras.en: Called lucid dreaming, this phenomenon occurs when we suddenly regain our capacity for metacognition, or thinking about our own thoughts, in the middle of a dream. Lucid dreamers can sometimes even control the content or trajectory of their dreams. Now, researchers claim that they've found a way to "train" people to lucid dream by having them meditate and complete virtual-reality-augmented exercises while they're awake.
paras.zh: 这种现象被称为清醒梦，当我们在梦中突然恢复元认知能力或思考自己的想法时，就会发生这种现象。清醒梦者有时甚至可以控制梦的内容或轨迹。现在，研究人员声称他们已经找到了一种方法，通过让人们在清醒时进行冥想和完成虚拟现实增强练习来“训练”人们进入清醒梦。

paras.en: In a study involving a few dozen participants, the scientists found that repeating this training twice a week for a month significantly increased how often participants experienced lucid dreaming. They say the approach could have practical applications as an intervention for people with nightmares, anxiety or post-traumatic stress disorder — but those applications are theoretical, for now.
paras.zh: 在一项涉及数十名参与者的研究中，科学家们发现，每周重复两次这种训练，持续一个月，参与者经历清醒梦的频率显着增加。他们表示，这种方法可以作为对噩梦、焦虑或创伤后应激障碍患者的干预措施而具有实际应用，但目前这些应用还只是理论上的。

paras.en: If you could learn how to lucid dream, would you? Let us know in the poll below, and add your thoughts in the comments.
paras.zh: 如果你能学会如何做清醒梦，你会吗？请在下面的投票中告诉我们，并在评论中添加您的想法。

paras.en: Nicoletta Lanese is the health channel editor at Live Science and was previously a news editor and staff writer at the site. She is a recipient of the 2026 AHCJ International Health Study Fellowship, with a project focused on antibiotic stewardship practices in Japan and the U.S. They hold a graduate certificate in science communication from UC Santa Cruz and degrees in neuroscience and dance from the University of Florida. Beyond Live Science, Lanese's work has appeared in The Scientist, Science News, the Mercury News, Mongabay and Stanford Medicine Magazine, among other outlets. Based in NYC, she also remains involved in dance and performs in local choreographers' work.
paras.zh: Nicoletta Lanese 是 Live Science 的健康频道编辑，此前曾担任该网站的新闻编辑和特约撰稿人。她是 2026 年 AHCJ 国际健康研究奖学金的获得者，该项目的重点是日本和美国的抗生素管理实践。他们拥有加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书以及佛罗里达大学的神经科学和舞蹈学位。除了《Live Science》之外，Lanese 的作品还出现在《科学家》、《科学新闻》、《水星新闻》、《Mongabay》和《斯坦福医学杂志》等媒体上。她以纽约为基地，仍然参与舞蹈并在当地编舞家的工作中表演。

articles.title: Highly active Russian volcano plays peek-a-boo with an astronaut
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: Where is it? Atlasov Island, off the coast of Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula [50.84755357, 155.56126752]
paras.zh: 它在哪里？阿特拉索夫岛，俄罗斯堪察加半岛海岸 [50.84755357, 155.56126752]

paras.en: What's in the photo? The summit of Alaid volcano peeking above a thick layer of low-lying clouds
paras.zh: 照片里有什么？阿莱德火山的山顶在厚厚的低云层上方窥视

paras.en: Who took the photo? An unnamed astronaut on board the International Space Station
paras.zh: 照片是谁拍的？国际空间站上的一名未透露姓名的宇航员

paras.en: This eye-catching astronaut photo shows a towering, highly active Russian volcano poking its head above a thick bank of swirling clouds over the Kuril Islands.
paras.zh: 这张引人注目的宇航员照片显示了一座高耸、高度活跃的俄罗斯火山从千岛群岛上空厚厚的漩涡云层中伸出头来。

paras.en: The lofty peak is located on Atlasov Island, the northernmost of the Kuril Islands — a chain of roughly 50 largely uninhabited volcanic landmasses stretching along a fault line that runs between Russia and Japan in the Sea of Okhotsk. Altasov lies 40 miles (65 kilometers) off Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula, which is also renowned for its volcanic activity.
paras.zh: 这座高耸的山峰位于千岛群岛最北端的阿特拉索夫岛，该岛由大约 50 个基本上无人居住的火山陆块组成，沿着鄂霍次克海俄罗斯和日本之间的断层线延伸。阿尔塔索夫距俄罗斯堪察加半岛 40 英里（65 公里），该半岛也因其火山活动而闻名。

paras.en: The island consists mainly of a single, massive volcano, called Alaid, which is known for its near-perfect cone shape. Alaid reaches up to 7,497 feet (2,285 meters) above sea level, making it the tallest peak in the Kuril Islands.
paras.zh: 该岛主要由一座名为阿莱德的巨大火山组成，以其近乎完美的圆锥形而闻名。阿莱德海拔高达 7,497 英尺（2,285 米），是千岛群岛的最高峰。

paras.en: Alaid has erupted at least nine times in the past 50 years, including a major outburst in April 1981 that ejected a 1,250-mile-long (2,000 km) plume of thick smoke and ash into the atmosphere, according to the Smithsonian Institution's Global Volcanism Program.
paras.zh: 根据史密森学会的全球火山计划，阿莱德火山在过去 50 年中至少喷发过 9 次，其中包括 1981 年 4 月的一次大喷发，当时喷发了 1,​​250 英里（2,000 公里）长的浓烟和火山灰到大气中。

paras.en: Its most recent eruption occurred between September and November 2022, when a river of lava flowed down its flank (see below). During this outburst, the volcano also spit out smoke and ash that was spotted from space alongside another eruption plume coming from the nearby island Paramushir.
paras.zh: 最近一次喷发发生在 2022 年 9 月至 11 月期间，当时熔岩河从其侧面流下（见下文）。在这次喷发期间，火山还喷出烟雾和火山灰，这些烟雾和火山灰与来自附近帕拉穆希尔岛的另一股喷发羽流一起从太空中被发现。

paras.en: In the astronaut's photo, roughly half of Atlasov Island rises above a deep, low-lying bank of swirling clouds. The summit of Alaid, crowned by a roughly mile-wide (1.6 km) caldera, is also obscured by clouds. (The volcano was not erupting when the photo was taken.)
paras.zh: 在宇航员的照片中，阿特拉索夫岛大约一半的面积耸立在低洼的漩涡云层之上。阿莱德峰顶上有一个大约一英里宽（1.6 公里）的火山口，也被云层遮盖。 （拍照时火山尚未喷发。）

paras.en: Farther down the volcano's flanks are a series of snow-filled gullies carved out by lava flows from previous eruptions. Eagle-eyed viewers may also be able to spot some parasitic cones — small openings where lava burst through in the past — around the edge of the cloud layer, according to NASA's Earth Observatory.
paras.zh: 火山侧翼的更深处是一系列被积雪覆盖的沟壑，这些沟壑是由先前喷发的熔岩流冲刷出来的。据美国宇航局地球观测站称，眼尖的观察者或许还能够在云层边缘发现一些寄生锥体——过去熔岩喷涌而出的小开口。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The area surrounding a cluster of parasitic cones on the volcano's northwest flank (top right in the photo) is devoid of vegetation — a result of another major eruption in 1972, which scoured the surrounding landscape with hot ash. A 2009 study revealed fresh signs of recovery in the affected area, but noted that it could take hundreds of years for vegetation to return to pre-eruption levels.
paras.zh: 火山西北侧（照片右上）的一群寄生锥周围的区域没有植被——这是 1972 年另一次大规模火山喷发的结果，火山喷发的热火山灰冲刷了周围的景观。 2009 年的一项研究揭示了受影响地区恢复的新迹象，但指出植被可能需要数百年才能恢复到喷发前的水平。

paras.en: The clouds are not the only thing the island rises above. Alaid is essentially the summit of a much larger underwater volcano that lies beneath the Sea of Okhotsk. The rest of the island has grown around the exposed cone as lava flows have reached sea level and solidified. Millions of years ago, this larger volcano was likely connected to the Kamchatka Peninsula via a land bridge that has since been submerged.
paras.zh: 云层并不是这座岛屿唯一升起的地方。阿莱德本质上是鄂霍次克海下方一座更大的水下火山的山顶。随着熔岩流达到海平面并凝固，岛屿的其余部分围绕暴露的锥体生长。数百万年前，这座较大的火山可能通过一座陆桥与堪察加半岛相连，但后来已被淹没。

paras.en: Astronauts and satellites have snapped several other stunning shots of intriguing landmasses nearby, including a quartet of end-to-end volcanoes on Simushir Island and a set of volcanic "nesting dolls" on Onekotan Island.
paras.zh: 宇航员和卫星还拍摄了附近迷人陆地的其他几张令人惊叹的照片，其中包括 Simushir 岛上的四座端到端火山和 Onekotan 岛上的一组火山“筑巢娃娃”。

paras.en: And in 2022, the Landsat 8 satellite also spotted the iconic summit of Mount Vesuvius peeking through a gap in the clouds over Italy, just like Alaid.
paras.zh: 2022 年，Landsat 8 卫星还发现了意大利上空云层缝隙中的标志性维苏威火山山顶，就像阿莱德一样。

paras.en: A 2024 astronaut photo shows the icy surface of Pangong Lake breaking apart in the lofty Tibetan Plateau. The point where the ice meets the water almost perfectly matches a disputed border between China and India.
paras.zh: 一张 2024 年宇航员拍摄的照片显示，班公湖的冰面在高耸的青藏高原上破裂。冰与水的交汇点几乎完美地符合中国和印度之间有争议的边界。

paras.en: A 2020 astronaut photo shows the unique structure of Ol Doinyo Lengai, an active stratovolcano in Tanzania that was recently adorned with a bright white "ash cone." The explosive peak produces a rare type of lava that is unusually cool but travels remarkably quickly.
paras.zh: 一张 2020 年宇航员照片显示了 Ol Doinyo Lengai 的独特结构，这是坦桑尼亚的一座活层火山，最近装饰着亮白色的“火山灰锥”。爆炸峰产生了一种罕见的熔岩，这种熔岩异常凉爽，但传播速度非常快。

paras.en: A 2010 satellite photo shows the point where a small lake bisects the snowy rim of an ancient glacier on Canada's Baffin Island. The rippling, snow-rimmed structure is the last remaining fragment of a colossal ice sheet that once covered large parts of North America.
paras.zh: 2010 年的一张卫星照片显示了加拿大巴芬岛上一个小湖将古老冰川的雪缘一分为二的地方。这座波光粼粼、雪边的结构是曾经覆盖北美大部分地区的巨大冰盖的最后残留碎片。

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。

articles.title: The Maya Loved Using Mercury-Rich Red Paint to Decorate Pottery, Temple Walls and Even Burials. They May Have Accidentally Poisoned Their Own Water and Food Supply in the Process

paras.en: The Maya loved cinnabar, a bright red ore used to decorate pottery, burial sites, structures and more. But cinnabar is roughly 86 percent mercury, a highly toxic element that can harm humans, animals and ecosystems.
paras.zh: 玛雅人喜欢朱砂，这是一种鲜红色的矿石，用于装饰陶器、墓地、建筑物等。但朱砂大约含有 86% 的汞，这是一种剧毒元素，会危害人类、动物和生态系统。

paras.en: The Maya used so much of this prized pigment that they polluted some of their cities. Now, new research suggests the Maya’s cinnabar-derived mercury contamination was even more widespread than previously thought—and it could have contributed to the civilization’s downfall.
paras.zh: 玛雅人大量使用这种珍贵的颜料，以至于污染了一些城市。现在，新的研究表明，玛雅人朱砂产生的汞污染比之前想象的更为广泛，而且它可能导致了文明的衰落。

paras.en: Testing of ancient sediment from two lakes in modern-day Mexico’s Yucatán Peninsula has revealed high concentrations of mercury during ancient Maya occupation. The findings, published November 4 in the journal Science Advances, suggest mercury pollution took a toll on the lakes’ aquatic ecosystems, causing their populations of aquatic creatures to decline or collapse. If the Maya ate fish or drank water from the lakes, they could have been exposed to toxic concentrations of mercury for decades or even centuries.
paras.zh: 对现代墨西哥尤卡坦半岛两个湖泊的古代沉积物进行的测试显示，在古代玛雅人占领期间，汞浓度很高。 11 月 4 日发表在《科学进展》杂志上的研究结果表明，汞污染对湖泊的水生生态系统造成了损害，导致水生生物数量减少或崩溃。如果玛雅人吃鱼或喝湖水，他们可能会接触有毒浓度的汞数十年甚至数百年。

paras.en: In 2022, scientists reported finding high levels of mercury at several archaeological sites in the Maya’s southern highlands and south-central lowlands, attributing the contamination to the use of cinnabar. The new study, conducted by a different team of researchers, builds on that work, investigating mercury levels at bodies of water in the Maya’s northern lowlands.
paras.zh: 2022 年，科学家报告称，在玛雅南部高地和中南部低地的多个考古遗址发现了高含量的汞，并将污染归因于朱砂的使用。这项新研究由另一个研究小组进行，以这项工作为基础，调查了玛雅北部低地水体中的汞含量。

paras.en: Researchers stuck long, heavy, hollow cylinders deep into the lakebeds of two lakes near ancient Maya cities, Coba and Xcach (pronounced “scotch”). They pulled up thick columns of sediment that had preserved centuries of environmental history, layer by layer.
paras.zh: 研究人员将又长又重的空心圆柱体深深插入玛雅古城科巴和Xcach（发音为“scotch”）附近的两个湖的湖床中。他们逐层拉起厚厚的沉积物柱，这些沉积物保存了几个世纪的环境历史。

paras.en: At one site, Lago Coba, the sediment revealed centuries of elevated mercury levels, lasting from around 40 C.E. to 300 C.E. That corresponds with the end of the late Preclassic Period and the beginning of the Classic Period, which is considered the golden age of Maya civilization.
paras.zh: 在科巴湖 (Lago Coba) 的一个地点，沉积物显示了几个世纪以来汞含量的升高，从公元 40 年左右持续到公元 300 年。这对应于前古典时期晚期的结束和古典时期的开始，古典时期被认为是玛雅文明的黄金时代。

paras.en: At Cenote Xcach, mercury levels spiked three different times: First, from roughly 125 C.E. to 200 C.E., just before the Classic Period; again, from 330 to 350 C.E., in the middle of the Classic Period; and, finally, from 535 C.E. to 820 C.E., toward the end of the Classic Period.
paras.zh: 在 Cenote Xcach，汞含量在三个不同的时期出现峰值：首先是从大约公元 125 年到公元 200 年，即古典时期之前；再次，公元 330 年至 350 年，古典时期中期；最后，从公元 535 年到公元 820 年，古典时期即将结束。

paras.en: Some of the samples had mercury levels of 2.3 parts per million, which is over 1,000 times more concentrated than the 2 parts per billion maximum contaminant level set by the Environmental Protection Agency for safe drinking water. The Maya people who lived near the lakes would have been exposed to these high levels for years.
paras.zh: 其中一些样品的汞含量为百万分之 2.3，比美国环境保护局针对安全饮用水设定的十亿分之二的最高污染物含量高出 1,000 倍以上。居住在湖泊附近的玛雅人多年来一直暴露在如此高的浓度下。

paras.en: “The mercury data was crazy,” lead author Matthew Waters, an environmental scientist at Auburn University, says in a statement. “Off the charts. These mercury levels aren’t normal.”
paras.zh: “汞数据太疯狂了，”主要作者、奥本大学环境科学家马修·沃特斯在一份声明中说。 “超出了图表。这些汞含量不正常。”

paras.en: The scientists also looked at various biological markers in the ancient sediments, which revealed that bacteria, algae, shelled organisms, midges and other populations had decreased or vanished during the high mercury periods.
paras.zh: 科学家们还研究了古代沉积物中的各种生物标记，这些标记表明细菌、藻类、带壳生物、蠓和其他种群在高汞时期减少或消失。

paras.en: These results suggest mercury was making its way up the food web. Based on their proximity to and penchant for fish and shellfish, the Maya could have suffered from mercury poisoning, which can cause damage to the central nervous system, kidneys, lungs and heart.
paras.zh: 这些结果表明汞正在进入食物网。由于玛雅人对鱼类和贝类的亲近和喜爱，他们可能患有汞中毒，汞中毒会对中枢神经系统、肾脏、肺和心脏造成损害。

paras.en: At the very least, the Maya living near the lakes would have seen “a strange color change in the water … and a drop in its productivity, such as fish for protein,” Waters tells Live Science’s Tom Metcalfe.
paras.zh: 沃特斯告诉《生活科学》杂志的汤姆·梅特卡夫，至少，生活在湖泊附近的玛雅人会看到“水发生了奇怪的颜色变化......并且其生产力下降，例如鱼类蛋白质的下降”。

paras.en: The scientists suspect the Maya imported cinnabar to Coba and Xcach because it does not occur naturally in the Yucatán Peninsula. If confirmed, this hunch could add cinnabar to the list of valuable commodities traded across the Maya world, alongside obsidian, jade and weapons. Researchers hope to take core samples from lakes located near Maya trade hubs to further explore this idea.
paras.zh: 科学家怀疑玛雅人将朱砂引入了科巴和Xcach，因为朱砂在尤卡坦半岛并不自然存在。如果这一预感得到证实，朱砂可能会与黑曜石、玉石和武器一起加入到玛雅世界的贵重商品交易清单中。研究人员希望从玛雅贸易中心附近的湖泊中采集岩芯样本，以进一步探索这一想法。

paras.en: In 2025, a team of archaeologists working at the Maya site of Caracol in modern-day Belize discovered the cinnabar-coated tomb of dynasty founder Te K’ab Chaak.
paras.zh: 2025 年，一组考古学家在位于现代伯利兹的卡拉科尔玛雅遗址发现了王朝创始人 Te K’ab Chaak 的朱砂坟墓。

paras.en: - The finds included more than 100 shards of obsidian, jade and shell that composed a mosaic death mask for the deceased ruler.
paras.zh: - 这些发现包括 100 多块黑曜石、玉石和贝壳碎片，为已故统治者制作了马赛克死亡面具。

paras.en: They’re also investigating another theory: whether mercury poisoning might have played a role in the abandonment of several large Maya cities toward the end of the Classic Period.
paras.zh: 他们还在研究另一种理论：汞中毒是否可能在古典时期末期几个玛雅大城市的废弃中发挥了作用。

paras.en: Scientists have put forward numerous theories to explain this collapse, ranging from overpopulation and warfare to drought and deforestation. The new paper doesn’t directly link mercury to the demise of these Maya cities, but it does add “one more stressor” to the list of pressures scientists know the civilization was already facing, study co-author Savanna Wooten, an environmental scientist at the Jones Center at Ichauway, a nonprofit research facility in Georgia, tells Reuters’ Will Dunham.
paras.zh: 科学家们提出了许多理论来解释这种崩溃，从人口过剩和战争到干旱和森林砍伐。这篇新论文并没有直接将汞与这些玛雅城市的灭亡联系起来，但它确实在科学家们所知道的文明已经面临的压力清单上添加了“另一个压力源”，该研究的合著者、佐治亚州非营利性研究机构伊肖韦琼斯中心的环境科学家萨凡娜·伍滕告诉路透社的威尔·邓纳姆。

articles.title: Octopuses Are the Ultimate Escape Artists. Now Scientists Know How the Creatures Contort Themselves to Squeeze Through Tiny Holes

paras.en: Octopuses are talented escape artists, capable of squeezing their bodies through seemingly impenetrable gaps to avoid danger, find hidden prey or break out of captivity. Scientists have long wondered how these eight-limbed creatures manage such impressive feats of flexibility. Now, they say they have some answers.
paras.zh: 章鱼是天才的逃脱艺术家，它们能够将自己的身体挤过看似无法穿透的缝隙，以避免危险、寻找隐藏的猎物或挣脱束缚。长期以来，科学家们一直想知道这些八肢生物是如何实现如此令人印象深刻的灵活性的。现在，他们说他们有了一些答案。

paras.en: A study published November 5 in the Journal of Experimental Biology describes the step-by-step processes some octopuses use to cram themselves into tight spaces. In addition to expanding our understanding of these crafty cephalopods, the findings could help engineers improve the design of soft robots that need to fit into small spaces, such as those used during search-and-rescue missions.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日发表在《实验生物学杂志》上的一项研究描述了一些章鱼将自己塞进狭小空间的逐步过程。除了扩大我们对这些狡猾的头足类动物的了解之外，这些发现还可以帮助工程师改进需要适应狭小空间的软机器人的设计，例如在搜救任务中使用的软机器人。

paras.en: “You always just think as a biologist that this is a minor question: How to squeeze your body into a crevice, through a hole or into a cave,” study co-author Michael Kuba, a biologist at the University of Naples Federico II in Italy, tells IFLScience’s Rachael Funnell. “But working with soft robotic engineers, you realize that there is so much more to how they manage to do this. They have several steps of the movement, and they have specific postures and body parts they use to move through a hole.”
paras.zh: “作为一名生物学家，你总是认为这是一个小问题：如何将你的身体挤进缝隙、洞或洞穴中，”研究合著者、意大利那不勒斯费德里科二世大学的生物学家迈克尔·库巴 (Michael Kuba) 告诉 IFLScience 的 Rachael Funnell。 “但是与软机​​器人工程师一起工作，你会意识到他们如何做到这一点还有很多。他们有几个运动步骤，并且他们有特定的姿势和身体部位用于穿过洞。”

paras.en: In the study, Kuba and colleagues conducted laboratory experiments involving three subadult common octopuses (Octopus vulgaris) and four juvenile Mayan octopuses (O. maya). The team started by measuring the distance between each animal’s eyes to determine the size of the semi-rigid cartilage casing surrounding their brains. Then, they adjusted a clear, acrylic tank partition to create a single, central hole that was either smaller or larger than the measurements, which ranged from about 0.4 to 1.4 inches. One at a time, they placed the octopuses in the tank, then watched and filmed what happened next.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，库巴和同事进行了实验室实验，涉及三只亚成年普通章鱼（Octopus vulgaris）和四只幼年玛雅章鱼（O.maya）。研究小组首先测量每只动物眼睛之间的距离，以确定它们大脑周围的半刚性软骨外壳的大小。然后，他们调整了透明的丙烯酸水箱隔板，以创建一个比测量值更小或更大的单个中心孔，测量值的范围约为 0.4 到 1.4 英寸。他们一次一只地把章鱼放入水箱中，然后观察并拍摄接下来发生的事情。

paras.en: “We know that they can squeeze through all these spaces, but nobody’s actually looked at how they do this,” study co-author Tamar Gutnick, a biologist at the Haus des Meeres-Aqua Terra Zoo in Austria, tells NPR’s Ari Daniel. “So, what we did was take octopuses and systematically make them go through different-sized holes.”
paras.zh: “我们知道它们可以挤过所有这些空间，但没有人真正研究过它们是如何做到这一点的，”该研究的合著者、奥地利 Haus des Meeres-Aqua Terra 动物园的生物学家塔玛尔·古特尼克 (Tamar Gutnick) 告诉 NPR 的阿里·丹尼尔 (Ari Daniel)。 “所以，我们所做的就是让章鱼系统地穿过不同大小的洞。”

paras.en: Octopus bodies are mostly soft and pliable. These creatures have only two stiffer body parts: a cartilaginous shell that protects their brains and a beak—made of a hard material called chitin—that they use to eat.
paras.zh: 章鱼的身体大多柔软且柔韧。这些生物只有两个更坚硬的身体部分：保护大脑的软骨壳和由称为甲壳素的坚硬材料制成的喙，它们用来进食。

paras.en: The common octopuses used two different strategies, depending on the size of the hole. When the opening was larger than the distance between their eyes, they tended to perform a three-step maneuver. First, they probed the hole with one arm, initially creating a U-shaped bend at the opening, then sticking the limb through. That might be the animals’ way of feeling out the situation.
paras.zh: 常见的章鱼根据洞的大小使用两种不同的策略。当开口大于眼睛之间的距离时，他们倾向于执行三步操作。首先，他们用一只手臂探查这个洞，最初在开口处形成一个 U 形弯曲，然后将肢体插入其中。这可能是动物感知情况的方式。

paras.en: “The idea is that the octopuses use the tactile sense on the arms to investigate the opening,” Kuba tells Reuters’ Marta Serafinko.
paras.zh: “我们的想法是，章鱼利用手臂上的触觉来调查开口，”库巴告诉路透社的玛塔·塞拉芬科。

paras.en: Then, they snaked a few more arms through the hole. Finally, they used the arms that were already through the hole to push against the back side of the partition, using leverage to pull the rest of their bodies through.
paras.zh: 然后，他们又从洞里伸了几条手臂。最后，他们用已经穿过洞的手臂推着隔板的背面，利用杠杆作用将身体的其余部分拉了进去。

paras.en: When the hole was smaller than the distance between their eyes, the common octopuses used a similar strategy, except they broke the final step into two stages. After probing and then threading a few arms through, they put the remaining arms through. Then, they pulled their head and mantle through.
paras.zh: 当洞小于眼睛之间的距离时，普通章鱼会使用类似的策略，只不过它们将最后一步分为两个阶段。在探测并穿过几条手臂后，他们将其余的手臂穿过。然后，他们把头和斗篷拉了出来。

paras.en: “This change initially puzzled all of us,” lead author Wenci Xin, a roboticist at the National University of Singapore, tells IFLScience. “However, after thinking about it carefully, we felt that it made sense: The animals were still following the same general pattern, while the new strategy simply divided the process of pulling the body through into separate stages.”
paras.zh: “这一变化最初让我们所有人都感到困惑，”新加坡国立大学的机器人专家、主要作者 Wenci Xin 告诉 IFLScience。 “然而，仔细思考后，我们觉得这是有道理的：动物仍然遵循相同的一般模式，而新策略只是将拉动身体的过程分为不同的阶段。”

paras.en: The Mayan octopuses deployed a similar strategy as the common octopuses when the hole was larger than the distance between their eyes. But when the hole was smaller, they simply ignored it—they didn’t even try to squeeze through.
paras.zh: 当洞大于它们眼睛之间的距离时，玛雅章鱼采取了与普通章鱼类似的策略。但当洞变小时，他们就直接忽略它——甚至没有试图挤过去。

paras.en: It’s not clear why the two species behaved differently. However, the researchers suspect their unique approaches likely stem from differences in their biologies or environments. Other species of octopuses might also have their own squeezing strategies.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚为什么这两个物种表现不同。然而，研究人员怀疑他们独特的方法可能源于他们的生物学或环境的差异。其他种类的章鱼也可能有自己的挤压策略。

paras.en: The new work sheds light on how some octopuses pull off their acrobatic stunts. But scientists still don’t fully understand how octopuses can tolerate the physical demands of these movements.
paras.zh: 这项新研究揭示了一些章鱼如何完成杂技特技。但科学家们仍然不完全了解章鱼如何忍受这些运动的身体要求。

paras.en: “It’s really remarkable that they carry on about their daily business,” Trevor Wardill, a neuroethologist at the University of Minnesota who was not involved with the study, tells the Washington Post’s Meghan Bartels.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的明尼苏达大学神经行为学家特雷弗·沃迪尔 (Trevor Wardill) 告诉《华盛顿邮报》的梅根·巴特尔斯 (Meghan Bartels)，“他们继续处理日常事务真是太了不起了。”

paras.en: If humans or other animals with backbones tried something similar, he says, “that level of brain distortion … would be like a massive concussion—you’d be really spaced out for a very long time, if not dead.”
paras.zh: 他说，如果人类或其他有脊椎的动物尝试类似的事情，“那种程度的大脑扭曲……就像一次巨大的脑震荡——你会在很长一段时间内昏迷不醒，甚至死亡。”

paras.en: Moving forward, the researchers hope the results of their experiments will help them develop flexible, octopus-like robots that can successfully navigate confined spaces. Today, most search-and-rescue robots are long and slender—more like snakes than octopuses, a design that helps them wriggle through narrow crevices. But an octopus-inspired robot might have other benefits, such as the ability to carry sensors, communication devices and tools on its flexible arms.
paras.zh: 展望未来，研究人员希望他们的实验结果能够帮助他们开发出灵活的、类似章鱼的机器人，能够成功地在密闭空间中航行。如今，大多数搜救机器人都又长又细——更像蛇而不是章鱼，这种设计可以帮助它们蠕动穿过狭窄的缝隙。但受章鱼启发的机器人可能还有其他好处，例如能够在其灵活的手臂上携带传感器、通信设备和工具。

paras.en: “This incredible capability could enable robots to overcome environmental limitations and enter spaces that are difficult to reach,” Xin tells Science News’ Nora Bradford.
paras.zh: “这种令人难以置信的能力可以使机器人克服环境限制并进入难以到达的空间，”辛告诉《科学新闻》的诺拉·布拉德福德。

articles.title: The Handwritten Final Draft of Martin Luther King Jr.'s 'I Have a Dream' Speech Was Considered Lost. It Turned Out to Be Sitting in a Desk Drawer for Decades

paras.en: It was late on August 27, 1963, and Martin Luther King Jr. was huddled with a group of his closest advisors in the lobby of the Willard Hotel in Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 1963 年 8 月 27 日深夜，马丁·路德·金 (Martin Luther King Jr.) 和他最亲密的一群顾问挤在华盛顿特区威拉德酒店的大厅里。

paras.en: They were drafting King’s closing remarks for the March on Washington, officially the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, which was set to start in just 12 hours. The group went back and forth on the message: Should it be ideological or Biblical? Directed towards the students marching or the nation at large?
paras.zh: 他们正在起草马丁·路德·金为“华盛顿大游行”（正式名称为“华盛顿争取就业和自由大游行”）的闭幕词，该活动原定在 12 小时内开始。小组就这个信息反复讨论：它应该是意识形态的还是圣经的？针对学生游行还是针对整个国家？

paras.en: As the night wore on, King eventually bowed out. “Okay brothers,” Clarence B. Jones, an activist and speechwriter for King, recalled him saying. “Thank you so much everybody for your suggestions and input … I am now going upstairs to my room to counsel with my Lord.”
paras.zh: 随着夜幕降临，金最终退出了。 “好吧，兄弟们，”金的活动家兼演讲撰稿人克拉伦斯·B·琼斯 (Clarence B. Jones) 回忆起金的说法。 “非常感谢大家的建议和意见……我现在上楼到我的房间向我的主商议。”

paras.en: Alone in his suite, King stayed up until 4 a.m., writing and revising his remarks on a yellow notepad, scratching out swaths of text in blue ink. He then sent these marked-up pages to be typed, forming the basis of his canonical “I Have a Dream” speech, delivered to more than 250,000 demonstrators gathered by the Lincoln Memorial.
paras.zh: 金独自在套房里熬夜到凌晨 4 点，在黄色记事本上书写和修改自己的言论，并用蓝色墨水划出大段文字。然后，他将这些标记好的页面发送给打字员，构成了他向林肯纪念堂聚集的超过 250,000 名示威者发表的经典演讲“我有一个梦想”的基础。

paras.en: Scholars have long assumed that the original, handwritten final draft had been discarded amid the day’s chaos. But six decades later, the manuscript has resurfaced from a drawer of one of King’s former aides. The seven yellow pages are set to be auctioned at Christie’s in January, where the draft is expected to sell for more than $10 million.
paras.zh: 长期以来，学者们一直认为手写的最终草稿在当天的混乱中已被丢弃。但六年后，这份手稿又从金的一位前助手的抽屉里重新出现。这七本黄页将于 1 月份在佳士得拍卖，预计售价将超过 1000 万美元。

paras.en: “When I first saw these pages and realized what they were, I was astounded,” Christie’s manuscripts specialist Peter Klarnet says in a statement. “This is a treasure of American history … Reading along, you’re there in the moment with Dr. King, watching him compose it and making edits in real time.”
paras.zh: “当我第一次看到这些页面并意识到它们是什么时，我感到震惊，”佳士得手稿专家彼得·克拉内特（Peter Klarnet）在一份声明中说道。 “这是美国历史的瑰宝……一边读，一边与金博士在一起，看着他实时创作并进行编辑。”

paras.en: Civil rights leader and philanthropist Xernona Clayton found the pages in the late 1990s. They were tucked in an envelope labeled “speech,” nestled among other papers in a desk drawer belonging to her late husband, Edward, one of King’s aides and speechwriters.
paras.zh: 民权领袖兼慈善家 Xernona Clayton 在 20 世纪 90 年代末发现了这些页面。它们被塞在一个贴着“演讲”标签的信封里，与她已故丈夫爱德华（金的助手和演讲撰稿人之一）的办公桌抽屉里的其他文件放在一起。

paras.en: Clayton knew it was an important document related to the “I Have a Dream” speech but not that it was the final manuscript. She tucked it back in the desk drawer, not wanting to disrespect King’s memory by selling or displaying his memorabilia.
paras.zh: 克莱顿知道这是一份与“我有一个梦想”演讲相关的重要文件，但不知道它是最终手稿。她把它塞回书桌抽屉里，不想通过出售或展示金的纪念品来不尊重他的记忆。

paras.en: But in recent years, she changed her mind. “Now that I’m older, I’m wiser,” Clayton, now 96, tells the New York Times’ Jennifer Schuessler. “It just seems like something that important ought to be shared.”
paras.zh: 但近年来，她改变了想法。 “现在我年纪大了，我更聪明了，”现年 96 岁的克莱顿告诉《纽约时报》的詹妮弗·舒斯勒。 “这似乎是一些重要的事情应该被分享。”

paras.en: In 2024, she shared the pages with her financial manager, who worked with the Christie’s team to identify it as the only known handwritten final draft of the famous speech.
paras.zh: 2024 年，她与财务经理分享了这些页面，财务经理与佳士得团队合作，将其确定为唯一已知的著名演讲的手写最终草稿。

paras.en: “I’m just glad I looked at the drawer,” Clayton says in the statement. “Now, the world will have the opportunity to see those words of wisdom that continue to inspire hope, freedom and the pursuit of equality.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴看到了抽屉，”克莱顿在声明中说道。 “现在，世界将有机会看到那些继续激发希望、自由和追求平等的智慧之言。”

paras.en: The handwritten manuscript is nearly identical to the final, typeface draft King carried with him to the lectern, a copy of which is currently on view at Smithsonian’s National Museum of African American History and Culture (NMAAHC).
paras.zh: 这份手写手稿与金随身携带到讲台上的最终字体草稿几乎完全相同，该手稿的副本目前正在史密森尼国家非裔美国人历史和文化博物馆 (NMAAHC) 展出。

paras.en: “The speech was slotted to be a four-minute closing to the march,” NMAAHC curator Kevin Strait explained in 2021. “However, it became a powerful, 16-minute rallying cry for the entire civil rights movement.”
paras.zh: NMAAHC 策展人凯文·斯特雷特 (Kevin Strait) 在 2021 年解释说：“这场演讲原定为游行结束时的四分钟。然而，它成为整个民权运动强有力的 16 分钟战斗口号。”

paras.en: In fact, neither the original, handwritten pages nor the printed copy bear any mention of the speech’s most memorable line, King’s “I have a dream” refrain. Those words, along with much of the speech’s second half, were improvised on the spot after gospel singer Mahalia Jackson shouted to King, “Tell ‘em about the ‘dream.’” The rediscovered draft does contain the speech’s enduring final line, “Free at last, free at last; thank God almighty, we are free at last.”
paras.zh: 事实上，手写原稿和印刷本都没有提及演讲中最令人难忘的一句话，即金的“我有一个梦想”。这些话以及演讲后半部分的大部分内容都是在福音歌手玛哈莉亚·杰克逊向金喊道“告诉他们‘梦想’”后即兴创作的。重新发现的草稿确实包含了演讲经久不衰的最后一句：“终于自由了，终于自由了；感谢全能的上帝，我们终于自由了。”

paras.en: King’s address has been extensively studied, but this manuscript may shed new light on the activist’s thinking in the hours leading up to the monumental march. For example, King rewrote the speech’s warning about “the tranquilizing drug of gradualism” three times. First, he wrote “tokenism,” before replacing it with “waitism.” He eventually crossing both out in favor of “gradualism,” per the Times.
paras.zh: 金的演讲已被广泛研究，但这份手稿可能会为这位活动家在纪念性游行前几个小时的想法提供新的线索。例如，金将演讲中关于“渐进主义镇静剂”的警告重写了三遍。首先，他写了“象征主义”，然后用“等待主义”代替。据《泰晤士报》报道，他最终将两者划掉，转而支持“渐进主义”。

paras.en: Scholars say the opportunity to see the speech in King’s own writing is an incredible opportunity. “When [Christie’s] called me, I was almost in disbelief. It’s almost like it gives us a chance to get between King’s ears, to get in his mind,” Lerone A. Martin, director of the Martin Luther King Jr. Research and Education Institute at Stanford University, tells the Times.
paras.zh: 学者们表示，有机会看到金自己撰写的演讲稿是一个难以置信的机会。 “当（佳士得）打电话给我时，我几乎不敢相信。这几乎就像给了我们一个深入金的耳朵、进入他的思想的机会，”斯坦福大学马丁·路德·金研究与教育研究所所长莱隆·马丁 (Lerone A. Martin) 告诉《泰晤士报》。

paras.en: Malcolm X attended the March on Washington but did not participate. He critiqued the event, calling it “the Farce in Washington,” and took issue with King’s "Dream" speech, declaring that “the black masses in America were—and still are—having a nightmare.”
paras.zh: 马尔科姆·X 参加了华盛顿游行，但没有参加。他批评了这一事件，称其为“华盛顿的闹剧”，并对金的“梦想”演讲提出异议，宣称“美国的黑人群众过去和现在仍然在做一场噩梦。”

paras.en: All proceeds from the sale will go to philanthropic efforts, including the Xernona Clayton Foundation and the King Center in Atlanta, which was founded by King’s wife and fellow civil rights activist Coretta Scott King.
paras.zh: 出售的所有收益将用于慈善事业，包括 Xernona Clayton 基金会和亚特兰大国王中心，该中心由金的妻子、民权活动家科雷塔·斯科特·金 (Coretta Scott King) 创立。

paras.en: The manuscript will be exhibited at the National Center for Civil and Human Rights in Atlanta from November 16 to 22, followed by a display in Chicago. The pages will also be on public display at Christie’s New York starting on King’s birthday, January 15, through January 21. The draft will be sold on January 22 in a single-lot sale.
paras.zh: 该手稿将于 11 月 16 日至 22 日在亚特兰大国家公民和人权中心展出，随后在芝加哥展出。这些页面还将在金的生日 1 月 15 日至 1 月 21 日期间在纽约佳士得公开展出。该草稿将于 1 月 22 日以单拍拍卖的形式出售。

paras.en: “It’s poetic that the past will protect the future,” Martin Luther King III, a human rights activist and the eldest son of the civil rights leader, says in the statement. “We are grateful that this treasure was preserved over the decades by the Clayton family … Now, for the first time, the public will have the opportunity to be inspired by this document.”
paras.zh: “过去将保护未来，这是诗意的，”人权活动家、民权领袖的长子马丁·路德·金三世在声明中说道。 “我们很感激克莱顿家族几十年来保存了这一宝藏......现在，公众将第一次有机会从这份文件中受到启发。”

paras.en: At Ulta Beauty, you can stock up on skin care, makeup, and haircare, then head to the salon for brows shaped, hair styled, and ears pierced, all in one visit. paras.en: I’ve tested a wide range of beauty products sold at Ulta, from hair tools and red-light therapy devices for hair growth to LED devices, pimple patches, and lip balms. Here’s how to shop smarter, with the best Ulta promo codes and Ulta coupons to keep on your radar.
paras.zh: 我测试过 Ulta 出售的各种美容产品，从美发工具和用于毛发生长的红光治疗设备到 LED 设备、痘痘贴和润唇膏。以下是如何更明智地购物，让您时刻关注最好的 Ulta 促销代码和 Ulta 优惠券。

paras.en: One of the best ways to save regularly on both small, everyday purchases and bigger beauty tech and tools is to shop Ulta’s weekly and daily sales. With Ulta’s Daily & Weekly Beauty Steals, you’ll find up to 50% off everything from perfume to facial cleansers to makeup essentials. You can save big on brands like Ralph Lauren, Murad, Bumble & Bumble, and more.
paras.zh: 无论是日常小额购买还是大型美容技术和工具，定期节省开支的最佳方法之一就是购买 Ulta 的每周和每日促销活动。通过 Ulta 的每日和每周 Beauty Steals，您会发现从香水到洗面奶再到化妆必需品的所有商品均可享受高达 50% 的折扣。您可以节省大量购买 Ralph Lauren、Murad、Bumble & Bumble 等品牌的费用。

paras.en: 15% Off at Ulta Beauty When You Download the App
