articles.title: Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose, and John Leguizamo reveal why they joined Andy Weir's sci-fi audio drama 'Exoplanet' (interview)
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: In any respectable audiobook project, finding the names of Andy Weir ("The Martian," "Project Hail Mary") and Benjamin Percy ("The Ninth Metal," "Wolverine") attached would elicit intense fan interest, but add the superstar vocal talents of Anthony Mackie ("Avengers: Infinity War," "Avengers: Doomsday"), Ariana DeBose ("West Side Story"), and John Leguizamo ("Ice Age"), and it catapults this sonic odyssey into the stratosphere.
paras.zh: 在任何受人尊敬的有声读物项目中，找到安迪·威尔（《火星救援》、《万岁玛丽计划》）和本杰明·珀西（《第九金属》、《金刚狼》）的名字都会引起粉丝的强烈兴趣，但加上安东尼·麦基（《复仇者联盟：无限战争》、《复仇者联盟：世界末日》）、阿丽亚娜·德博斯（《西区故事》）和约翰的超级巨星声乐天赋Leguizamo（《冰河世纪》），它将这场声音奥德赛推向了平流层。

paras.en: Such is the case with "Exoplanet," Audible Original’s new 7-episode science fiction audio drama executive produced by Weir and penned by Percy. Its planet-hopping space disaster narrative sees the crew of the starship Wild Blue Yonder hit a quantum anomaly, forcing their ship to crash-land onto a deadly exoplanet. All is not as it seems, though, as each crew member arrives in a different era on the same world.
paras.zh: Audible Original 的全新 7 集科幻音频剧《Exoplanet》就是这样的例子，由 Weir 制作、Percy 编剧。它的行星跳跃太空灾难叙事中，星际飞船野蓝远方号的船员遭遇了量子异常，迫使他们的飞船迫降在一颗致命的系外行星上。然而，一切并不像看上去的那样，因为每个船员都在不同的时代到达同一个世界。

paras.en: We hooked up with Mackie, DeBose, and Lequizamo to learn more about this renaissance of audio dramas and what attracted them to board Weir's sci-fi thriller.
paras.zh: 我们采访了 Mackie、DeBose 和 Lequizamo，了解有关有声剧复兴的更多信息，以及是什么吸引他们观看威尔的科幻惊悚片。

paras.en: One crew. One planet. Three timelines. No one survives alone. A sci-fi thriller executive produced by Andy Weir (#1 bestselling author of Project Hail Mary, The Martian), with an all-star cast led by Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose and John Leguizamo.
paras.zh: 一名船员。一颗行星。三个时间线。没有人能够独自生存。这部科幻惊悚片由安迪·威尔（《万福玛丽计划》、《火星救援》畅销书作者）监制，演员阵容由安东尼·麦基、阿丽亚娜·德博斯和约翰·雷吉扎莫领衔。

paras.en: Exoplanet is free for Audible members, but also available for purchase separately.
paras.zh: Exoplanet 对 Audible 会员免费，但也可以单独购买。

paras.en: Mackie voices Chief Engineer Jeff Shaw. His attraction to the imaginative genre began at an early age thanks to some cool family friends while growing up in the Big Easy.
paras.zh: 麦基为总工程师杰夫·肖配音。他从小就对富有想象力的流派产生了兴趣，这要归功于在 Big Easy 长大的一些很酷的家庭朋友。

paras.en: "My brother went to college at Morehouse," he tells SPACE. "I was like 8, and he was 18. He’d always bring friends home, because New Orleans is a party city, so they'd come over and get drunk. But one of his friends gave me a book by Walter Mosley and one by Octavia Butler, and I got hooked into sci-fi and the future."
paras.zh: “我哥哥在莫尔豪斯上大学，”他告诉《太空》杂志。 “我当时大约 8 岁，他 18 岁。他总是带朋友回家，因为新奥尔良是一个派对城市，所以他们会过来喝得烂醉。但他的一个朋友给了我一本沃尔特·莫斯利的书和一本奥克塔维亚·巴特勒的书，我迷上了科幻和未来。”

paras.en: "From 'Back to the Future' to 'Aliens,' the future was such an idea of what was going to be out there. Now we’re living it," reveals Mackie. "It’s very important to me as a human being to have that construct as a part of my career. The only thing more arrogant than wanting to be president is standing up and saying, 'Yeah, I can go to space.' That sounds crazy to me."
paras.zh: “从《回到未来》到《外星人》，未来就是外面将会发生什么的想法。现在我们正在生活中，”麦基透露道。 “作为一个人，将这种构想作为我职业生涯的一部分对我来说非常重要。唯一比想当总统更傲慢的事情就是站起来说，‘是的，我可以去太空。’这对我来说听起来很疯狂。”

paras.en: Leguizamo's New York City childhood was influenced by absorbing classic radio dramas of the past, which primed him for this special Audible project.
paras.zh: 雷吉扎莫在纽约的童年受到了过去经典广播剧的影响，这为他创作这个特殊的 Audible 项目做好了准备。

paras.en: “It was Anthony and Ariana being in it that really pumped me up, and of course Andy Weir," he recalls regarding his portrayal of Science Officer Logan Bowers. "Then when I got the theme, that it was something relevant today and makes you think about computers and technology taking over and making us obsolete. It just hit me in that right zeitgeist, at that right little point."
paras.zh: “安东尼和阿丽亚娜的出现真正让我兴奋不已，当然还有安迪·威尔，”他在谈到自己对科学官员洛根·鲍尔斯的扮演时回忆道。 “然后，当我想到这个主题时，它与今天相关，让你思考计算机和技术的接管并使我们变得过时。它恰好在那个正确的小点上击中了我的时代精神。”

paras.en: "As a poor kid, there was no YouTube or cell phones, and we didn’t have computers," reminisces Leguizamo. "I used to go to the Broadcast Museum on 53rd Street and listen to old radio plays like The Shadow and these incredible detective radio plays. It's a different art form. With no visuals, your voice has to create the world. I thought that was an incredible challenge."
paras.zh: “作为一个贫穷的孩子，没有 YouTube 或手机，我们也没有电脑，”雷吉扎莫回忆道。 “我以前经常去 53 街的广播博物馆，听一些老广播剧，比如《影子》和这些令人难以置信的侦探广播剧。这是一种不同的艺术形式。没有视觉效果，你的声音必须创造世界。我认为这是一个令人难以置信的挑战。”

paras.en: DeBose portrays the Wild Blue Yonder's confident First Officer Becca Bang, who’s stranded in a temporal mystery that might engulf her at any moment.
paras.zh: 德博斯饰演“野蓝那边”自信的大副贝卡·邦，她陷入了一个随时可能吞没她的时间谜团中。

paras.en: "I've yet to do anything like this, which is always exciting," she adds. "I was a little afraid of it, which told me I should do it. These gents are so talented. It's great company. It’s coming from brilliant minds who build worlds so impeccably. And it's about real stuff we’re dealing with today. I liked the idea that we could tell this story and make people listen and create a space for them to imagine themselves in it and see how they problem-solve to make the world a bit better."
paras.zh: “我还没有做过这样的事情，这总是令人兴奋的，”她补充道。 “我有点害怕，这告诉我我应该这样做。这些男士太有才华了。这是一家伟大的公司。他们来自聪明才智，他们构建了如此完美的世界。而且这是我们今天正在处理的真实事物。我喜欢这样的想法，我们可以讲述这个故事，让人们倾听，创造一个空间，让他们想象自己在其中，看看他们如何解决问题，让世界变得更好。”

paras.en: Recording your character's lines is far more difficult than just stepping up to the microphone to read a script, and our ace "Exoplanet" trio delivered in every session.
paras.zh: 录制角色的台词比仅仅走到麦克风前朗读剧本要困难得多，而我们的王牌“系外行星”三人组在每次会议中都会进行表演。

paras.en: "I just go in and throw myself at something," DeBose recalls. "I don’t really have a method. But I can tell you this: it is a full-body workout. I use everything at my disposal, whether it’s a chair or a pillow or running in place. I just do what the character does and end up sweating. And after three days, I have to go sit in silence. It's great. I love the idea of bringing back the radio play. The art of listening is such a thing. I don’t think people listen enough. Even for myself."
paras.zh: “我只是进去并全身心投入某件事，”德博斯回忆道。 “我真的没有办法。但我可以告诉你：这是一种全身锻炼。我使用我能使用的一切，无论是椅子、枕头还是原地跑步。我只是按照角色做的做，最后出汗。三天后，我必须安静地坐着。这太棒了。我喜欢带回广播剧的想法。聆听的艺术就是这样一件事。我认为人们听得不够。即使是对我自己来说。”

paras.en: Likewise, Leguizamo embraced his booth sessions with exuberance and authenticity.
paras.zh: 同样，雷吉扎莫以热情和真实的态度迎接他的展位会议。

paras.en: "You have to cancel the rest of your day, especially if you've got to talk, because your vocal chords are fried," he admits. "And if they're not fried you're not doing your job. You really have to do the physicality. If you run you have to run like a maniac and be out of breath. If I'm getting hit I start punching myself. Then there’s a sexiness to doing these things. Your voice has to have a little mystery, a little naughtiness. It’s an interesting intersection where you pull it back a little and invite the audience in.”
paras.zh: “你必须取消一天中剩下的时间，尤其是当你必须说话的时候，因为你的声带已经受损，”他承认。 “如果它们没有被炸，你就没有做好你的工作。你真的必须做身体上的工作。如果你跑步，你必须像疯子一样跑，上气不接下气。如果我被击中，我就会开始打自己。然后做这些事情就有一种性感。你的声音必须有一点神秘，一点调皮。这是一个有趣的交叉点，你可以把它拉回来一点，邀请观众进来。”

paras.en: For Mackie, who’s used to athleticism needed to play MCU superheroes like The Falcon and Captain America, recording dialogue offered a different type of opportunity.
paras.zh: 对于习惯了扮演猎鹰和美国队长等 MCU 超级英雄所需的运动能力的麦基来说，录制对话提供了一种不同类型的机会。

paras.en: “I look for reasons not to talk to people, so I love doing these," he jokes. "Once I’m out of the studio, I’m not talking to anybody for two days. At a certain point for me, I find mentally I get tired of hearing myself talk. I just have to come home at cut off. I’ve said enough words for the next month.”
paras.zh: “我寻找不与人交谈的理由，所以我喜欢这样做，”他开玩笑说。 “一旦我离开工作室，我就会有两天不跟任何人说话。对我来说，在某个时刻，我发现精神上我厌倦了听自己说话。我只得在中断时回家。我已经为下个月说了足够多的话了。”

paras.en: "Exoplanet" is available now exclusively from Audible.
paras.zh: 《Exoplanet》现已由 Audible 独家发售。

paras.en: One crew. One planet. Three timelines. No one survives alone. A sci-fi thriller executive produced by Andy Weir (#1 bestselling author of Project Hail Mary, The Martian), with an all-star cast led by Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose and John Leguizamo.
paras.zh: 一名船员。一颗行星。三个时间线。没有人能够独自生存。这部科幻惊悚片由安迪·威尔（《万福玛丽计划》、《火星救援》畅销书作者）监制，演员阵容由安东尼·麦基、阿丽亚娜·德博斯和约翰·雷吉扎莫领衔。

paras.en: Exoplanet is free for Audible members, but also available for purchase separately.
paras.zh: Exoplanet 对 Audible 会员免费，但也可以单独购买。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: SpaceX moves Starship Flight 15 booster to launch pad for 'squeeze test' ahead of epic double-catch attempt (photos)
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: SpaceX is one big step closer to the 15th test flight of its Starship megarocket.
paras.zh: SpaceX 距离其星际飞船巨型火箭第 15 次试飞又近了一大步。

paras.en: The company announced today (Nov. 10) that it had moved its latest Starship first stage, known as Super Heavy Booster 22, to the launch mount at its Starbase facility in South Texas ahead of Flight 15, which is scheduled to lift off this Friday (Nov. 13).
paras.zh: 该公司今天（11 月 10 日）宣布，在 15 号航班定于本周五（11 月 13 日）升空之前，已将其最新的 Starship 第一级（称为 Super Heavy Booster 22）移至德克萨斯州南部 Starbase 设施的发射架。

paras.en: During the upcoming launch test, SpaceX plans to catch both Booster 22 and Starship's Ship upper stage with its launch tower's "chopstick" arms in a double landing catch — something the private spaceflight company has never tried before. It will be the first full recovery of an orbital rocket in history.
paras.zh: 在即将到来的发射测试中，SpaceX 计划用发射塔的“筷子”臂进行双着陆，以抓住 Booster 22 和 Starship 飞船的上级——这是这家私人航天公司以前从未尝试过的。这将是历史上首次完全回收轨道火箭。

paras.en: Booster 22 therefore "was used for final catch testing upon arrival [at the pad], including a suspended squeeze test at catch height," SpaceX said in an X post today (Nov. 10).
paras.zh: SpaceX 在今天（11 月 10 日）的 X 帖子中表示，Booster 22“被用于抵达（到达发射台）后的最终捕获测试，包括在捕获高度进行悬挂挤压测试”。

paras.en: That post shared four photos of the giant booster, which is powered by 33 of SpaceX's next-gen Raptor engines. The first shot showed Super Heavy in one of Starbase's "Mega Bay" assembly buildings before rollout, while the other three depicted it grasped by the tower's arms, held high in the South Texas sky.
paras.zh: 该帖子分享了巨型助推器的四张照片，该助推器由 33 台 SpaceX 下一代猛禽发动机提供动力。第一个镜头显示了超级重型在推出前位于 Starbase 的“Mega Bay”装配大楼中，而其他三个镜头则描绘了它被塔的手臂抓住，高举在德克萨斯州南部的天空中。

paras.en: SpaceX has used the chopstick arms during Starship flights before; it has successfully caught Super Heavy on three separate occasions. But the company has never attempted a catch of Ship, which flies higher and farther than the booster and is therefore a more challenging target. And SpaceX only reached orbit with Starship for the first time on Flight 14, which launched on Sept. 28.
paras.zh: SpaceX 此前曾在 Starship 飞行中使用过筷子臂；它已经在三个不同的场合成功捕获了“超重”。但该公司从未尝试过捕获“飞船”，因为“飞船”比助推器飞得更高更远，因此是一个更具挑战性的目标。 SpaceX 仅在 9 月 28 日发射的 14 号航班上首次搭载 Starship 进入轨道。

paras.en: So Flight 15 will break new ground. And, if all goes to plan, it will give us a look at the future: SpaceX plans to catch Super Heavy and Ship on all operational Starship missions, as this recovery strategy will allow the company to boost the megarocket's launch cadence.
paras.zh: 因此，15 号航班将开辟新天地。而且，如果一切按计划进行，这将使我们看到未来：SpaceX 计划在所有正在运行的星际飞船任务中赶上超重型和飞船，因为这种回收策略将使该公司能够加快巨型火箭的发射节奏。

paras.en: And SpaceX wants to fly Starship incredibly often, so that it can build out its Starlink V3 broadband constellation and even bigger Starmind AI data-center network. Indeed, Elon Musk has said the company is eyeing 10,000 Starship flights per year by 2030.
paras.zh: SpaceX 希望能够频繁地发射 Starship，以便能够建立其 Starlink V3 宽带星座以及更大的 Starmind AI 数据中心网络。事实上，埃隆·马斯克曾表示，该公司的目标是到 2030 年每年进行 10,000 次 Starship 飞行。

paras.en: If all goes to plan, Flight 15 will launch from Starbase on Friday during a 75-minute window that opens at 5:45 p.m. EST (2245 GMT; 4:45 p.m. local Texas time).
paras.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，15 号航班将于周五从 Starbase 发射，时间为 75 分钟，时间为下午 5:45。美国东部时间（2245 GMT；德克萨斯州当地时间下午 4:45）。

paras.en: Super Heavy will return to Starbase for its catch about 6.5 minutes after liftoff. Ship will follow suit much later — about 22 hours later, in fact, after it has deployed 26 Starlink V3 spacecraft into LEO and completed 14 circuits of our planet.
paras.zh: Super Heavy 将在升空后约 6.5 分钟返回 Starbase 进行捕获。飞船将在很久之后效仿——事实上，大约 22 小时后，在它已将 26 颗星链 V3 航天器部署到近地轨道并完成了地球的 14 圈飞行之后。

paras.en: You can watch all the action live here at Space.com and get updates about the mission here.
paras.zh: 您可以在 Space.com 上观看所有现场直播，并在此处获取有关任务的最新信息。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: Curiosity Blog, Sols 5056-5062: Charging Back Up!

paras.en: By Remington Free, Operations Systems Engineer, NASA-JPL
paras.zh: 作者：Remington Free，NASA-JPL 操作系统工程师

paras.en: Earth planning date: Friday, Oct. 30, 2026
paras.zh: 地球规划日期：2026 年 10 月 30 日星期五

paras.en: Today’s plan covered 3 sols, 5060, 5061, and 5062, as we take a few recharging sols before getting back to our normal drilling activities. As you may know if you have been following the blog closely, we are in the middle of a drilling campaign on our target called “Nazca.” We’ve already drilled the hole, characterized the tailings from the drill hole with ChemCam, and have now done several sample dropoffs, both to our SAM and CheMin instruments within the belly of the rover. We still have a number of activities left to do as part of the campaign, including another dropoff to SAM for a different kind of analysis, and drilling cleanup activities. One of those activities is called “RAGE” (Rotate to Agitate for Granule Expulsion, a very fun acronym) where we essentially shake the drill to get any remaining sample out of it. We’ll also make sure to take lots of imaging to continue document the drill hole and tailings.
paras.zh: 今天的计划涵盖了 3 个 sol，即 5060、5061 和 5062，因为我们在恢复正常钻井活动之前需要进行一些充电。如果您一直密切关注该博客，您可能会知道，我们正在针对名为“纳斯卡”的目标进行钻探活动。我们已经钻了孔，用 ChemCam 对钻孔中的尾矿进行了表征，现在已经完成了几次样品投放，同时将样品投放到流动站腹部的 SAM 和 CheMin 仪器中。作为该活动的一部分，我们仍有许多活动要做，包括再次前往 SAM 进行不同类型的分析，以及钻探清理活动。其中一项活动称为“RAGE”（旋转搅拌以排出颗粒，这是一个非常有趣的缩写），我们实际上是摇动钻头以从中取出任何剩余的样品。我们还将确保拍摄大量图像以继续记录钻孔和尾矿。

paras.en: In any case, those activities are very power-hungry for our rover! So today’s plan purposefully did not have a lot of activities in it so we could get a nice few power positive sols before we get back to drilling. Each of our three sols had a standard morning science block, with an extra exciting brand-new activity on 5061 (more on that shortly!).
paras.zh: 无论如何，这些活动对于我们的漫游车来说非常耗电！因此，今天的计划故意没有进行太多活动，这样我们就可以在返回钻探之前获得一些不错的正能量溶胶。我们的三个 sol 中的每一个都有一个标准的早晨科学块，在 5061 上有一个额外令人兴奋的全新活动（稍后会详细介绍！）。

paras.en: Over the three sols, we conducted remote science with ChemCam active and Remote Micro-Imager mosaics on some interesting targets (“Titicaca,” “Pampas,” and “Salta”), some Mastcam imaging of our calibration target and our drill target, several Navcam dust devil studies and Mastcam tau observations, and twilight imaging. Despite this plan being recharging/waiting, we got in lots of exciting science to continue to study the Nazca crystal formations and the nearby layered rocks and bedrock.
paras.zh: 在这三个太阳系中，我们利用 ChemCam 主动和远程微成像仪马赛克对一些有趣的目标（“的喀喀”、“潘帕斯”和“萨尔塔”）进行了远程科学研究，对我们的校准目标和钻探目标进行了一些 Mastcam 成像，进行了一些 Navcam 尘暴研究和 Mastcam tau 观测，以及暮光成像。尽管这个计划正在充电/等待，我们还是获得了许多令人兴奋的科学成果，继续研究纳斯卡晶体结构以及附近的层状岩石和基岩。

paras.en: On 5061, we also conducted a brand-new engineering activity to test parallelism over one of our downlink communications windows. As the rover gets older and our power output slowly decreases over the length of the mission, we are continuously looking for new ways to execute activities with less power use. One of our strategies is parallelism – having two activities execute at the same time will save power due to the rover being awake for less time. However, we need to vet pairs of activities ahead of time to ensure they are safe to run together. This is a test of one of those pairs – running our CheMin “Get Data” activity at the same time as we are sending data to one of our orbiters. CheMin Get Data is a high CPU activity which transfers science data from the instrument to our flight computers. The test seems to have gone well, but we’ll have to wait to hear back from our engineering team to analyze the results!
paras.zh: 在 5061 上，我们还进行了一项全新的工程活动来测试我们的一个下行链路通信窗口的并行性。随着流动站逐渐老化，我们的功率输出在任务期间缓慢下降，我们不断寻找新的方法来执行更少能耗的活动。我们的策略之一是并行性——同时执行两项活动将节省电量，因为流动站的唤醒时间较短。然而，我们需要提前审查成对的活动，以确保它们可以安全地一起运行。这是对其中一对的测试——在向其中一个轨道飞行器发送数据的同时运行我们的 CheMin“获取数据”活动。 CheMin Get Data 是一项高 CPU 活动，它将科学数据从仪器传输到我们的飞行计算机。测试似乎进展顺利，但我们必须等待工程团队的回复来分析结果！

paras.en: Overall, it was an exciting plan full of great remote science as we wait to be able to wrap up our drill campaign. Stay tuned to hear more about how the rest of the Nazca campaign went!
paras.zh: 总的来说，这是一个令人兴奋的计划，充满了伟大的远程科学，因为我们正在等待能够结束我们的演习活动。请继续关注以了解有关纳斯卡战役其余部分进展情况的更多信息！

articles.title: Autumn Mornings Bring Valley Fog

paras.en: On a cool November morning, low clouds traced the branching valleys of the Appalachian Plateau and the Cumberland River. By afternoon, they had faded, leaving clear skies over the autumn landscape.
paras.zh: 十一月一个凉爽的早晨，低云掠过阿巴拉契亚高原和坎伯兰河的分支山谷。到了下午，它们已经消退了，在秋天的风景上留下了晴朗的天空。

paras.en: The change is visible in this pair of images from November 8, 2026. The MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) on NASA's Terra satellite acquired the left image that morning. In this natural-color view, low clouds appear white as they fill many of the valleys. Autumn vegetation appears in shades of brown and green.
paras.zh: 这一变化在 2026 年 11 月 8 日的这对图像中可见。NASA Terra 卫星上的 MODIS（中分辨率成像光谱仪）于当天早上获取了左侧图像。在这张自然色彩的视图中，低云呈现白色，因为它们充满了许多山谷。秋季植被呈棕色和绿色。

paras.en: The VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite) on NOAA-21 acquired the right image that afternoon, after the clouds had dissipated and exposed the rivers and lakes beneath them. This false-color view makes it easier to distinguish water (dark blue) from vegetation (bright green).
paras.zh: 当天下午，云层消散并露出下方的河流和湖泊后，NOAA-21 上的 VIIRS（可见红外成像辐射计套件）获得了正确的图像。这种假色视图可以更轻松地区分水（深蓝色）和植被（亮绿色）。

paras.en: The clouds appear to be fog, a type of cloud that forms near the ground. Foggy mornings in the region are common this time of year. As nights lengthen, the ground has more time to radiate away the day's heat, and the air just above it cools to the dew point—the temperature at which air becomes saturated and water vapor begins condensing into the tiny droplets that make up fog.
paras.zh: 这些云看起来像是雾，是一种在地面附近形成的云。每年这个时候，该地区的早晨有雾很常见。随着夜晚的延长，地面有更多的时间散发白天的热量，地面上方的空气冷却到露点——在这个温度下，空气变得饱和，水蒸气开始凝结成微小的水滴，形成雾。

paras.en: Because cold air is denser than warm air, it flows downslope and pools in valleys, so fog tends to form there first. Notice the fog filling the branching valleys across part of the Appalachian Plateau in eastern Kentucky and southwestern West Virginia. Rivers and streams that run along many of the valley floors add to the effect by supplying extra moisture. The same pattern is visible along the Cumberland River and its reservoirs in north-central Tennessee and south-central Kentucky.
paras.zh: 由于冷空气比温暖的空气密度高，因此它会向下坡流动并汇集在山谷中，因此雾往往首先形成。请注意，肯塔基州东部和西弗吉尼亚州西南部阿巴拉契亚高原部分地区的分支山谷充满了雾气。沿着许多山谷地面延伸的河流和溪流通过提供额外的水分来增加效果。沿着田纳西州中北部和肯塔基州中南部的坎伯兰河及其水库可以看到同样的图案。

paras.en: According to the National Weather Service, temperatures in many places on the morning of November 8 dipped into the 30s Fahrenheit before giving way to a mild, sunny afternoon. Forecasters reported locally dense valley fog that morning. Dense fog had also blanketed a wider part of the region earlier in the week, prompting advisories for hazardous travel conditions.
paras.zh: 据国家气象局称，11 月 8 日上午，许多地方的气温降至 30 华氏度，随后迎来了温和、阳光明媚的下午。预报员报告说，当天早上，当地山谷有浓雾。本周早些时候，浓雾还覆盖了该地区的大部分地区，引发了危险旅行条件的警告。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory images by Lauren Dauphin, using MODIS data from NASA EOSDIS LANCE and GIBS/Worldview, and VIIRS data from NASA EOSDIS LANCE, GIBS/Worldview and the Joint Polar Satellite System (JPSS). Story by Kathryn Hansen.

articles.title: Water Surges Into Navajo Reservoir

paras.en: Back-to-back extreme rain events inundated the Four Corners region of the U.S. Southwest in late October and early November 2026. The storms alleviated short-term drought conditions in the Southwest but caused river levels to spike to record or near-record levels in places, triggering damaging floods.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月下旬和 11 月初，连续的极端降雨事件淹没了美国西南部的四个角地区。风暴缓解了西南部的短期干旱状况，但导致部分地区河流水位飙升至创纪录或接近创纪录的水位，引发破坏性洪水。

paras.en: One effect of the heavy rains detected by satellites was the rapid rise of water levels in Navajo Reservoir. The change is visible in the images above, acquired on September 20 (left) and November 7 (right) with the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 9. In that time, the lake in northern New Mexico and southern Colorado rose by nearly 60 feet (18 meters), according to data from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers. (Note that the Bureau of Reclamation decreased releases from Navajo Dam on September 16 and 17.)
paras.zh: 卫星监测到的暴雨造成的影响之一是纳瓦霍水库水位迅速上升。从上面的图像中可以看到这种变化，这些图像是在 9 月 20 日（左）和 11 月 7 日（右）使用 Landsat 9 上的 OLI（操作陆地成像仪）获取的。根据美国陆军工程兵团的数据，当时新墨西哥州北部和科罗拉多州南部的湖泊上升了近 60 英尺（18 米）。 （请注意，垦务局在 9 月 16 日和 17 日减少了纳瓦霍大坝的排放量。）

paras.en: On November 7, the reservoir stood at its highest level since August 2019 and at 108 percent of the average capacity for that date. That contrasts with September 20, when it held just 60 percent of its average capacity. Due to snow drought across the West in winter 2025-26, the lake saw relatively little growth in the spring, when snowmelt often raises water levels.
paras.zh: 11 月 7 日，水库蓄水量达到 2019 年 8 月以来的最高水位，达到当日平均蓄水量的 108%。与 9 月 20 日形成鲜明对比的是，当时的产能仅为平均产能的 60%。由于 2025-26 年冬季西部地区雪旱，该湖在春季的增长相对较少，而春季融雪常常导致水位上升。

paras.en: The San Juan, Piedra, and other rivers swelled with runoff amid the wet weather. Pagosa Springs, Colorado, a town along the San Juan River about 40 miles (64 kilometers) northeast of the lake, was especially hard-hit by flooding. In the first round of rain, 5.05 inches (12.8 centimeters) fell in the town, and on October 23 the river reached major flood stage. After more rain, the river spiked again on November 1, this time nearly to the record level set in 1911 during a devastating flood. Officials issued evacuation orders, and responders rescued dozens of people, according to news reports, while water inundated streets and damaged property.
paras.zh: 由于天气潮湿，圣胡安河、彼德拉河和其他河流的径流水位暴涨。科罗拉多州帕戈萨斯普林斯是圣胡安河沿岸的一个小镇，距离该湖东北约 40 英里（64 公里），受洪水影响尤其严重。在第一轮降雨中，该镇的降雨量达到了 5.05 英寸（12.8 厘米），10 月 23 日，河流达到了大洪水阶段。经过更多降雨后，11 月 1 日河水水位再次飙升，这次几乎达到了 1911 年毁灭性洪水期间创下的纪录水位。据新闻报道，官员发布了疏散命令，救援人员救出了数十人，同时水淹没了街道并损坏了财产。

paras.en: Heavy rain and flooding have been widespread across southwest Colorado, southeast Utah, northern Arizona, and northwest New Mexico in recent weeks. From early September through early November, precipitation totals were 2 to 4 times the average throughout the Four Corners region—an area beset by long-term drought that was exacerbated by snow drought and high temperatures in 2026.
paras.zh: 最近几周，科罗拉多州西南部、犹他州东南部、亚利桑那州北部和新墨西哥州西北部普遍出现大雨和洪水。从 9 月初到 11 月初，四角地区的降水总量是平均水平的 2 到 4 倍，该地区长期遭受干旱，2026 年的雪旱和高温加剧了这一地区的情况。

paras.en: Though the downpours posed hazards to communities along many rivers, they did provide drought relief throughout the region. Weekly U.S. Drought Monitor maps, derived from a suite of satellite data products and ground-based observations, have indicated improvements to drought conditions due to the fall storms. The group’s November 3 summary noted that “short-term drought has ended for the Southwest and Great Basin,” although long-term drought persists in places.
paras.zh: 尽管倾盆大雨对许多河流沿岸的社区造成了危害，但确实缓解了整个地区的干旱。根据一系列卫星数据产品和地面观测数据得出的美国每周干旱监测地图显示，秋季风暴导致干旱状况有所改善。该组织在 11 月 3 日的总结中指出，“西南地区和大盆地的短期干旱已经结束”，但一些地方长期干旱依然存在。

paras.en: Wet weather in the Southwest is often associated with El Niño events, when the segment of the jet stream flowing eastward near the equatorial Pacific tends to strengthen. Experts noted that the low-pressure system delivering the heavy rainfall in autumn 2026 was at a low latitude for the time of year and drew energy from unusually high ocean temperatures. El Niño patterns—like the one currently underway—can increase the likelihood of moisture-laden storms being steered across the Southwest interior.
paras.zh: 西南地区的潮湿天气常常与厄尔尼诺现象有关，此时赤道太平洋附近向东流动的急流部分往往会加强。专家指出，2026 年秋季带来强降雨的低压系统在一年中的这个时候处于低纬度，并从异常高的海洋温度中获取能量。厄尔尼诺现象——就像目前正在发生的那样——可能会增加潮湿的风暴席卷西南内陆的可能性。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory images by Michala Garrison, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Story by Lindsey Doermann.
paras.zh: NASA 地球观测站图像，由 Michala Garrison 使用美国地质调查局的陆地卫星数据拍摄。林赛·杜尔曼的故事。

articles.title: Nearly 64,000 flee Nigeria for Niger where a humanitarian crisis is deepening

paras.en: Nearly 64,000 flee Nigeria for Niger where a humanitarian crisis is deepening
paras.zh: 近64,000人逃离尼日利亚前往尼日尔，那里的人道主义危机正在加深

paras.en: Violence in northern Nigeria is fueling a growing humanitarian crisis across the whole region: 64,000 have fled to neighbouring Niger and several hundred have left for Benin since the start of the year, as host countries struggle to cope, the UN’s refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚北部的暴力事件正在加剧整个地区日益严重的人道主义危机：联合国难民署 (UNHCR) 周二表示，自今年年初以来，东道国难以应对，已有 64,000 人逃往邻国尼日尔，数百人逃往贝宁。

paras.en: Northern Nigeria has been experiencing multiple, overlapping security crises involving jihadist insurgencies, armed banditry, and farmer-herder conflicts, forcing millions from their homes over the past 25 years.
paras.zh: 过去 25 年来，尼日利亚北部经历了多重重叠的安全危机，涉及圣战叛乱、武装土匪和农牧冲突，迫使数百万人背井离乡。

paras.en: Most this year have fled to Niger, which is already struggling with insecurity, climate shocks and overstretched services.
paras.zh: 今年大多数人逃往尼日尔，尼日尔已经陷入不安全、气候冲击和服务过度紧张的困境。

paras.en: Before the start of 2026, the landlocked West African nation was already hosting more than half a million refugees and asylum-seekers, including some 327,500 from Nigeria, alongside large numbers of internally displaced (IDPs).
paras.zh: 2026 年初之前，这个西非内陆国家已经收容了超过 50 万难民和寻求庇护者，其中包括来自尼日利亚的约 327,500 人，以及大量国内流离失所者 (IDP)。

paras.en: In October alone, around 1,200 people crossed into Diffa, in south-eastern Niger, and another 3,400 into Tahoua, in the west, both bordering Nigeria.
paras.zh: 仅在 10 月份，就有约 1,200 人越境进入尼日尔东南部的迪法，另有 3,400 人进入西部的塔瓦，两者均与尼日利亚接壤。

paras.en: Conditions are particularly dire in Diffa, which has accounted for more than 70 per cent of Niger’s reported security incidents this year, including armed attacks and violence against civilians.
paras.zh: 迪法的情况尤其严峻，尼日尔今年报告的安全事件中 70% 以上是发生在迪法，其中包括武装袭击和针对平民的暴力行为。

paras.en: Drought and irregular rainfall have also devastated agriculture and pastureland. Grain production is expected to be insufficient in around 700 of the region’s 1,000 villages, while an estimated 70 per cent of pastureland has been lost.
paras.zh: 干旱和不规律的降雨也摧毁了农业和牧场。该地区 1,000 个村庄中的约 700 个村庄预计粮食生产不足，同时估计 70% 的牧场已消失。

paras.en: Newly arrived refugees, many of them children, face very difficult living conditions, UNHCR stressed.
paras.zh: 难民署强调，新抵达的难民（其中许多是儿童）面临着非常困难的生活条件。

paras.en: Malnutrition levels are high as access to food and clean water is limited, with refugee women describing having to walk several kilometres to collect water for their families.
paras.zh: 由于获得食物和清洁水的机会有限，营养不良程度很高，难民妇女表示必须步行几公里才能为家人取水。

paras.en: Many are also living in makeshift shelters that offer little protection from the elements, and humanitarian partners are reporting poor hygiene and widespread respiratory infections.
paras.zh: 许多人还住在临时避难所，几乎无法抵御恶劣天气，人道主义合作伙伴报告卫生条件差，呼吸道感染广泛传播。

paras.en: Only around five per cent of Nigerian refugees who arrived this year have been registered, with lack of funds hampering the effort.
paras.zh: 今年抵达的尼日利亚难民中只有约 5% 进行了登记，因为缺乏资金阻碍了这一努力。

paras.en: Without documentation, refugees face additional barriers to accessing assistance and essential services, leaving them exposed to heightened protection risks.
paras.zh: 如果没有证件，难民在获得援助和基本服务方面面临额外障碍，使他们面临更高的保护风险。

paras.en: Education is another major concern, particularly for children arriving from Nigeria’s English-language-based education system, with no schools or transitional classes at some locations. Hausa is the sole official language of Niger.
paras.zh: 教育是另一个主要问题，特别是对于来自尼日利亚以英语为基础的教育系统的儿童来说，该系统在某些地方没有学校或过渡班。豪萨语是尼日尔的唯一官方语言。

paras.en: Despite being dealt a difficult hand, Niger's authorities and host communities are demonstrating “remarkable solidarity” with Nigeria’s refugees, UNHCR’s Dominique Hyde said, including by making land available for temporary shelter.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署的多米尼克·海德表示，尽管遇到了困难，尼日尔当局和收容社区仍然表现出了对尼日利亚难民的“非凡的团结”，包括提供土地作为临时住所。

paras.en: However, their capacity to support growing numbers of refugees is increasingly stretched, and UNHCR is calling on the international community to urgently scale up their assistance.
paras.zh: 然而，他们支持越来越多难民的能力日益捉襟见肘，难民署呼吁国际社会紧急扩大援助规模。

paras.en: The UN agency is seeking $11.4 million to scale up the emergency and solutions response in Niger, Nigeria and Benin, including a $2 million appeal for immediate critical needs to support water, food, shelter, health care, registration and protection.
paras.zh: 该联合国机构正在寻求 1140 万美元，以扩大尼日尔、尼日利亚和贝宁的紧急情况和解决方案响应，其中包括呼吁提供 200 万美元，以满足支持水、食物、住所、医疗保健、登记和保护的紧急需求。

paras.en: “Without additional resources, thousands of vulnerable families risk being left without essential assistance and protection as displacement continues,” Ms. Hyde said.
paras.zh: 海德女士说：“如果没有额外的资源，随着流离失所的继续，数以千计的弱势家庭将面临得不到基本援助和保护的风险。”

articles.title: Ebola: IOM urges wider surveillance beyond formal routes in DR Congo

paras.en: Ebola: IOM urges wider surveillance beyond formal routes in DR Congo
paras.zh: 埃博拉：国际移民组织敦促刚果民主共和国在正式路线之外进行更广泛的监测

paras.en: Seventy-one confirmed Ebola cases have been detected along transit routes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) since the outbreak began almost six months ago, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) said on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织 (IOM) 周二表示，自疫情爆发近六个月以来，刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 过境路线上已发现 71 例埃博拉确诊病例。

paras.en: The cases were picked up at points of entry and control, 95 per cent of them on informal routes that bypass official checkpoints, Dr. Andrew Mbala, IOM’s Regional Ebola Coordinator, told journalists in Geneva, speaking from Nairobi.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织埃博拉区域协调员安德鲁·姆巴拉博士在内罗毕向日内瓦记者表示，这些病例是在入境点和控制点发现的，其中 95% 是通过绕过官方检查站的非正式路线发现的。

paras.en: With transmission continuing, people on the move and funding running short, the agency says surveillance has to reach well beyond formal border crossings if the outbreak is to be contained.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，随着传播的持续、人员的流动和资金的短缺，如果要遏制疫情，监测范围就必须远远超出正式的过境点。

paras.en: “Often when people think about response and especially in this context of Ebola, many people tend to think about the hospitals, the treatment centres, the isolation wards and all that,” he said. “We need to think about the mobility of the population.”
paras.zh: “通常，当人们想到应对措施时，尤其是在埃博拉病毒的背景下，许多人往往会想到医院、治疗中心、隔离病房等等，”他说。 “我们需要考虑人口的流动性。”

paras.en: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), more than 10,400 confirmed cases and 5,103 deaths had been reported in the DRC as of 31 October.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织(WHO)称，截至10月31日，刚果民主共和国已报告超过10,400例确诊病例和5,103例死亡。

paras.en: IOM maps the places where people gather, such as markets, bus stations and places of worship. It also maps what it calls “the mobility corridor”, meaning where people are travelling to and from, including areas hit by the outbreak.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织绘制了人们聚集的地方的地图，例如市场、公交车站和礼拜场所。它还绘制了所谓的“流动走廊”，即人们往返的地方，包括受疫情影响的地区。

paras.en: Those findings show responders where to send staff and resources.
paras.zh: 这些调查结果向响应者展示了向何处派遣人员和资源。

paras.en: Since the outbreak began, teams have carried out 55 million screenings in the DRC and 11 neighbouring countries.
paras.zh: 自疫情爆发以来，工作组已在刚果民主共和国和11个邻国进行了5500万次筛查。

paras.en: Dr. Mbala said most people transporting the bodies of Ebola victims also use informal routes. So far, 258 bodies have been intercepted.
paras.zh: 姆巴拉博士说，大多数运送埃博拉受害者尸体的人也使用非正式路线。到目前为止，已截获258具尸体。

paras.en: “It is quite important that we look into the points of control and to be able to expand our scope in terms of response to make sure that we cover all the informal routes, not only concentrating on the formal ones,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“非常重要的是，我们要研究控制点，并能够扩大我们的应对范围，以确保我们覆盖所有非正式路线，而不仅仅是专注于正式路线。”

paras.en: IOM also supports surveillance at 57 displacement sites in the DRC, 50 of them in health zones affected by the outbreak. It is helping affected and at-risk countries improve early detection and screening.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织还支持对刚果民主共和国 57 个流离失所地点进行监测，其中 50 个位于受疫情影响的卫生区。它正在帮助受影响和面临风险的国家改善早期发现和筛查。

paras.en: The agency needs $110 million for its regional operations through March 2027 but is nearly $60 million short.
paras.zh: 截至 2027 年 3 月，该机构需要 1.1 亿美元用于其区域运营，但缺口近 6000 万美元。

paras.en: Elsewhere in the DRC, peacekeepers with the UN mission, MONUSCO, evacuated three civilians, two women and a man, who were wounded in a shooting along the Plaine Savo–Gali road in Ituri Province on Sunday.
paras.zh: 在刚果民主共和国的其他地方，联合国稳定团联刚稳定团的维和人员疏散了周日在伊图里省萨沃-加利平原公路上发生的枪击事件中受伤的三名平民（两名妇女和一名男子）。

paras.en: They were taken from Bethlehem to Fataki Hospital with a Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) nurse travelling with them, and all three arrived safely for further treatment.
paras.zh: 他们被无国界医生组织护士从伯利恒送往法塔基医院，三人均安全抵达接受进一步治疗。

paras.en: The mission said the evacuation was part of its work to protect civilians and help people get urgent medical care in areas hit by insecurity.
paras.zh: 该特派团表示，疏散是其保护平民和帮助人们在不安全地区获得紧急医疗服务的一部分。

articles.title: World News in Brief: Ending cholera by 2030 ‘within reach’, Haiti displacement and hunger, US human rights review rescheduled

paras.en: World News in Brief: Ending cholera by 2030 ‘within reach’, Haiti displacement and hunger, US human rights review rescheduled
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：到 2030 年消除霍乱“触手可及”、海地流离失所和饥饿、美国人权审查重新安排

paras.en: Last year was the deadliest for cholera since 1999, with almost 7,900 deaths, Dr. Lorenzo Pezzoli, WHO lead for epidemic-prone bacterial diseases, told journalists in Geneva.
paras.zh: 世卫组织负责流行性细菌性疾病问题的洛伦佐·佩佐利博士在日内瓦对记者表示，去年是自 1999 年以来霍乱致死人数最多的一年，约有 7,900 人死亡。

paras.en: Most of the deaths happened on a community level, before patients could access healthcare.
paras.zh: 大多数死亡发生在社区层面，患者还没有获得医疗服务。

paras.en: Fatalities dipped down in the first nine months of 2026, but more than 3,000 have still died of the preventable and treatable disease – nearly nine in ten of them in Africa.
paras.zh: 2026 年前 9 个月，死亡人数有所下降，但仍有 3,000 多人死于这种可预防和可治疗的疾病，其中近十分之九在非洲。

paras.en: Where there is clean water, basic sanitation and a nearby health centre, patients can recover, Dr. Pezzoli said. But in a crowded camp or a village cut off by conflict, cholera can turn deadly within hours, and El Niño could make matters worse, since both too much and too little water fuel the disease.
paras.zh: 佩佐利博士说，只要有干净的水、基本的卫生设施和附近的医疗中心，病人就可以康复。但在拥挤的营地或因冲突而与世隔绝的村庄，霍乱可能在数小时内致命，而厄尔尼诺现象则可能使情况变得更糟，因为水过多或过少都会加剧这种疾病。

paras.en: Most cases are currently being reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Yemen, Zambia, Nigeria, Somalia and Djibouti. WHO has already provided 71 million doses of cholera vaccine.
paras.zh: 目前报告的大多数病例是在刚果民主共和国、也门、赞比亚、尼日利亚、索马里和吉布提。世卫组织已提供 7100 万剂霍乱疫苗。

paras.en: Sufficient clean water and sanitation facilities would end cholera for good, Dr. Pezzoli said – but not where conflict is raging.
paras.zh: 佩佐利博士说，充足的清洁水和卫生设施将永远消除霍乱，但在冲突激烈的地区却并非如此。

paras.en: Haiti: Thousands flee violence as hunger deepens
paras.zh: 海地：饥饿加剧，数千人逃离暴力

paras.en: Armed violence continues to force people from their homes in Haiti’s West Department, UN Deputy Spokesperson Farhan Haq told journalists in New York on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 联合国副发言人法尔汉·哈克周二在纽约告诉记者，武装暴力继续迫使海地西部地区的人们离开家园。

paras.en: Since late October, attacks in Arcahaie and Cabaret, northwest of Port-au-Prince, have displaced more than 5,900 people, according to the International Organization for Migration (IOM). Some 70 per cent are staying with host families, while the rest are sheltering in makeshift sites.
paras.zh: 据国际移民组织 (IOM) 称，自 10 月底以来，太子港西北部的阿尔卡艾 (Arcahaie) 和卡巴莱 (Cabaret) 发生的袭击事件已导致 5,900 多人流离失所。大约 70% 的人住在寄宿家庭，其余的人则在临时营地避难。

paras.en: Meanwhile, hunger continues to deepen. Nearly six million people, more than half the population, face high levels of acute food insecurity, including nearly 1.9 million at emergency levels.
paras.zh: 与此同时，饥饿现象继续加深。近 600 万人（占总人口的一半以上）面临严重的严重粮食不安全，其中近 190 万人处于紧急状态。

paras.en: The UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) estimates that more than a quarter of a million children aged six to 59 months are expected to suffer from acute malnutrition between June this year and May next year, including nearly 94,000 with severe acute malnutrition.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）估计，今年6月至明年5月期间，预计将有超过25万6至59个月大的儿童遭受急性营养不良，其中近94,000人患有严重急性营养不良。

paras.en: Humanitarians are assessing needs and assisting the hardest-hit families, but insecurity continues to hamper access, Mr. Haq said.
paras.zh: 哈克表示，人道主义人员正在评估需求并为受灾最严重的家庭提供援助，但不安全局势继续阻碍救援工作。

paras.en: The $880 million humanitarian plan for Haiti is less than half funded, with $424 million received as the year draws to a close.
paras.zh: 为海地提供的 8.8 亿美元人道主义计划的资金还不到一半，截至年底已收到 4.24 亿美元。

paras.en: US human rights review rescheduled after ‘continued non-cooperation’
paras.zh: “持续不合作”后美国人权审查重新安排

paras.en: The UN Human Rights Council on Tuesday expressed regret at the “continued non-cooperation” of the United States with the universal periodic review (UPR) mechanism, after the Government declined to take part in its scheduled review for the second time.
paras.zh: 联合国人权理事会周二对美国政府第二次拒绝参加普遍定期审议（UPR）机制后“持续不合作”表示遗憾。

paras.en: The US review had originally been set for 7 November 2025. After the country did not participate, it was rescheduled for Tuesday but the US failed to comply again.
paras.zh: 美国的审查原定于2025年11月7日进行，由于该国没有参加，因此推迟到周二，但美国再次未能遵守。

paras.en: Under the Universal Periodic Review, every Member State, whatever its size or influence, appears before its peers in Geneva about once every four and a half years.
paras.zh: 根据普遍定期审议，每个会员国，无论其规模或影响力如何，大约每四年半就会在日内瓦出席一次。

paras.en: It presents a report on its human rights record, answers questions and receives recommendations from other countries.
paras.zh: 它提交一份关于其人权记录的报告，回答问题并接受其他国家的建议。

paras.en: In a decision adopted in Geneva, the council called on the US to “resume its cooperation with the universal periodic review mechanism” and rescheduled the review for its next Working Group session, from 18 to 29 January 2027.
paras.zh: 在日内瓦通过的一项决定中，理事会呼吁美国“恢复与普遍定期审议机制的合作”，并将审议工作重新安排在2027年1月18日至29日举行的下一次工作组会议上。

paras.en: The other States scheduled for review by the UPR Working Group during its current session (2-13 November 2026) are: Suriname, Greece, Samoa, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Hungary, Papua New Guinea, Tajikistan, the United Republic of Tanzania, Antigua and Barbuda, Eswatini, Trinidad and Tobago, Thailand and Ireland.
paras.zh: 普遍定期审议工作组计划在本届会议（2026年11月2日至13日）期间审议的其他国家包括：苏里南、希腊、萨摩亚、圣文森特和格林纳丁斯、匈牙利、巴布亚新几内亚、塔吉克斯坦、坦桑尼亚联合共和国、安提瓜和巴布达、斯威士兰、特立尼达和多巴哥、泰国和爱尔兰。

articles.title: Who can win the Race to Dubai and what does McIlroy need to be No 1?

paras.en: DP World Tour Championship: Who can win the Race to Dubai and what does Rory McIlroy need to finish season No 1 again?
paras.zh: DP 世界巡回锦标赛：谁能赢得迪拜之战？罗里·麦克罗伊需要什么才能再次获得赛季第一？

paras.en: Eugenio Chacarra leads the Race to Dubai standings ahead of Rory McIlroy and Patrick Reed; McIlroy is looking to win the Harry Vardon Trophy for an eighth time; watch the DP World Tour Championship live throughout the week on Sky Sports Golf
paras.zh: 尤金尼奥·查卡拉 (Eugenio Chacarra) 在迪拜竞赛中领先罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 和帕特里克·里德 (Patrick Reed)；麦克罗伊希望第八次赢得哈利瓦尔登奖杯；每周在天空体育高尔夫频道观看 DP 世界巡回锦标赛直播

paras.en: The Race to Dubai season reaches its climax this week at the DP World Tour Championship, live on Sky Sports, with nine players still in with a chance of topping the season-long standings.
paras.zh: 迪拜之战赛季本周在天空体育直播的 DP 世界巡回锦标赛上达到高潮，仍有 9 名选手有机会登上整个赛季的积分榜榜首。

paras.en: Only the top 50 available players in the rankings are eligible to tee it up at Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai, where Eugenio Chacarra enters as Race to Dubai leader and looking to become just the third Spaniard to win the Order of Merit.
paras.zh: 只有排名前 50 名的球员才有资格在迪拜的朱美拉高尔夫庄园打球，尤金尼奥·查卡拉 (Eugenio Chacarra) 是迪拜竞赛领军人物，他希望成为第三位赢得荣誉勋章的西班牙人。

paras.en: Compatriot Jon Rahm is among those in contention to lift the Harry Vardon Trophy after his win at the Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship on Sunday, his sixth Rolex Series win, while Rory McIlroy chases a record-equalling eighth Race to Dubai title.
paras.zh: 同胞乔恩·拉姆 (Jon Rahm) 周日在阿布扎比阿尔达尔锦标赛 (Abu Dhabi Aldar Champions) 获胜后，成为争夺哈里·瓦尔登奖杯 (Harry Vardon Trophy) 的热门人选，这是他第六次获得劳力士系列赛冠军，而罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 则在争夺创纪录的第八个迪拜竞赛冠军头衔。

paras.en: McIlroy moved above Patrick Reed into second after his third-place finish in Abu Dhabi, with The Masters champion well-placed to challenge Chacarra and win the Race to Dubai for a fourth successive season.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊在阿布扎比获得第三名后，超越帕特里克·里德升至第二位，大师赛冠军完全有能力挑战查卡拉，并连续第四个赛季赢得迪拜赛冠军。

paras.en: The winner of the DP World Tour Championship gets 2,000 points, with Casey Jarvis, Aaron Rai, Rahm, Jayden Schaper, Ryan Fox and Daniel Hillier all still - mathematically at least - in the running to win the Race to Dubai.
paras.zh: DP 世界巡回赛冠军获得者将获得 2,000 分积分，凯西·贾维斯 (Casey Jarvis)、亚伦·雷 (Aaron Rai)、拉姆 (Rahm)、杰登·沙佩尔 (Jayden Schaper)、瑞安·福克斯 (Ryan Fox) 和丹尼尔·希利尔 (Daniel Hillier) 仍然有望赢得迪拜竞赛，至少在数学上是这样。

paras.en: Only Chacarra and McIlroy have complete control of their Race to Dubai destiny, with a win for either guaranteeing No 1 spot, but there are plenty of other scenarios and permutations to determine who will lift the trophy on Sunday.
paras.zh: 只有查卡拉和麦克罗伊能够完全掌控迪拜之战的命运，任何一方获胜都将确保第一名的位置，但还有很多其他场景和排列可以决定谁将在周日举起奖杯。

paras.en: How can Rory McIlroy win the Race to Dubai?
paras.zh: 罗里·麦克罗伊如何才能赢得迪拜之战？

paras.en: McIlroy trails Chacarra by 533.93 points but could finish as low as fourth - worth 600 points - and still win the Race to Dubai, depending on how the Spaniard and others perform.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊落后查卡拉 533.93 分，但可能仅获得第四名（价值 600 分），但仍然赢得迪拜比赛，具体取决于西班牙人和其他人的表现。

paras.en: A McIlroy victory would take him to 5,709.86 points and guarantee the Race to Dubai, regardless of other results, while solo second would be enough if Chacarra or Reed doesn't win the tournament.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊的胜利将使他的积分达到 5,709.86 分，无论其他结果如何，都可以保证迪拜比赛的胜利，而如果查卡拉或里德没有赢得比赛，单人第二名就足够了。

paras.en: Solo third is worth 752 points and would take McIlroy to 4,461.86 points, leaving him needing Chacarra to be outside the top 11, Reed to be lower than tied-second and none of Jarvis, Rai or Rahm to win.
paras.zh: 个人第三名的得分为 752 分，麦克罗伊的得分将达到 4,461.86 分，这使得他需要查卡拉进入前 11 名之外，里德低于并列第二，而贾维斯、拉伊或拉姆都无法获胜。

paras.en: McIlroy finishing fourth would require even more to edge Race to Dubai victory, as it would need Chacarra below 46th, Reed outside a share of second and none of the others within 2,000 points of the current lead to win.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊获得第四名需要更多的努力才能赢得迪拜赛的胜利，因为查卡拉需要低于第 46 位，里德位于第二位之外，其他人都没有在当前领先优势的 2,000 分以内才能获胜。

paras.en: How does Chacarra hold onto his Race to Dubai lead?
paras.zh: 查卡拉如何保持迪拜竞赛的领先地位？

paras.en: Chacarra has topped the standings since winning the DP World India Championship, his third victory of the season after claiming the Open d'Italia and KLM Open in June, although has seen his lead cut after tied-22nd finishes in his last two starts.
paras.zh: 查卡拉自赢得DP世界印度锦标赛以来一直位居积分榜榜首，这是他在6月赢得意大利公开赛和荷兰皇家航空公开赛后本赛季的第三场胜利，尽管在最近两场比赛中获得并列第22名后，他的领先优势被缩小。

paras.en: Victory guarantees he would join Seve Ballesteros and Rahm as the only Spanish winners of the Order of Merit, as would second spot if McIlroy doesn't win.
paras.zh: 胜利保证了他将与塞夫·巴列斯特罗斯和拉姆一起成为唯一获得荣誉勋章的西班牙人，如果麦克罗伊没有获胜，他也将获得第二名。

paras.en: Third would secure the Race to Dubai unless McIlroy finishes no higher than solo second and Reed isn't the winner, while solo fourth would require both title rivals outside the top two and Jarvis not to win.
paras.zh: 除非麦克罗伊的成绩不高于个人第二名并且里德不是获胜者，否则第三名将确保进入迪拜的比赛，而个人第四名则需要前两名之外的冠军竞争对手和贾维斯都不能获胜。

paras.en: Anything further down the leaderboard brings multiple other scenarios into play, although Chacarra could finish bottom this week in Dubai and still potentially become season champion.
paras.zh: 尽管查卡拉本周可能在迪拜排名垫底，但仍有可能成为赛季冠军，但排行榜上的任何进一步下滑都会带来多种其他情况。

paras.en: What do Reed and others need to win the Race to Dubai?
paras.zh: 里德和其他人需要什么才能赢得迪拜竞赛？

paras.en: A Reed win would secure the Race to Dubai unless it's Chacarra in second, while a runner-up finish would take him to No 1 if McIlroy is outside the top two and Chacarra lower than a share of third.
paras.zh: 里德的胜利将确保迪拜比赛的胜利，除非查卡拉获得第二名，而如果麦克罗伊不在前两名且查卡拉低于第三名，那么获得亚军将使他升至第一。

paras.en: For Jarvis - currently fourth - to claim the Race to Dubai, the South African would need to win, McIlroy finish outside the top two and Chacarra to be no higher than fourth.
paras.zh: 对于贾维斯（目前排名第四）来说，南非人需要获胜才能获得迪拜比赛的冠军，麦克罗伊则无法进入前两名，而查卡拉则不高于第四名。

paras.en: Rai and Rahm both require victory as well as Chacarra to be outside the top seven and for both McIlroy and Rahm to be lower than second, while Schaper, Fox and Hillier require Chacarra to finish further back to keep their slim hopes alive.
paras.zh: 拉伊和拉姆都需要胜利，查卡拉也需要进入前七名之外，而麦克罗伊和拉姆都需要低于第二名，而沙佩尔、福克斯和希利尔则需要查卡拉进一步落后，以保住他们渺茫的希望。

paras.en: Who will earn their PGA Tour cards this week?
paras.zh: 本周谁将获得美巡赛卡？

paras.en: The leading 10 players - not otherwise exempt - on the Race to Dubai Rankings after this week will earn PGA Tour cards for the following season, with plenty of spots still up for grabs.
paras.zh: 本周之后迪拜之行排名中领先的 10 名选手（并非豁免）将获得下赛季的美巡赛卡，还有大量名额可供争夺。

paras.en: Chacarra, Reed, Jarvis and Schaper all have their PGA Tour cards wrapped up, with Hillier, Jacob Skov Olesen and Bernd Wiesberger all well-placed to secure dual membership for 2027.
paras.zh: 查卡拉、里德、贾维斯和沙珀都已经拿到了美巡赛卡，希利尔、雅各布·斯科夫·奥尔森和贝恩德·威斯伯格都有望在 2027 年获得双重会员资格。

paras.en: Andy Sullivan, Oliver Lindell and Joe Dean are the others starting the week inside the top 10, although any eligible player in the DP World Tour Championship field still has a chance of moving high enough in the Race to Dubai standings to earn a PGA Tour card.
paras.zh: 安迪·沙利文 (Andy Sullivan)、奥利弗·林德尔 (Oliver Lindell) 和乔·迪恩 (Joe Dean) 是本周开始进入前十名的其他人，尽管任何符合 DP 世界巡回锦标赛资格的选手仍有机会在迪拜之战中排名上升到足够高的位置，从而获得 PGA 巡回赛卡。

paras.en: Spanish quartet Angel Ayora, Nacho Elvira, Angel Hidalgo and David Puig are the next four players in the standings not already exempt, ahead of South Africa's Henni du Plessis and England's Dan Bradbury.
paras.zh: 西班牙四重奏安吉尔·阿约拉、纳乔·埃尔维拉、安吉尔·伊达尔戈和大卫·普伊格是积分榜上接下来的四名尚未豁免的球员，领先于南非的亨尼·杜普莱西斯和英格兰的丹·布拉德伯里。

articles.title: White: Opetaia could become a global star with spectacular Wilder win

paras.en: Fury vs AJ undercard: Jai Opetaia could become a global star with spectacular Deontay Wilder win, says Dana White
paras.zh: 富里 vs AJ Undercard：达纳·怀特 (Dana White) 表示，凭借 Deontay Wilder 的精彩胜利，杰·奥佩塔亚 (Jai Opetaia) 可能会成为全球明星

paras.en: Jai Opetaia steps up to heavyweight for a bout against hard-punching former champion Deontay Wilder on the undercard of Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua in Cardiff on December 11; "If he wins this fight spectacularly, everything is open and available to Jai Opetaia," promoter Dana White says
paras.zh: 12 月 11 日，在卡迪夫举行的泰森·富里对阵安东尼·约书亚的比赛中，贾伊·奥佩塔亚 (Jai Opetaia) 晋级重量级，与实力强劲的前冠军德昂泰·维尔德 (Deontay Wilder) 进行较量；发起人达纳·怀特 (Dana White) 表示：“如果他出色地赢得了这场比赛，那么一切都对杰·奥佩塔亚 (Jai Opetaia) 开放并可用。”

paras.en: Jai Opetaia could become a global star if he defeats Deontay Wilder on the undercard of Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff on December 11.
paras.zh: 如果贾伊·奥佩塔亚 (Jai Opetaia) 于 12 月 11 日在卡迪夫公国体育场举行的泰森·富里 (Tyson Fury) 对阵安东尼·约书亚 (Anthony Joshua) 的底牌比赛中击败德昂泰·维尔德 (Deontay Wilder)，他可能会成为全球巨星。

paras.en: Opetaia, an elite cruiserweight, is stepping up to heavyweight for what could be a one-off bout in the division against the former world champion.
paras.zh: 奥佩塔亚是一名轻量级精英选手，他正在向重量级选手迈进，与这位前世界冠军进行一场可能是该级别的一次性比赛。

paras.en: Wilder, who previously held the WBC heavyweight title, had a spectacular championship run that earned him the reputation as one of the hardest punchers the sport has ever seen.
paras.zh: 怀尔德此前曾获得 WBC 重量级拳王头衔，他在冠军赛上取得了令人瞩目的成绩，这为他赢得了这项运动史上最强悍的拳击手之一的声誉。

paras.en: Opetaia is already a force in the cruiserweight division and has continued to impressed.
paras.zh: 奥佩塔亚已经是轻量级的一支力量，并且继续给人留下深刻的印象。

paras.en: But a victory over Wilder, especially if he wins in style, would take the Australian to a new level of fame.
paras.zh: 但战胜维尔德，尤其是如果他以风格取胜，将使澳大利亚人的名气上升到一个新的水平。

paras.en: "Imagine if on this Netflix card Opetaia knocks him out or wins this fight spectacularly, everything is open and available to Jai Opetaia," promoter Dana White told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “想象一下，如果在这张 Netflix 卡上，奥佩塔亚击倒了他，或者以惊人的方式赢得了这场比赛，那么一切都对杰·奥佩塔亚开放并可用，”发起人达纳·怀特告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "He's one of these unique people who basically has an entire country behind him. He's got Australia and New Zealand. The more he wins, the higher profile fights he has, the bigger he becomes, not just there but all over the world. Everybody knows who Jai Opetaia is now."
paras.zh: “他是这些独特的人之一，基本上有整个国家支持他。他有澳大利亚和新西兰。他赢的越多，他打的比赛就越引人注目，他变得越大，不仅在国内，而且在全世界。现在每个人都知道杰伊·奥佩塔亚是谁。”

paras.en: Opetaia wants to remain active. "He's willing to fight all the time," White said. "That's the way you stay relevant, forget about making more money and all the stuff that's common sense, that's how you become a legend.
paras.zh: 奥佩塔亚希望保持活跃。 “他愿意一直战斗，”怀特说。 “这就是你保持相关性的方式，忘记赚更多的钱和所有常识性的东西，这就是你成为传奇的方式。

paras.en: "We're sitting here and talking about Ray Robinson [boxing so frequently] and he did that. That's how you become a legend. Jai is one of those guys."
paras.zh: “我们坐在这里谈论雷·罗宾逊（经常打拳击），他做到了。这就是你成为传奇的方式。杰伊就是其中之一。”

paras.en: Oleksandr Usyk, an unbeaten undisputed champion at both heavyweight and cruiserweight, potentially returning to 200lbs creates a new dynamic for the division.
paras.zh: 亚历山大·乌西克 (Oleksandr Usyk) 是重量级和次轻量级无可争议的不败冠军，他有可能重返 200 磅，为该级别带来新的动力。

paras.en: "There's a chance of working with everybody," White hinted, adding: "What does that tell you? It tells that that's the money division right now and Jai Opetaia is a part of it."
paras.zh: “有机会与每个人合作，”怀特暗示道，并补充道：“这告诉你什么？它告诉你现在就是资金部门，而杰·奥佩塔亚是其中的一部分。”

paras.en: Zuffa Boxing's 21-year-old heavyweight Da'Mazion Vanhouter dazzled again on Saturday when he took out Ivan Balaz with stunning speed.
paras.zh: 周六，祖法拳击队21岁的重量级拳手达马齐恩·范豪特(Da'Mazion Vanhouter)再次表现出色，他以惊人的速度击败了伊万·巴拉兹(Ivan Balaz)。

paras.en: White wants to keep Vanhouter busy and have him box in a month's time on the Fury-AJ undercard too.
paras.zh: 怀特想让范胡特保持忙碌，并让他在一个月的时间里也能在Fury-AJ底牌上打球。

paras.en: "Is this kid the next great American heavyweight? And the answer seems to be yes right now," White said.
paras.zh: “这孩子是下一个伟大的美国重量级人物吗？现在答案似乎是肯定的，”怀特说。

paras.en: "He's another one turning around and fighting again quickly and I believe that [after Balaz] he'll probably be on the Cardiff card too.
paras.zh: “他是另一个迅速转身并再次战斗的人，我相信（在巴拉兹之后）他也可能会出现在卡迪夫的名单上。

paras.en: "The truth of the matter is why would you not want to be on that card? That's the card you want to be on, especially if you're a heavyweight."
paras.zh: “问题的真相是，你为什么不想加入那张牌？这就是你想要加入的牌，特别是如果你是重量级选手的话。”

paras.en: Watch Carlos Adames vs Gerome Warburton from 4pm live on Sky Sports Mix on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六下午 4 点，观看 Sky Sports Mix 直播卡洛斯·亚当斯 (Carlos Adames) 对阵杰罗姆·沃伯顿 (Gerome Warburton) 的比赛。

articles.title: Carney on Australia challenge, 'Magic' concept, and 'necessary' domestic limbo

paras.en: Brian Carney on the challenge of usurping Australia, a 'Magic' style 2030 World Cup, and the 'necessary' domestic limbo
paras.zh: 布莱恩·卡尼 (Brian Carney) 谈篡夺澳大利亚的挑战、“神奇”风格的 2030 年世界杯以及“必要的”国内困境

paras.en: Sky Sports Rugby League's Brian Carney takes a look at the upcoming Rugby League World Cup finals, the Rugby League World Cup 2030, and the domestic limbo over the potential NRL partnership on the horizon
paras.zh: 天空体育橄榄球联盟的布莱恩·卡尼 (Brian Carney) 探讨了即将到来的橄榄球联盟世界杯决赛、2030 年橄榄球联盟世界杯，以及即将与 NRL 合作的国内不确定性

paras.en: Sky Sports Rugby League's Brian Carney analyses the big talking points from the world of rugby league, including the upcoming Rugby League World Cup finals, the 'Magic' style concept for the Rugby League World Cup 2030, and the ongoing work towards an NRL partnership.
paras.zh: 天空体育橄榄球联盟的布莱恩·卡尼分析了橄榄球联盟世界的热门话题，包括即将举行的橄榄球联盟世界杯决赛、2030 年橄榄球联盟世界杯的“魔术”风格概念，以及正在进行的 NRL 合作伙伴关系工作。

paras.en: The more things change, the more things seem to stay the same.
paras.zh: 事情变化得越多，似乎就越多保持不变。

paras.en: In a World Cup where we were hailing Tonga and Samoa and their emergence as title contenders, not just for an upset here and there but as title contenders, you have Australia and New Zealand in the final.
paras.zh: 在世界杯上，我们赞扬汤加和萨摩亚作为冠军争夺者的出现，不仅仅是因为这里或那里的爆冷，而且作为冠军争夺者，澳大利亚和新西兰进入了决赛。

paras.en: - Rugby League World Cup 2026 schedule and results
paras.zh: - 2026 年橄榄球联盟世界杯赛程表和结果

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育交易或无合同直播

paras.en: - Download Sky Sports app for analysis, news and video
paras.zh: - 下载天空体育应用程序进行分析、新闻和视频

paras.en: Australia and New Zealand are deserved finalists. They opened the tournament with an absolute bell-ringer and we will hope for more of the same in the final.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚和新西兰当之无愧地入围决赛。他们以绝对的敲响了比赛的序幕，我们希望在决赛中能有更多同样的表现。

paras.en: I really cannot split them. I give New Zealand a really good chance but like Australia have done for nearly half a century now, they keep finding ways to win.
paras.zh: 我实在无法将他们分开。我给新西兰一个非常好的机会，但就像澳大利亚近半个世纪以来所做的那样，他们不断寻找获胜的方法。

paras.en: When they are down and out, dead and buried, off their game, like they were against Fiji, they find a way to win.
paras.zh: 当他们陷入困境、死亡和埋葬、失去比赛时，就像对阵斐济时一样，他们找到了获胜的方法。

paras.en: Kalyn Ponga coming back in for New Zealand was a massive boost and he obviously had no problems defensively off the back of his broken arm- he threw himself into tackles and came up with try-savers.
paras.zh: 卡林·庞加（Kalyn Ponga）为新西兰队回归对他来说是一个巨大的推动，他在断臂后的防守上显然没有任何问题——他全身心投入铲球并提出了保护措施。

paras.en: We are in for a sensational final between the two best nations in the world. There are no complaints there.
paras.zh: 我们即将迎来世界上最好的两个国家之间的一场激动人心的决赛。那里没有抱怨。

paras.en: In the women's final, I cannot look past the Jillaroos. They are at a level of dominance that I don't think we have ever seen from the Kangaroos ever.
paras.zh: 在女子决赛中，我无法忽视 Jillaroos 队。我认为他们的统治力是我们从未在袋鼠身上看到过的。

paras.en: The scorelines they are posting, their ability to win games at a canter, even sometimes leaving points out there.
paras.zh: 他们发布的比分，他们以慢跑赢得比赛的能力，甚至有时会留下分数。

paras.en: It is remarkable. It looks a greater hurdle to catch up with them for the likes of New Zealand and Samoa than the hurdle in the men's game.
paras.zh: 这是非常了不起的。对于新西兰和萨摩亚这样的球队来说，追赶他们的难度似乎比男子比赛的难度更大。

paras.en: Will Tonga rue going all out against Samoa?
paras.zh: 汤加会后悔全力对抗萨摩亚吗？

paras.en: I do not think there is a huge amount between Australia, New Zealand, Tonga, and Samoa on any given day. I would not have fallen over in shock if Tonga or Samoa had won either of the semi-finals.
paras.zh: 我认为澳大利亚、新西兰、汤加和萨摩亚之间的任何一天都没有大量的往来。如果汤加或萨摩亚赢得半决赛，我不会感到震惊。

paras.en: I was probably more surprised that Tonga went full-on against Samoa a week earlier in a game that they did not have to win.
paras.zh: 更令我惊讶的是，汤加在一周前对阵萨摩亚的比赛中全力以赴，而他们不必赢。

paras.en: They went all out for that game and it would have taken plenty out of both teams heading into the semi-finals.
paras.zh: 他们在那场比赛中全力以赴，如果两支球队进入半决赛，他们都会付出很大的努力。

paras.en: While I understand and applaud that the emotion of the game and the occasion drove Tonga and Samoa to field strong sides, it didn't make a whole lot of strategic sense for Tonga in particular. They could have rested players and prepared for their semi-final.
paras.zh: 虽然我理解并赞扬这场比赛的情绪和场合促使汤加和萨摩亚派出强队，但这对汤加来说并没有多大的战略意义。他们本可以让球员休息并为半决赛做准备。

paras.en: I was somewhat surprised at that approach not withstanding the fact the game meant so much passion wise.
paras.zh: 我对这种做法感到有些惊讶，尽管事实上这款游戏意味着如此多的激情。

paras.en: The whole purpose was to win the World Cup, not to beat Samoa.
paras.zh: 整个目的是赢得世界杯，而不是击败萨摩亚。

paras.en: Tonga and Samoa's Tier 1 status: A warning shot for England?
paras.zh: 汤加和萨摩亚的一级地位：对英格兰的警告？

paras.en: In terms of Tonga and Samoa now being given Tier 1 status, I would be surprised if that warning shot wasn't felt all the way back in 2017 when Tonga emerged as a force in international rugby league.
paras.zh: 就汤加和萨摩亚现在获得一级地位而言，如果早在 2017 年汤加成为国际橄榄球联盟的一支力量时就没有感受到这种警告，我会感到惊讶。

paras.en: I do not think for a minute that England will have been taken by surprise by the performances of Tonga and Samoa and the subsequent reward which appears to be Tier 1 status.
paras.zh: 我不认为英格兰会对汤加和萨摩亚的表现以及随后的似乎是一级地位的奖励感到惊讶。

paras.en: It is only good for the game and I think people will applaud the efforts that have been made by a variety of people and organisations to get those teams to where they are.
paras.zh: 这只会对游戏有利，我认为人们会赞扬各种人和组织为让这些团队达到目标而付出的努力。

paras.en: You also have to give a nod to those Tonga players back in 2017. Andrew Fifita, Jason Taumulolo, and Daniel Tupou in particular made the decision to make themselves available to Tonga.
paras.zh: 你还必须向 2017 年的汤加球员致敬。安德鲁·菲菲塔、杰森·陶穆洛洛和丹尼尔·图普特别决定让自己为汤加效力。

paras.en: That decision has been the spark that has lit this Pacific rebirth of Tonga and Samoa in international rugby league.
paras.zh: 这一决定点燃了汤加和萨摩亚在国际橄榄球联盟中重生的火花。

paras.en: Doing things differently: 'Magic' style in 2030
paras.zh: 以不同的方式做事：2030 年的“魔法”风格

paras.en: The Rugby League World Cup 2030 is fascinating. We are told it is going to be a Magic Weekend style event where they will descend upon a city for a weekend, play all the games, then decamp to another host city.
paras.zh: 2030 年橄榄球联盟世界杯非常精彩。我们被告知这将是一场万智牌周末风格的赛事，他们将在一个城市度过一个周末，玩完所有比赛，然后逃往另一个主办城市。

paras.en: That is not a traditional way of doing a World Cup but the mastermind and the brains behind it is Peter V'Landys and the Australian Rugby League Commission.
paras.zh: 这不是举办世界杯的传统方式，但其幕后策划者和大脑是 Peter V'Landys 和澳大利亚橄榄球联盟委员会。

paras.en: The ARLC have all the power, all the money, and at the helm they have a man who, in his professional history, has shown a willingness to challenge the establishment and the status quo.
paras.zh: ARLC 拥有所有权力、所有资金，掌舵者是一位在其职业生涯中表现出挑战体制和现状的意愿的人。

paras.en: Cast your minds back to 2017 and the Melbourne Cup, one of the most prestigious horse races in the world.
paras.zh: 让您的思绪回到 2017 年和墨尔本杯，这是世界上最负盛名的赛马比赛之一。

paras.en: So, if you are the boss of New South Wales horse racing, how do you try and take on the Melbourne Cup? Do you go like-for-like? No.
paras.zh: 那么，如果你是新南威尔士州赛马界的老板，你会如何尝试挑战墨尔本杯呢？你会像往常一样去吗？不。

paras.en: V'Landys decided to create something different and did the Everest race. The draw would be done differently; the audience and the sponsors they would be targeting would be very different.
paras.zh: V'Landys 决定创造一些不同的东西，并参加了珠穆朗玛峰比赛。抽签的方式会有所不同；他们的目标观众和赞助商会有很大不同。

paras.en: It would look and feel very different to the Melbourne Cup and it has been a roaring success by all metrics.
paras.zh: 它的外观和感觉与墨尔本杯非常不同，但从所有指标来看，它都取得了巨大的成功。

paras.en: He is not going to take on, for example, the Rugby Union World Cup and try and go blow for blow with them and replicate what rugby union or football does.
paras.zh: 例如，他不会去参加橄榄球联盟世界杯，并试图与他们针锋相对，并复制橄榄球联盟或足球的做法。

paras.en: 'We are different' is how he thinks and he will think differently and act differently with this Magic style World Cup.
paras.zh: “我们不同”是他的想法，在这届万智牌风格的世界杯上，他的想法和行为也会有所不同。

paras.en: I am fascinated by it. They have got all the wind behind them at the moment. They have all the money and will to do this.
paras.zh: 我对它着迷。此刻他们已经掌握了所有的风向。他们有足够的资金和意愿来做到这一点。

paras.en: This is the man who brought games to Las Vegas when people said it could and would not happen and it would not be a success.
paras.zh: 当人们说这可能发生、不会发生、也不会成功时，就是这个人把游戏带到了拉斯维加斯。

paras.en: While it is not for the traditionalists, V'Landys' thinking is what is best for rugby league and he might have landed on something there.
paras.zh: 虽然这不适合传统主义者，但 V'Landys 的想法对橄榄球联盟来说是最好的，他可能已经在那里找到了一些东西。

paras.en: That goes hand-in-hand with the extension of the eligibility rules to great-grandparents because he wants Tonga, Samoa, Fiji, Cook Islands, Papua New Guinea. He wants to secure all of Pacifica.
paras.zh: 这与将资格规则扩展到曾祖父母齐头并进，因为他想要汤加、萨摩亚、斐济、库克群岛、巴布亚新几内亚。他想要保护整个帕西菲卡。

paras.en: This is another step towards ensuring that these teams have the players available to them to create stories that resonate back in their countries.
paras.zh: 这是确保这些球队拥有足够的球员来创造在他们的国家引起共鸣的故事的又一步。

paras.en: We are a nimble sport because we are small, we have got fewer institutional breaks than others which can be good and bad.
paras.zh: 我们是一项灵活的运动，因为我们规模较小，我们的制度性突破比其他国家少，这可能是好是坏。

paras.en: It has allowed the ARLC to determine what international rugby league is going to look like.
paras.zh: 它使 ARLC 能够确定国际橄榄球联盟的外观。

paras.en: When you are paying the piper, you call the tune and the ARLC are paying the piper.
paras.zh: 当你付钱给风笛手时，你就决定了，ARLC 也在付钱给风笛手。

paras.en: Most people in administrative roles spend their lives trying to solve problems. V'Landys seems to make a living discovering that they weren't problems in the first place.
paras.zh: 大多数担任行政职务的人一生都在努力解决问题。维兰迪斯（V'Landys）似乎以谋生为生，并发现他们一开始就不是问题。

paras.en: It is hard to argue that we are not in a case of limbo domestically with so much to be announced and the fact we are in November.
paras.zh: 很难说我们在国内并没有陷入困境，有这么多事情需要宣布，而事实上我们已经在 11 月了。

paras.en: There is a lot going on and if the NRL partnership deal comes to pass, it is a major development in our game and it has taken a long time to get to this point.
paras.zh: 正在发生很多事情，如果 NRL 合作伙伴协议得以通过，这将是我们游戏的重大发展，并且花了很长时间才达到这一点。

paras.en: If that means a delay on other things, I say so be it. It is not ideal but I won't lose sleep over it.
paras.zh: 如果这意味着其他事情的延迟，我会说就这样吧。这并不理想，但我不会因此而失眠。

paras.en: It might set back planning but if we get where we need to be at the end of it all, I am sure it will be worth it.
paras.zh: 这可能会阻碍计划，但如果我们最终能达到我们需要的目标，我相信这是值得的。

paras.en: Improvement in the domestic game is vital, not just for international rugby league. We need to continuously improve the domestic game for our audiences, who are our most important people.
paras.zh: 国内比赛的进步至关重要，不仅仅是对国际橄榄球联赛而言。我们需要为观众不断改进国内游戏，观众是我们最重要的人。

paras.en: We have to improve it for those people, you have to keep the product on top for those people.
paras.zh: 我们必须为这些人改进它，你必须为这些人保持产品的最佳状态。

paras.en: If the domestic game improves, then you would imagine the international game would improve by extension but your focus first and foremost has to be on the fans and ensuring you are giving them a game they want to watch in increasing numbers and are happy with.
paras.zh: 如果国内比赛有所改善，那么你会想象国际比赛也会随之改善，但你首先要关注的是球迷，并确保你为他们提供了一场他们想要观看的比赛，他们越来越多地想观看并且感到满意。

paras.en: That is the only question you need to answer.
paras.zh: 这是您需要回答的唯一问题。

articles.title: Parents, sister of far-right Kraków shooter found dead in family home
articles.author: Shayna Jacobs

paras.en: Three bodies found in the home of the 24-year-old shooter in Saturday’s rampage in the heart of Kraków, Poland, belonged to the gunman’s family, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，周六在波兰克拉科夫市中心发生的枪击事件中，在 24 岁枪手的家中发现了三具尸体，这些尸体属于枪手的家人。

paras.en: Investigators are looking at the deaths of the shooter’s parents and sister as they unravel events surrounding the random violence in the Polish city’s historic center, Main Market Square, around 3 p.m. Saturday.
paras.zh: 调查人员正在调查枪手父母和妹妹的死亡情况，同时调查下午 3 点左右在波兰城市历史中心主市场广场发生的随机暴力事件。周六。

paras.en: The relatives, who lived about 90 miles from Kraków, most likely died from gunshot wounds, according to police.
paras.zh: 据警方称，这些亲戚住在距离克拉科夫约 90 英里的地方，很可能死于枪伤。

paras.en: Authorities said the shooter, who survived a shootout with police and remains in the hospital, wore a bulletproof vest.
paras.zh: 当局表示，枪手在与警方的枪战中幸存下来，目前仍在医院，他穿着防弹背心。

paras.en: World leaders paid tribute to victims, and Poland declared two national days of mourning after the shooter, motivated by far-right ideologies killed six people in Kraków in what the country’s defense minister characterized as a “terror attack.”
paras.zh: 世界领导人向受害者表示哀悼，波兰宣布全国哀悼两天，此前克拉科夫枪击案凶手在极右意识形态的驱使下造成六人死亡，该国国防部长将此次事件称为“恐怖袭击”。

paras.en: The dead are a man from the United Kingdom, a woman from Austria and four Polish nationals, according to regional official Krzysztof Jan Klęczar. The injured include visitors from Britain, Portugal, Russia, Germany and Austria, according to The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 据地区官员克日什托夫·扬·克勒查尔 (Krzysztof Jan Klęczar) 称，死者包括一名英国男子、一名奥地利女子和四名波兰公民。据美联社报道，受伤者包括来自英国、葡萄牙、俄罗斯、德国和奥地利的游客。

paras.en: St. Mary’s Basilica in the square paused its hourly trumpet call overnight in honor of the victims. It was the first time the historic church had done so since World War II.
paras.zh: 广场上的圣玛丽大教堂彻夜暂停了每小时一次的号角声，以纪念遇难者。这是二战以来这座历史悠久的教堂第一次这样做。

paras.en: The gunman, whom officials described as having “ultranationalistic” beliefs, is reported to have opened fire in Kraków’s Main Market Square. The midday attack was the country’s deadliest shooting in decades, while a policeman who confronted the gunman is in critical condition.
paras.zh: 据报道，这名枪手在克拉科夫的主要集市广场开枪，官员称其具有“超民族主义”信仰。中午的袭击是该国几十年来最严重的枪击事件，而与枪手对峙的一名警察情况危急。

paras.en: The suspect is being investigated on suspicion of murder in connection, Justice Minister Waldemar Żurek said Sunday on X, adding that he “acted with the aim of seriously intimidating a large number of people, making this a terrorist offence.”
paras.zh: 司法部长瓦尔德马·祖雷克 (Waldemar Żurek) 周日表示，嫌疑人因涉嫌谋杀而正在接受调查，并补充说，他“采取行动的目的是严重恐吓大量民众，使这起事件成为恐怖主义犯罪”。

paras.en: The same suspect faces a separate murder charge over killings in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyskie, Żurek said, a town 93 miles northeast of Kraków, where three of his relatives were found dead in his home.
paras.zh: 祖雷克说，同一名嫌疑人因在克拉科夫东北 93 英里的奥斯特罗维茨圣十字镇杀人而面临单独的谋杀指控，他的三名亲戚被发现死在他的家中。

paras.en: “Establishing all the circumstances of these tragic events, determining the full sequence of the perpetrator’s actions and securing evidence are currently the priorities of the investigation,” which is being led by terror offense specialists within the prosecutor’s office, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，“查明这些悲惨事件的所有背景，确定肇事者行为的全部顺序并获取证据是目前调查的首要任务”，调查由检察官办公室内的恐怖犯罪专家领导。

paras.en: Kraków prosecutor Eryk Stasielak said that the shooter was in critical condition and that victim autopsies are set to start Monday, according to PAP, a Polish news service.
paras.zh: 据波兰新闻机构 PAP 报道，克拉科夫检察官埃里克·斯塔西拉克 (Eryk Stasielak) 表示，枪手情况危急，受害者尸检将于周一开始。

paras.en: “Tomorrow we will be deciding the fate of the attacker, if he survives, because he remains in critical condition,” Stasielak said, according to a translation of the report.
paras.zh: 根据报告的译文，斯塔西拉克说：“明天我们将决定袭击者的命运，如果他还活着，因为他仍处于危急状态。”

paras.en: Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński did not name the suspect, identifying him only as a Polish national in his mid-20s from Ostrowiec Świętokrzyskie. He used an automatic rifle, Kierwiński said Saturday, describing him as having “ultranationalistic” views.
paras.zh: 内政部长 Marcin Kierwiński 没有透露嫌疑人的姓名，仅称他是来自奥斯特罗维茨圣十字省的 20 多岁的波兰国民。基尔温斯基周六表示，他使用的是自动步枪，并称他有“超民族主义”观点。

paras.en: “Everything indicates he was fascinated by far-right ideologies,” he said.
paras.zh: “一切都表明他对极右意识形态着迷，”他说。

paras.en: The suspect was shot by police at the scene and taken to the hospital around 3 p.m.
paras.zh: 下午3点左右，嫌疑人在现场被警察开枪射杀，并被送往医院。

paras.en: A man and two women later found dead in an apartment are believed to be the suspect’s parents and sister, according to Andrzej Fijołek, deputy inspector of Police National Headquarters.
paras.zh: 国家警察总部副巡视员安杰伊·菲霍莱克 (Andrzej Fijołek) 表示，后来在公寓里发现的一名男子和两名妇女死亡，据信是嫌疑人的父母和妹妹。

paras.en: The Interior Ministry announced two national days of mourning Sunday and Monday.
paras.zh: 内政部宣布周日和周一为两个全国哀悼日。

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV expressed his sadness in a message to the archbishop of Kraków on Sunday. The pope “implores the gift of Christian hope for the families overwhelmed by grief and joins with all those experiencing these days of mourning,” the message read, according to a translation.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世周日在给克拉科夫大主教的信中表达了他的悲伤。根据翻译，教皇“恳求为那些被悲伤压垮的家庭带来基督教希望的礼物，并与所有经历这些日子哀悼的人们一起”。

paras.en: Żurek, the justice minister, said early Sunday on social media that Senior Constable Jakub Kulik “is fighting for his life in hospital” after he confronted the shooter.
paras.zh: 司法部长祖雷克周日早些时候在社交媒体上表示，高级警员雅库布·库里克在与枪手对峙后“正在医院为自己的生命而战”。

paras.en: “One of his lungs is not functioning, and he needs every drop of blood he can get,” he posted on X.
paras.zh: 他在 X 上发帖称：“他的一个肺部无法正常工作，他需要得到每一滴血。”

paras.en: Police later said blood banks in Kraków were full and thanked those who donated.
paras.zh: 警方后来表示，克拉科夫的血库已满，并对献血者表示感谢。

paras.en: “Senior constable Jakub Kulik and senior constable Artur Moranski are true heroes,” Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said, referring to both officers.
paras.zh: “高级警官雅库布·库里克和高级警官阿图尔·莫兰斯基是真正的英雄，”波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克在谈到这两名警官时说道。

paras.en: Klęczar said that without “the efficient and selfless intervention” of the officers, “the number of victims could have been significantly higher.”
paras.zh: 克勒查尔说，如果没有警察“高效和无私的干预”，“受害者人数可能会大大增加”。

paras.en: “The condition of the two police officers remains serious,” Klęczar said Sunday. Kierwiński later said the two men had been brought out of comas.
paras.zh: “两名警察的情况仍然很严重，”克勒查尔周日表示。基尔文斯基后来说，两人已从昏迷中苏醒。

paras.en: Video on social media shows what appears to be an injured police officer firing at the gunman before he drops to his knees and rolls over onto his back. The officer, who did not appear to have backup nearby, struggles to reload his firearm and appears to be clutching his right arm.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上的视频显示，一名受伤的警察向枪手开枪，然后枪手跪倒在地，翻身仰面躺着。这名警官附近似乎没有后备人员，他正在努力重新装弹，并且似乎紧紧抓住自己的右臂。

paras.en: British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said the U.K. government “deeply mourns the British national and other victims” who died.
paras.zh: 英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德表示，英国政府“对遇难的英国国民和其他受害者深表哀悼”。

paras.en: “The U.K. stands resolutely in solidarity with the people of Poland,” he said.
paras.zh: “英国坚决与波兰人民站在一起，”他说。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy also said Saturday that his country “stands in solidarity” with neighboring Poland, calling the shooting a “shocking crime.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基周六也表示，乌克兰与邻国波兰“站在一起”，称枪击事件是“令人震惊的犯罪”。

paras.en: The U.S. State Department said it was not aware of any American citizens harmed in the violence.
paras.zh: 美国国务院表示，目前尚不清楚有任何美国公民在暴力事件中受伤。

paras.en: “The profound depth of Poland’s shock at the horror of yesterday’s appalling mass murder in Krakow is truly remarkable to behold,” the U.S. ambassador to Poland, Tom Rose, said in a post on X.
paras.zh: 美国驻波兰大使汤姆·罗斯 (Tom Rose) 在 X 上发帖称：“波兰对昨天克拉科夫发生的骇人听闻的大屠杀感到震惊，着实令人震惊。”

paras.en: Noting how rare the incident was in an “extraordinarily safe” country like Poland, he added, “There’s something profoundly precious about being in a country where such evil remains so foreign to everyday life, where an entire nation recoils in horror at the mere thought of it, and where the depth of grief reveals the true goodness of its people.”
paras.zh: 他指出，这一事件在波兰这样一个“极其安全”的国家是多么罕见，他补充道，“在这样一个国家，这种邪恶对日常生活来说仍然如此陌生，整个国家一想到它就会感到恐惧，而悲痛的深度揭示了其人民的真正善良，这是非常宝贵的。”

paras.en: Part of Main Market Square in Kraków and surrounding streets reopened Sunday, but cordons remain while police carry out forensic work, the city has said in a statement.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫市在一份声明中表示，周日，克拉科夫主要集市广场的部分区域和周边街道重新开放，但在警方进行法医工作期间，警戒线仍然存在。

paras.en: Several makeshift memorials with flowers and candles appeared across the city Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日，全市各地出现了几个用鲜花和蜡烛搭建的临时纪念馆。

paras.en: Many of those caught up in the attack were tourists visiting the city.
paras.zh: 袭击事件中的许多人是到访这座城市的游客。

paras.en: Taylor Dorfmeister, 21, a student from Santa Cruz, California, studying in Italy who was visiting Poland, was in the square with his roommate when gunfire erupted. Dorfmeister said there was a delay before the crowd reacted and then everyone began to flee. He said he took shelter in a building.
paras.zh: 21 岁的泰勒·多夫梅斯特 (Taylor Dorfmeister) 是一名来自加利福尼亚州圣克鲁斯的学生，正在意大利留学，当时正在波兰访问，枪声爆发时，他和室友正在广场上。多夫迈斯特说，人群过了一段时间才做出反应，然后每个人都开始逃跑。他说他在一栋大楼里避难。

paras.en: “We ran up the stairs in the building to hide, and it was a dead end, which is when I was the most terrified, since the gunshots were [loud] and near,” Dorfmeister told NBC News.
paras.zh: 多夫梅斯特告诉 NBC 新闻：“我们跑上大楼的楼梯躲起来，那是一条死胡同，这是我最害怕的时候，因为枪声又大又近。”

paras.en: It sounded to Dorfmeister like the gunfire was coming from the first floor of the building where he hid. He was “fully prepared for the worst” based on the proximity of the noise, he said.
paras.zh: 多夫梅斯特听起来枪声像是从他藏身的大楼一楼传来的。他说，根据噪音的距离，他“做好了最坏的准备”。

paras.en: “This is it,” Dorfmeister thought. “Like, there’s nowhere to go, nowhere to hide.”
paras.zh: “就是这样，”多夫迈斯特想。 “就像，无处可去，无处可藏。”

paras.en: Marie-Ange Collaer was visiting with her family from Brussels.
paras.zh: 玛丽-安吉·科拉尔 (Marie-Ange Collaer) 与家人从布鲁塞尔来探望。

paras.en: “We literally ran for our lives and managed to hide from the bullets flying around,” she wrote on Facebook. “Lying on the floor in a shop like in a bad police movie whilst you hear bullets everywhere.”
paras.zh: 她在脸书上写道：“我们真的是拼命逃命，并设法躲避飞来的子弹。” “躺在商店的地板上，就像一部糟糕的警察电影中一样，你会听到到处都是子弹。”

paras.en: Collaer said that her family were shaky and “quite in shock” after they returned to their hotel and that everyone was grateful to be alive.
paras.zh: 科拉尔说，回到酒店后，她的家人都摇摇欲坠，“非常震惊”，每个人都庆幸自己还活着。

paras.en: “We saw a few that did not make it, true horror,” she wrote.
paras.zh: “我们看到了一些没有成功的人，真正的恐怖，”她写道。

paras.en: U.K. resident Neil Thaxton and his wife, Nicky, also survived the attack.
paras.zh: 英国居民尼尔·萨克斯顿和他的妻子尼基也在袭击中幸存。

paras.en: “We had just walked through the main square and heard the gunshots,” Thaxton wrote on Facebook. “We thought it was fireworks then people started running, we went into a gift shop and the staff took us in the back of the shop and locked the doors and turned the lights off.”
paras.zh: 萨克斯顿在脸书上写道：“我们刚刚走过主广场，就听到了枪声。” “我们以为那是烟花，然后人们开始逃跑，我们走进一家礼品店，工作人员把我们带到商店后面，锁上门并关掉灯。”

articles.title: U.S. charges 3 men with plotting multiple terror attacks, including planned attack against U.K. airbase
articles.author: Michael Kosnar

paras.en: Three men, including one already jailed in the U.S., were accused by U.S. authorities Tuesday of being Iran-supported operatives who plotted nearly 20 attacks on Jewish communities in Europe and the U.S., as well as a planned assault on a British air base used by the U.S. Air Force.
paras.zh: 三名男子，其中一名已在美国入狱，周二被美国当局指控为伊朗支持的特工，他们策划了近 20 起针对欧洲和美国犹太社区的袭击，并计划袭击美国空军使用的英国空军基地。

paras.en: Charges against Mohammad Al-Saadi, a dual Iranian-Iraqi national; Mohsen Mohajeri, an Iranian national; and Mohammad Ali Al-Hassani, an Iraqi national, were outlined in a superseding indictment unsealed in federal court in New York City.
paras.zh: 对拥有伊朗和伊拉克双重国籍的穆罕默德·萨阿迪 (Mohammad Al-Saadi) 的指控； Mohsen Mohajeri，伊朗国民；纽约市联邦法院公布的一份替代起诉书中概述了伊拉克国民穆罕默德·阿里·哈桑尼的情况。

paras.en: Only Al-Saadi — an alleged pro-Iranian terrorist who is believed to have plotted attacks across Europe, Canada and the U.S., as first reported by NBC News — is in custody.
paras.zh: 只有萨阿迪 (Al-Saadi) 被拘留，他是一名被指控亲伊朗的恐怖分子，据 NBC 新闻报道，据信他在欧洲、加拿大和美国策划了袭击事件。

paras.en: U.S. Attorney Jamie McDonald in New York said in a news release that Al-Saadi, who was arrested in the spring, continued to coordinate with his co-defendants in the days leading up to the attempted September terrorist plot at a British Royal Air Force Base in Fairford, where U.S. bombers and troops had been stationed.
paras.zh: 纽约美国检察官杰米·麦克唐纳 (Jamie McDonald) 在一份新闻稿中表示，今年春天被捕的萨阿迪在 9 月份在费尔福德英国皇家空军基地（美国轰炸机和部队曾驻扎在那里）未遂恐怖袭击阴谋之前的几天里，继续与他的同案被告进行协调。

paras.en: “As alleged, these defendants helped orchestrate a campaign of terror on behalf of terrorist organizations affiliated with Iran that targeted Jewish communities in Europe and the United States, and the British military base, RAF Fairford, housing American service members,” said McDonald, whose office is handling the case.
paras.zh: “据称，这些被告代表与伊朗有关联的恐怖组织帮助策划了一场恐怖活动，目标是欧洲和美国的犹太社区，以及居住着美国军人的英国皇家空军费尔福德基地，”负责处理此案的办公室的麦克唐纳说。

paras.en: “The threat presented by Iran and Iran-backed terrorist groups to America and our allies is not hypothetical — it is very real,” he added in the statement.
paras.zh: 他在声明中补充道：“伊朗和伊朗支持的恐怖组织对美国和我们的盟友构成的威胁不是假设的，而是非常真实的。”

paras.en: The new indictment offers fresh insight into an episode that has been shrouded in mystery for more than a month after five men were detained after midnight Sept. 27 on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offenses after three suspicious vans were spotted traveling toward the base in western England.
paras.zh: 新的起诉书为这一事件提供了新的视角。9月27日午夜后，三辆可疑货车被发现驶向英格兰西部基地，五名男子因涉嫌爆炸物和恐怖主义犯罪而被拘留，这个事件已经笼罩了一个多月的神秘面纱。

paras.en: The Justice Department indictment alleges that Al-Hassani paid associates to carry out surveillance of RAF Fairford in August and paid several people to move forward with the plot in September “by procuring vans and barrels of fuel, researching the purchase of chemical accelerants, including large quantities of potassium chloride, and purchasing metallic objects that could be used as explosive shrapnel.”
paras.zh: 司法部起诉书称，哈桑尼在 8 月份付钱给同事，让他们对英国皇家空军费尔福德进行监视，并在 9 月份付钱给几个人来推进阴谋，“通过采购货车和燃料桶，研究购买化学促进剂，包括大量氯化钾，以及购买可用作爆炸弹片的金属物体。”

paras.en: The group even made custom decals to give the vans the appearance that they were used by a fuel company and a swimming pool supply business, authorities say.
paras.zh: 当局称，该组织甚至定制了贴花，让这些货车看起来像是一家燃料公司和一家游泳池供应公司使用的。

paras.en: Al-Hassani is alleged to have then tasked the people to go to the base with the fuel when U.K. law enforcement took the men into custody.
paras.zh: 据称，当英国执法部门拘留这些人时，哈桑尼要求这些人携带燃料前往基地。

paras.en: Al-Saadi was helping direct the RAF Fairford plot while he was in a U.S. prison, according to the indictment. He made video and phone calls to his family members in Iraq, who are alleged to have passed coded messages to Al-Hassani and Mohajeri.
paras.zh: 起诉书称，萨阿迪在美国监狱期间帮助指挥了英国皇家空军费尔福德阴谋。他给在伊拉克的家人打电话和视频，据称他们向哈桑尼和莫哈杰里传递了密码信息。

paras.en: In a July call with his sister, Al-Saadi asked, “What are we doing about all our old work?” — a reference to terrorist activity — according to investigators.
paras.zh: 7 月份，萨阿迪在与妹妹的一次通话中问道：“我们对之前的工作做了什么？” ——据调查人员称，这是对恐怖活动的提及。

paras.en: His sister replied, “It isn’t cancelled,” investigators said.
